src: IKhabinethi iyayamukela iKulumo yobuJamo beNarha (i-SoNA) kaMengameli u-Jacob Zuma, yona enikele amaSewula Afrika ithuba lokuzwa iHlelo lokuSebenza likaRhulumende.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱanganedza Mulaedza wa Lushaka nga Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma, tshe tsha ṋea MaAfrika Tshipembe tshifhinga tsha u pfa Mbekanyamushumo ya Kushumele kwa muvhuso.

src: URhulumende umema boke ababelani kilo loke ilizwe ukuthi baSebenzisane ehlelweni lamaphuzu alithoba kobanyana kuzokuthungeleleka ihlelo lokuhlumisa umnotho nelokuvula imisebenzi.
tgt: Muvhuso u khou ita khuwelelo kha vhoṱhe vha kwameaho shangoni ḽashu u Shumisana kha pulane ya mbuno dza ṱahe u itela u ṱuṱuwedza nyaluwo na u sika mishumo.

src: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaSewula Afrika alizwa ngcono iHlelo lokuSebenza likaRhulumende, kwenziwe iindlela zokuthintana zangemva kwe-SoNA ezizakuveza imininingwana yeememezelo ezenziwe nguMengameli.
tgt: U vhona uri maAfrikaTshipembe vhapfesesa khwine Mbekanyamushumo ya Kushumele kwa muvhuso, vhurangela vhudavhidzani vhuḓaho nga murahu ha Mulaedza wa Lushaka ho itwa u itela u ṋea zwidodombedzwa nga ha nḓivhadzo dzo itwaho nga Muphuresidennde.

src: Lapha-ke kubalwa imiHlangano yeeMbikiindaba yeHlanganisela yaboNgqongqotjhe ethome ukubanjwa mhlana ali-15, ezabe iyokuphela mhlana ama-24 kuMhlolanja wee-2015.Ngaphezu kwalokho, iKulumo yeSabelo seeMali yomNyaka wee-2015/16 eyokwethulwa mhlana 25 kuMhlolanja izokuphakamisa ukwabiwa kwemithombo yeensetjenziswa emahlelweni karhulumende ahlukahlukeneko, njengoba kugandelele uMengameli.
tgt: Izwi zwi katela vhudavhidzani na Vhoramafhungo ha Tshigwada tsha Dziminisita dza mihasho i shumisanaho he ha farwa nga dzi 15 u swika dzi 24 Luhuhi WEBTOKEN tshi ḓadziswa, Mulaedza wa Mugaganyagwama wa 2015/16 wo tetshelwaho u vha hone nga dzi 25 Luhuhi 2015 tshi ḓo bvisela khagala u avhelwa ha zwishumiswa kha mbekanyamushumo dza muvhuso dzo fhambanaho sa zwe zwa ombedzelwa nga Muphuresidennde.

src: IKhabinethi iyayisola indlela ephambene nekambiso nesiko lePalamende amanye wamaLunga wePalamende aziphethe ngayo nakuvulwa iPalamende.
tgt: Khabinethe i sasaladza u sa laulea na vhuḓipfari vhusi ha Phalamennde ha miṅwe ya Miraḓo ya Phalamennde nga ḓuvha ḽa u Vula ha Phalamennde.

src: Kuyadanisa ukubona ukuthi amalunga akhethwe mphakathi bona ayowujamela ePalamende akhethe ukubhica ngedaka ukuzinikela nomzabalazo owenziwako wokulwela ikululeko nentando eyatholakala nzima kangaka le.2 IKhabinethi ibikelwe ngendima esele yenziweyi-Operation Phakisa yomNotho weLwandle.
tgt: Zwi a shonisa uri vhaimeleli avha vho khethwaho nga tshitshavha vho nanga u sa ṱhonifha u ḓikumedzela na nndwa dzo itwaho u swikelela demokirasi ye ya wanala zwi tshi khou konḓa.2 Khabinethe yo nyeṱulelwa nga ha mvelaphanḓa yo itwaho kha ikonomi ya maḓanzhe OperationPhakisa.

src: I ‘Lab’ namkha isigaba sokuhlela senziwe e-Durban ngoVelabahlinze nangoRhoboyi womnyaka wee-2014, umphumela wakhona kwaba ‘lihlelo lokuhlukaniswa komsebenzi ngeendinyana ezingaphunyeleliswa lula’ ngemininingwana yawo epheleleko, wokuhlumisa umnotho welwandle.
tgt: Vhupulani ho itwa ngei Durban nga ṅwedzi wa Fulwana na Ṱhangule 2014 ha fhedza ho ḓisa mveledziso nga vhuḓalo ya ‘pulane dzzi langeaho’ u alusa ikonomi ya maḓanzhe.

src: I-Operation Phakisa nje seyingene esigabeni sokuthoma sokusetjenziswa kilesisigaba-ke kuzokuqalwa umsebenzi wokubeka ilihlo newokwelusa ihlelo lokuthoma ukusebenzisa namkha lokuphumelelisa lelihlelo.
tgt: Yuniti dza nḓisedzo dzo no thomiwa nahone vhulavhelesi na nḓila dza u pfukisela na maitele na zwone zwi hone.

src: Sezihlonyiwewe iinsetjenziswa zokuphumelelisa umsebenzi lo, ngokunjalo namahlelo wokubeka ilihlo neendlela zokudlulisela umsebenzi phambili nazo sezilungile.
tgt: Ho dovha ha newa thoololo nga ha Operation Phakisa ya vhuvhili yo rangwaho phanḓa nga Muhasho wa Mutakalo, yo sedzaho kha Kuvhonele ya nṱhesa na Ṱhogomelo ya Kiḽiniki ine ya khou bvela phanḓa nahone ye ya rwelwa ṱari nga Muphuresidennde nga dzi 18 Ḽara 20.3 Khabinethe yo tendela Maano a Muhanga wa Pfanelo na Mutakalo wa Mbebo na Vhudzekani ha Vhaswa vha Lushaka.

src: Ikhutjhiwe nehlathululo yokuthi kufuze lenziwe njani ihlandla lesibili le-Operation Phakisa elithwelwe mNyango wezamaPhilo lelihlandla-ke lizokuqalana nehlelo i-Ideal Clinic Realisation and Maintenance, esele lithomile, elisikinyiswe nguMengameli mhlana ali-18 kuSinyikhaba 20.3 IKhabinethi iphasise iQhinga lomTlamo wezamaPhilo weLutjha kezomSeme nezeMbeleko namaLungelo eliZweni oKe.
tgt: Maano aya a sedzesa kha u bveledza na u ṱuṱuwedza mvelelo dza zwa mutakalo dzine khadzo mutakalo wa vhudzekani na mbebo ya vhaswa zwa vha zwa ndeme.

src: IQhingeli liqalene nokukhuthaza nokuphakamisa imiphumela yepilo ehle, la kuqalwe khona khulu khulu ipilo ehle yelutjha kezomseme nembelekweni.
tgt: Maano aya a ḓo dovha a vhona uri hu na pfano yo khwiniseaho, u shumisana na u konana na mbekanyamushumo dza muvhuso, zwitshavha na vhafarani vha mvelaphanḓa vhane vha khou shuma kha sia ḽa vhudzekani ha vhaswa na mutakalo wa mbebo.

src: Iqhingeli lizakubuye godu liqinisekise ukuthi kunokukhambisana nokusebenzisana okuhle nehlelo likarhulumende, nezakhamuzi kunye nababelani bezetuthuko esele vele basebenza ekorweni eqalelela ipilo ehle yelutjha kezomseme nembelekweni.
tgt: Komiti ya Dziminisiṱa ya Phoḽisi ya Vhathu i ḓo lavhelesa u thomiwa hazwo, u monitha na vhuṱoli ha Maano aya.4 Khabinethe yo tendela u ganḓiswa ha mvetamveto ya mbekanyamaitele ya Mveledziso ya Vhaswa kha Gurannḓa ya Muvhuso.

src: IKomidi yaboNgqongqotjhe bomThethokambiso abahlanganyeleko ngeNani labaNtu namkha ngabaNtu abaHlala eNdaweni ngiwo ozakuqalelela ukuphunyeleliswa, ukweluswa ngokubekwa ilihlo kunye nokulinganiswa kweQhingeli.
tgt: Hezwi zwi vhumba tshipiḓa tsha Mbekanyamushumo ya Mashumele yo Ṱanganelanaho ya Afurika Tshipembe ya Mveledziso ya Vhaswa – Iyaho Phanḓa 2013-2016, yo tendelwaho nga Khabinethe nga dzi 18 Tshimedzi 2013.Mbekanyamaitele i ṋetshedza muhanga wa vhuḓifhinduleli wa muvhuso kha u ṋetshedza tshomedzo dzo fhelelaho dza tshumelo ya ndeme ya Mveledziso ya Vhaswa ine ya ḓo wanala hoṱhe-hoṱhe nga zwithu zwo linganaho fhethu ha tsini u itela uri vhana vha ḓiphine nga zwikhala zwi eḓanaho zwa u zwi swikela.

src: IKhabinethi iphasise ukumenyezelwa eGazedeni yomBuso komtlolo womTlamo womThethokambiso weHlelo lokuThuthukiswa kwabeNtwana kwebuNcanini Lokhu-ke kuyingcenye yeHlelo lemiSebenzi eliLungelelweko leHlelo lokuThuthukiswa kwabeNtwana kwebuNcanini leSewula Afrika – Iragelo phambili phakathi komnyaka wee-2013-2016, eliphasiswe yiKhabinethi mhlana ali-18 kuKhukhulamungu wee-2013.
tgt: Mbekanyamaitele i ḓovha hafhu ya ḓivhadza tshivhalo tsha tshumelo ntswa dzine dza ḓo thivha magake o no vhonalaho kha vhunzhi ha tshumelo dzine dza vha hone zwino nga maanḓa kha maḓuvha a 1 000 a u thoma a vhutshilo ha ṅwana.

src: UmThethokambiso lo uphethe isendlalelo sesibopho sikarhulumende sezenzelwa zakhe ezipheleleko nezezinga eliphezulu zokuThuthukiswa kwabeNtwana kwebuNcanini ezizakutholakala kizo zoke iindawo ngokwaneleko nangobuduze, kobanyana boke abantwana bazokuba nethuba lokuzithola.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela hafhu u thomiwa ha Komiti ya Dziminisiṱa (IMC), ine ya ḓo vhona uri hu na maitele o dzudzanyeaho nahone are na vhukonanyi.

src: Umthethokamiso lo uza nezenzelwa ezitja zokuvala iinkhala ezibonakele erherhweni lezenzelwa zagadesi, khulu khulu emalangeni ayi-1000 wokuthoma wepilo yomntwana.
tgt: Mudzulatshidulo wayo hu ḓo vha Minisiṱa wa Muhasho wa Mveledziso ya Matshilisano.5 Khabinethe yo tendela u bviswa ha muvhigo wa Mvetamveto ya Shango ya u Thoma nga ha Mbumbano ya Dzitshakha kha Pfanelo dza Vhathu vha re na Vhuholefhali, u itela vhupfiwa nga tshitshavha ha tshifhinga tsha maḓuvha a Muvhigo u angaredza tshifhinga tsha u bva Lambamai 2012 u swika Ṱhafamuhwe 20.6 Khabinethe yo tendela uri Afurika Tshipembe ḽi shele mulenzhe kha Ṅwaha wa Mapa wa Dzitshakhatshakha nga 2015 na 2016 nga u dzudzanya vhuṱambo uvhu kha maimo a lushaka ho sedzwa uri hu ḓo engedzwa maimo a u dzhiela nzhele mapa na ḽitheresi Afurika Tshipembe.

src: IKhabinethi ibuye yavumelana nanokuvulwa kweKomidi yaboNgqongqotjhe abaHlanganyeleko, ezakuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhanjwa ngendlela elungelelana ngokuvumelana nokuzwana.
tgt: Mimapa i thusa u pfesesa thaidzo na khonadzeo, u fana na u ṋetshedza dzinnḓu, u londola zwiko zwa mupo, u laula khonadzeo ya khombo, na u tshimbidza themamveledziso dza vhuendi nga misi yoṱhe.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukuthi iSewula Afrika ingenele umcimbi womNyaka weMebhe yamaZwe ngamaZwe ngomnyaka wee-2015 nangowee-2016 ngokukhwezelela imicimbi elizweni loke ngomnqopho wokuphakamisa ilimuko lamamebhe kunye nelwazi lokwazi ukufunda eSewula Afrika.
tgt: U pfesesa mafhungo nga ḓivhavhupo zwi thusa vhupulani na u dzhia tsheo u itela mveledziso ya Afurika Tshipembe.

src: Amamebhe asiza ngokuthi umuntu akghone ukuzwisisa imiraro nalokho okungenzeka (okungakghonakala), njengokwakhiwa kweenkumba, ukulondoza imithombo yamandla yemvelo, ukulawula ubujamo obunengozi kunye nokukghonakalisa umthangalasisekelo wezokuthutha ngesikhathi.
tgt: Tsheo dza ndeme dza Khabinethe.1 Khabinethe yo tendela Masumbasia nga ha u thomiwa ha muṱhaṱhuvho wo ḓitikaho nga vhukoni kha miraḓo ya Tshumelo dza Vhalanguli Vhahulwane (SMS), yo bviswaho u ya nga Ndima ya vhuṋa tshipiḓa II

src: Ukuba nelwazi ngesakheko sephasi kuhlomisela ukuhlelwa kwezinto nokuthathwa kweenqunto zokuthuthukisa iSewula Afrika.
tgt: na Ndima ya vhuṋa, tshipiḓa VI tsha Milayo ya Tshumelo ya Tshitshavha, 2001.Ḽisumbasia ḽo khwiniswaho ḽi ṱuṱuwedza u topolwa ha magake a mveledziso ya muraḓo wa SMS ho imaho nga hoṱhe, u thomiwa ha u shumiswa ha nḓowenḓowe ya thekiniki na u ṋetshedza ngeletshedzo nga ha uri mihasho i nga shumisa hani mvelelo dza muṱhaṱhuvho wa vhukoni khathihi na maṅwe maitele a u thola na u nanga.2 Khabinethe yo tendela u vha hone ha Vhege ya Lushaka yo Sedzaho kha Imbizo u bva nga dzi 7 u swika 12 Lambamai 2015 fhasi ha thero Roṱhe ri isa Afurika Tshipembe Phanḓa.

src: IinQunto zeKhabinethi eziQakathekileko.1 IKhabinethi ivumele imiLayelo ngokuphunyeleliswa kokuhlolwa kwekghono lokusebenza kwamalunga wabaPhathi bemiSebenzi ePhakemeko (ama-SMS), ekhutjhwe ngokwesaHluko 4 Indinyana II
tgt: Vhege i ḓo katela, u dalelwa ha muḓi nga muḓi u dalela thandela nyambedzano na vhakwameaho vhukwamani na tshitshavha khathihi na vhukwamani ha nyanḓadzamafhungo ya mbambadzo na tshitshavha.

src: nesaHluko 4, Indinyana VI yemiThetholawulo yomnyaka wee-2001 yeKoro emBusweni.
tgt: Izwi zwi ṋetshedza vhalanguli pulatifomo u davhidzana thwii na maAfurika Tshipembe, uri vha pfe mafhungo nga vhone vhaṋe na u ṱola mvelaphanḓa ya mbekanyamushumo dza muvhuso.3 Milayotibe.1 Khabinethe yo tendela u ganḓiswa ha mvetamveto ya Tsireledzo, Ṱhuṱhuwedzo, Mveledziso na Ndangulo ya Mulayotibe wa Sisiṱeme dza Nḓivho dza Sialala ngomu ha Gurannḓa ya Muvhuso khathihi na maitele a vhukwamani na tshitshavha.

src: UmLayelo otjhugululiweko ukhuthazela ukukhonjwa kweendawana ezifuna itjhejo lokuthuthukiswa kwamaLunga we-SMS, uveze ukusetjenziswa kwemisebenzi yechwephetjhe, ukhanyise nekombandlela ngokuthi iminyango ngeminyango ingayisebenzisa njani imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwekghono lokusebenza ngokusebenzisana nazo zoke ezinye iindlela zokukhetha nokuqatjha.
tgt: Ndivho khulwane ya Mulayotibe uyu ndi u tutuwedza tsireledzo ya Ndivho ya Sialala na mvusuludzo na u ḓivha Nḓivho ya Sialala i elanaho na vhuṋe nga sialala na zwitshavha zwapo AfurikaTshipembe.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukusingatha iVeke yeMbizo yeliZweloke ukusuka mhlana ali-7 ukuyokufika nakali-12 kuSihlabantangana wee-2015, ngaphasi kwesihloko esithi “Sisoke siragela iSewula Afrika Phambili”.
tgt: U ṱuṱuwedza vhululamisi ha pfanelo na mbuelo dze sialala na zwitshavha zwapo zwa fhurwa.2 Khabinethe yo tendela u ganḓiswa ha Mulayotibe wa Khwiniso wa Ndangulo ya Tshigidi, 2015 ngomu ha Gurannḓa ya Muvhuso u itela vhupfiwa nga tshitshavha.

src: NgeVeke le kuzabe kuvakatjhelwa umuzi nomunzi kuthathwa imininingwana yobunjalo bomuzi ngamunye kukhanjwa kuhlolwa iindawo ngeendawo namkha kuhlolwa amaphrojekthi ngamaphrojekhthi kucocisanwa nababelani kubonisanwa nomphakathi kubonisanwa naneembikiindaba ezisebenzela ukwenza imali nezisebenzela umphakathi.
tgt: Mulayotibe u khwinisa Mulayo wa Ndangulo ya Tshigidi, 2000 na u tikedza Bono ḽa Pulane ya Mveledziso ya Lushaka nga u lingedza u khwinisa thendelo na muhanga wa ndaulo une wa ḓo langa zwigidi.

src: Koke lokhu-ke kunikela abadosiphambili ithuba nekundla yokukhulumisana namaSewula Afrika bunqopha, bazizwele mathupha iindaba nemiraro yomphakathi ngokwabo, babuye baqale nokuthi ingangani indima eyenziwa mahlelo karhulumende.
tgt: Ndangulo ya zwigidi ndi sia ḽa ndeme ḽa maele a ulwa na vhugevhenga a muvhuso.4 Vhuimo ha Khabinete kha Mafhungo a Zwino.1 Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo zwitshavhani na kha madzangano uri hu shumiwe na muvhuso, fhasi ha vhurangaphanḓa ha Muhasho wa Tshumisano kha Muvhuso na zwa Sialala, u vhona uri khaedu dza Malamulele ngei Limpopo dzi khou tandululwa.

src: 3 ImiThethomlingwa.1 IKhabinethi ivumele ukumenyezelwa komtlamo womThethomlingwa wokuVikela, nokuKhuthaza, nokuThuthukiswa kunye nokuLawulwa kweLwazi leNdabuko eGazedeni yomBuso kunye nehlelo lokubonisana nomphakathi.
tgt: Khabinethe i sasaladza u thithiswa ha zwikolo nga zwiṅwe zwigwada sa yone nḓila ya u ṱahisa mbilaelo.

src: Ekuwona mnqopho ophambili walomThethomlingwa kuvikela iLwazi leNdabuko nokubuyisa nokuvuma amaqiniso ngeLwazi leNdabuko labaNtu beNdabuko balapha eSewula Afrika.
tgt: Izwi zwo fhura vhana pfanelo yavho ya pfunzo na u vha kundisa iṅwe pfanelo ya u ḓiṅwalisela milingo yavho ya u engedza ya Gireidi U thoṅwa ha masipala ngei Malamulele zwi fanela u vha fhasi ha mulayo sa zwe zwa randwa nga Bodo ya Mikano.2 Khabinethe i sasaladza ṱhaselo kha tshaka dza vhatsinda sa nyito dza vhugevhenga ya dovha ya ombedzela uri mazhendezi a tshumelo ya mulayo a sa timatime u dzhia vhukando kha muṅwe na muṅwe ane a ḓo wanala sa ene o vhangaho pfudzungule idzo.

src: UmThethomlingwa lo ubuyisa amalungelo nobuhle obabusenziwa lilwazi lendabuko abantu bendabuko abemukwa wona.
tgt: A huna vhuleme na vhuthihi ha ikonomi na u sa fushea hune hu nga imelela nyito dza vhugevhenga dzi elanaho na ṱhaselo idzi.

src: UmThethomlingwa lo utjhugulula umThetho womnyaka wee-2000 oLawula iinGidi, kanti unjalo nje bewuphendula neNembombono yomTlamo wokuThuthukiswa kweliZweloke (i-NDP) ngokufuna ukwenza ubungcono ehlelweni lomtlamo olitlatlha newokulawula iingidi.
tgt: Afurika Tshipembe ndi ḽiṅwe ḽa mashango o sainaho Milayo ya Ṱhunḓu ngei Geneva nahone ḽo ḓiimisela u tsireledza tshaka dza vhatsinda shangoni ḽino.

src: Phela ukulawulwa kweengidi kuyingcenye eqakathekileko yendlela nekambiso urhulumende angayisebenzisa ukuqeda ubulelesi.
tgt: Sa shango ḽo sainaho Milayo iyi, nahone sa shango ḽine ḽa tsireledza na u londa pfanelo dza vhathu, ri ḓo tsireledza pfanelo dza mutheo dza muthu muṅwe na muṅwe ngomu mikanoni yashu, hu tshi katelwa na tshakha dza vhatsinda.3 Khabinethe yo tendela u swikiswa ṱafulani ngei Phalamenndeni u itela u thendelo ha , Mulanga wo Bveledzaho Nzudzanyo dza Kuvhulungele kwa BRICS kha Bannga Ntswa ya Mveledziso.

src: 4 Ubujamo beKhabinethi Ngeendaba Ezenzeka esikhathini sanje.1 IKhabinethi ikhuthaza imiphakathi neenjamiso ezihlelekileko ukuthi zisebenzisane ngokulekelelana norhulumende, ngaphasi koburholi bomNyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nezeNdabuko, ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi iyararululwa imiraro ye-Malamulele e-Limpopo.
tgt: Nzudzanyo ya Kuvhulungele kwa Dzangano i khou thomiwa u itela u fhindula mutsiko wa u badela wa tshifhinga tshipfufhi.

src: IKhabinethi iyakusola ukuliywa nokudungwa kwehlelo lokufunda eenkolweni, okwenziwa ziinqhema ezithileko njengendlela yokuzwakalisa iinlilo.
tgt: Hafhu, i ḓo shuma sa maitele a tsirakhombo u thusa mashango a BRICS u thivhela mutsiko wa thengiselano ya tshifhinga nyana, u ṋea thikhedzo na u khwaṱhisa ngona ya mukatelo ya tsireledzo ya masheleni.4 Khabinethe i dzhiela nzhele u pfukisela ha Mudzulatshidulo wa tshipiḓa tsha Afurika Tshipembe tsha Khoro ya Vhubindudzi ya BRICS u bva kha Vho Patrice Motsepe u ya kha Vho Brian Molefe.

src: Lokhu kwemuka bekudima abantwana ilungelo labo lokufunda, lidima nabanye abafundi ilungelo lokurejistarela ukutlola iinhlahlubo zokuzalisiselela zikaGreyidi Ukwakhelwa kwendawo ye-Malamulele umasipaladi ongowayo kufuze kwenziwe ngokulandela umthetho obekwe yiBhodi yokuSikwa kwemiKhawulo.2 IKhabinethi isola ukusahlelwa kwamaphandle njengesenzo sobulelesi nje-ke itjho iyabuyelela ithi bomthetho angeze bazaze ukubathathela amagadango labo abatholakala baphehla inturhu enje.
tgt: Vho Motsepe vho vha mudzulatshidulo wa u thoma wa tshipiḓa tsha Afurika Tshipembe na Khoro ya Vhubindudzi ya BRICS yothe.

src: Akunamtlhago wobuchaka nesililo okungabekwa njengesizathu esizwakalako sokwenza ubulelesi obukhambisana nokusahlelwa kwamaphandle.
tgt: Nga tshifhinga tshavho tsha ofisi, Vho Motsepe vho zwi kona u thoma tshiimiswa itshi tsha ndeme sa tshipiḓa tsha BRICS nahone vha shuma sa mudzulatshidulo nga vhudzivha.

src: ISewula Afrika ingelinye lamazwe atlikitla isiVumelwano se-Geneva ngabaPhalali, ngalokho-ke inesibopho sokuwavikela woke amaphandle alapha ekhethu.
tgt: Vho Kellerman vho rekhoda Winds of Samsara na mubveledzi wa India Ricky Kej, zwe zwa vha wanisa pfufho kha tshumisano yavho.7 Khabinethe i ṱahisa na u livhuwa vhashumisi vhoṱhe vha fulufulu nga u fhindula khuwelelo ya u fhungudza tshumiso ya muḓagasi.

src: Njengelizwe elatlikitla namanye amazwe kilesisiVumelwano, begodu nanjengelizwe elikhakhazisa amalungelo wobuntu, sizawavikela amalungelo wabo boke abantu abaselizweni lekhethweli, ngitjho nawo amaphandle imbala.3 IKhabinethi ivumele ukwethulwa ePalamende kwesiVumelwano sokuSungulwa kwesiKhwama sokuGada isiMetjhe se-BRICKS ngeBhanga yezokuThuthukisa eTja, kobanyana sizofakazelwa, sidluliswe.
tgt: Maitele a u dzudzanya khaedu dza fulufulu a khou shumiwa khao.

src: Ihlelweli-ke lisungulelwa ukuphendula iingandelelo zesikhathi esifitjhazana sokubhadela ekufuze kubhadelwe ngaso.
tgt: Lufhera lwa Nndwa lwe lwa thoṅwa nga Nyendavhusiku 2014 lwo rangwa phanḓa nga Mufarisa Muphuresidennde Vho Cyril Ramaphosa vha khou ṱavhanyisa o thomiwa ha pulane ya mbuno ṱhanu u shandukisa nyimele iyi.8 Khabinethe i ima na Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma u rumela ndiliso kha muṱa na khonani dza muṅwali wa maṅwalwa a Afrikaans Vho Phurofesa André Brink.

src: Ukudlula lapho, lizakusebenza njengegadango lokuyelela nelokulekelela amazwe amalunga we-BRICS ukulindela nokukhandela iingandelelo zemali zesikhatjhana, linikele ukusekelana libuye godu liqinise ukuya phambili ubuphephelo beemali ephasini zombelele.4 IKhabinethi itjheja ukudluliselwa kwesikhundla sokuba nguSihlalo ebesiphethwe nguNomzana Patrice Motsepe emKhandlwini wezamaBhizinisi ephikweni leSewula Afrika ngaphasi kwe-BRICS KuNomana Brian Molefe.
tgt: Ri ḓo vha elelwa sa muṅwali wa ndeme wa Afrikaans we a shumisa vhukoni hawe ha maṅwalwa u amba nga ha muvhuso wa tshiṱalula.5 Mbekanyamushumo dzine dza khou ḓa.1 Khabinethe i khou ombedzela khuwelelo nga Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma uri mahoro oṱhe ngei Lesotho a ḓifare nga nḓila ine ya sika nyimele yavhuḓi ya u fara dzikhetho nga mulalo, zwi khagala, zwi tshi ṱhonifhea, nahone dzo vhofholowa, zwi ṱanaho lutamo lwa vhathu.

src: UNomana Motsepe waba nguSihlalo wephiko leSewula Afrika nelomKhandlu wezamaBhizinisi sewuwoke ekusungulweni kwawo.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱahisa vhuḓifulufheli kha matshimbidzele a mushumo u no khou bvelaphanḓa wa Thuṅwa ya Vhulavhelesi ya ngei Lesotho fhasi vhurangaphanḓa ha Mufarisa Muphuresidennde Vho Ramaphosa.

src: Ekuphatheni kwakhe lesisikhundla, uNomzana Motsepe uphumelele ukusungula lesisijamiso njengengcenye eyisika yesijamiso se-BRICS, begodu umsebenzakhe wokuba nguSihlalo wawenza kuhle khulu waba yipumelelo esiqongolo.
tgt: Sa tshipiḓa tsha tsheo ya Mashango mararu a SADC ta Ṱhoho dza Mivhuso, Afurika Tshipembe ḽi ḓo shela mulenzhe nga u rangaphanḓa na u vhumba tshipiḓa tsha Thuṅwa dza Vhulavhelesi ha Khetho dza SADC ngei Lesotho, hu tshi itela khetho dze dza tetshelwaho ḽa 28 Luhuhi 20.2 Mulangammbi Muhulwane wa Mmbi ya Lushaka ya Afurika Tshipembe, Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma vha ḓo vha vhone vho faraho vhuṱambo kha Ḓuvha la u Pembelela Mmbi dza Zwiṱhavhane fhasi ha thero “Mmbi ya phurofeshenala i konaho ya vhupileli ya vhathu vha Afurika Tshipembe” nga la 21 Luhuhi 2015, ngei Potchefstroom, Devhula Vhukovhela.

src: Nje-ke iKhabinethi ithokoza uNomzana Motsepe ngomsebenzakhe omuhle, beyifisela noNomzana Molefe itjhudu lodwa njengoba angena kilomsebenzi oqakathekileko nje.5 IKhabinethi iyasibuka isiQhema seKhrikhethi seliZwe leSewula Afrika ngokudlala kwaso kuhle khulu emidlalweni yeBhegere yePhasi yeKhrikhethi, begodu isifisela itjhudu njengoba ilizwe loke lisisekela nje emidlalweni yaso edlalelwa e-Australia ne-New Zealand nje.6 IKhabinethi ithokoza umdlali wefludi u-Wouter Kellerman othumbe unongorwana i-Grammy Award nge-albhamu ekhambe phambili.
tgt: Ḓuvha ḽa Mmbi dza Zwithavhane li pembelelwa ṅwaha munwe na munwe hu tshi ṱhonifhiwa vhanna na vhafumakadzi vhe vha shumela tshitshavha fhano hayani na mashangoni a nnḓa.3 Khabinethe i ṱuṱuwedza vhatholi vhoṱhe vhe vha tevhela Mulayo wa Ndinganyo ya Matholele u dzhenela Pfufho dza Ndinganyo ya Matholele 2015 phanḓa ha datumu ya musi dzi tshi vala nga ḽa 13 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.Mutambo uyu une wa ḓo farwa nga Khomishini ya Ndinganyo ya Vhutholi, u pfufha vhatholi vhe vha thoma u shumisa maano ane a vhona uri ndinganyo ya matholele na u fhambana, ngeno vha tshi tusa nḓowelo mmbi ya khethululo.4 Minisita wa zwa Vhuendelamashango Vho Derek Hanekom vha do ṋea tshipitshi tsha u vula Meetings Africa une wa ḓo farwa Sentharani ya Buthano ngei Sandton u bva nga dzi 23 u swika dzi 25 Luhuhi 2015 fhasi ha thero: “U bveledza Afurika Roṱhe”.

src: UNomana Kellerman urekhode i-albhamu le, i-Winds of Samsara, nomthiyiingoma we-Indiya u-Ricky Kej, ebathumbise unongorwana lo ngalomsebenzi wokuvuma abawuhlanganyeleko.7 IKhabinethi izwakalisa ukuthokoza kwayo kibo boke abasebenzisi begezi ngokulalela nokuhlonipha isibawo sokuthi baphungule umthamo wegezi abayisebenzisako.
tgt: Izwi ndi ṱano ḽa vhubindudzi ha mabindu mahulwane ḽa Buthano ḽa Birou ya Lushaka ya Afurika Tshipembe, ḽine ḽa kunga vhaṱani vha Afurika na dziṅwe khasiṱama dza mashango a seli.

src: Ihlelo lokulungisa imiraro iSewula Afrika eqalene nayo ngeendaba zegezi linikelwa iqalontanzi eliphezulu kinakho koke.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendelana kha u ri Afurika Tshipembe ḽi vhe ṋemuḓi wa Muṱangano wa Ikonomi wa Ḽifhasi – Afurika, ngei Sentharani ya Buthano ḽa Dzitshaka ire Ḓoroboni ya Kapa u bva nga dzi 3 u swika dzi 5 Fulwi 2015.

src: ISiQhema sokuLuka amaNo esisungulwe yiKhabinethi ngoNobayeni wee-2014, esidoswa phambili liSekela likaMengameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa sisebenzela ukuliphumelelisa ngebelo ihlelo lamaphuzu amahlanu lokulungisa ubujamo bezinto oburarileko ngegezi.
tgt: Thero i ḓo vha “Kale na Zwino: U humbula nga ha vhumatshelo”.

src: Ukuphunyeleliswa Kwamahlelo kahulumende Qakathekileko IKhabinethi ithokozele iSabelo seeMali somNyaka wee-2015 ekusona sizakutjhayela ihlelo lamaphuzu alithoba elethulwe nguMengameli nakethula iKulumo yobuJamo beNarha.
tgt: Khabinethe yo ṱanganedza Mugaganyagwama wa Lushaka wa 2015 une wa ḓo tshimbidza u thomiwa ha nzudzanyo ya mbuno dza ṱahe ye ya ṋetshedzwa nga Muphuresidennde nga tshifhinga tsha musi vha khou amba na lushaka.

src: Lesisabelo seemali sinikela isiqiniseko, ukunzinza kunye nesandla sokuphatha iimali esihlakaniphileko nesiyelelako esifunekako, umnotho weSewula Afrika nawuzakuphumelela ukudlula kilobubudisi okibo njenganje.
tgt: Mugaganyagwama uyu u ṋetshedza fulufhelo, vhudziki na ndaulo ya zwa masheleni yo teaho u fhirisa ikonomi ya Afrika Tshipembe kha heyi nyimele ya ikonomi i konḓaho.

src: IKhabinethi itjho iyabuyelela ukuthi ayafuneka amagadango wezomthelo ethulwe eSabelweni seeMali somNyaka wee-2015 ukusekela ihlelo leemali lomnyaka weemali ozokuthwasa lo.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou ombedzela uri mielo ya muthelo yo ḓivhadzwaho kha Mugaganyagwama wa Lushaka wa 2015 yo tea u tikedza zwa gwama kha ṅwaha u ḓaho.

src: AmaSewula Afrika akhuthazwa bona asebenzisane norhulumende ngomnqopho wokuthundubaza ubujamo bezomnotho obumbi esikibo njenganje, kobanyana umnotho uzokuhluma.2 IKhabinethi iyawubuka umsebenzi omuhle khulu owenziwe liSekela likaMengameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa ngokuphumelelisa kwakhe ikhetho elihle nelilungileko ebelibanjwe e-Lesotho, njengoba bekathunywe yiHlangano yokuThuthukisa imiPhakathi ye-Afrika engeSewula (i-SADC ) ukwenza loyo msebeniz nje.
tgt: MaAfrika Tshipembe a khou ṱuṱuwedzwa u shumisana na muvhuso u lwisana na nyimele ikonomi ya zwino u ṱuṱula u isa phanḓa nyaluwo ya ikonomi.2 Khabinethe i khoḓa mushumo wa vhudzivha wo itwaho nga Muthusa Muphuresidennde Cyril Ramaphosa kha u tshimbidza khetho kwao dzo vhofholowaho ngei Lesotho kha mushumo wawe sa Mutshimbidzi wa Mashango a Mveledziso a Tshipembe ha Afrika (SADC).

src: IKhabinethi iyawubuka nomKhandlu oLuleka ngezeKhetho (i-EAC), neKomitjhini yezeKhetho ye-Lesotho (i-LEC), nebezokuPhepha kunye nabantu be-Lesotho ngokuraga kwabo ikhetho elinokuthula, elikhululekileko nelilungileko.
tgt: Khabinethe i dovha hafhu u khoda Khantsele ya Vhueletshedzi ha Khetho (EAC), Khomishini ya Khetho ya Lesotho (LEC), Mmbi dza Vhutsireledzi na vhathu vha Lesotho kha u fara khetho kwao dzo vhofholowaho, dza mulalo.

src: ISewula Afrika izokusebenzisana norhulumende we-Lesotho osandukukhethwa lo ngomnqopho wokuhlumisa umnotho wamazwe amabili la, newesiPhande esise-Afrika engeSewula kunye neKhonthinenthi yoke.3 IKhabinethi ikuthokozele ukuhlanganyela kweSewula Afrika ekuthokozeleni iLanga leeNyamazana zoMmango lePhasiloke mhlana ama-3 kuNtaka wee-2015.
tgt: Afrika Tshipembe ḽi ḓo shuma na muvhuso muswa wo khethwaho wa Lesotho u bveledza ikonomi ya mashango aya mavhili, Dzingu ḽa Tshipembe ha Afrika na Dzhango ḽoṱhe.3 Khabinethe i tenda na u ṱanganedza u shela mulenzhe ha Afrika Tshipembe kha u pembelela Ḓuvha ḽa Ḽifhasi ḽa Phukha nga ḽa 3 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Ngaphasi kwesandla sikaNgqongqotjhe u-Edna Molewa, iSewula Afrika iragela phambili ngokwakha nokusebenzisa amahlelo avikela ibhoduluko lelizwe newokulwa nomukghwa wokuzuma iimbandana ngaphandle kwemvumo.
tgt: Fhasi ha vhurangaphanḓa ha Minisita Molewa Afrika Tshipembe ḽi khou isa phanḓa u vhea mbekanyo dzine dza tsireledza mupo wa shango na nndwa dzi lwaho na u zwima lu siho mulayoni.

src: Okuphambili kilokhu kubekwa kwe-Green Scorpions eDoyelweni leemPhaphamtjhini leenTjhabatjhaba i-OR Tambo.
tgt: Tsha ndeme kha hezwi ho vha u vhea Green Scorpions ngei Vhukavhamabufho ha dzitshakha ha OR Tambo.

src: Imithetho leyo-ke ngile elandelako: imiThetholawulo yeeMbandana eziseNgozini namkha eziVikelweko, umThethokambiso we-CITES, ukuzunywa kwezinto zemvelo, umThetholawulo wokuFikelela nokwAbelana ngeNzuzo kunye nomThetholawulo we-Alien and Invasive Species.
tgt: Izwi ndi u itela u vhona uri hu tevhelwa Milayo ya Zwivhumbwa ya Tsireledzo kana tshutshedzo, Milayo ya CITES, Bio-prospecting, Milayo ya Tswikelelo na Vhukovha-Mbuelo na Milayo ya Zwivhumbwa zwi sa Ḓivhei na Zwidinaho.

src: Ukusingatha imidlalo le kungavula imisebenzi elinganiselwa ee-11 650, bese kuhlumisa umnotho welizwe lekhethweli ngemali elinganiselwa kumaBhiliyoni ama-Obunye ubuhle obuzakutjhiywa miDlalo le lihlelo lezokuthutha umphakathi elilungelelweko le-Durban, iplani yalo esele ivunyiwe kukunje.
tgt: Afrika Tshipembe ḽo dovha hafhu u shela mulenzhe kha u shumisana na Interpol, nga maanḓa kha Komiti ya Vhueletshedzi na Vhutevhela milayo ya Mupo na Bodo ya Ndangulo, na kha zwigwada zwiraru zwi shumaho na vhugevhenga zwa Interpol zwine zwa vha, tshigwada tshi shumaho na zwa vhugevhenga ha Phukha, tshigwada tshi shumaho na zwa vhugevhenga ha vhureakhovhe na tshigwada tshi shumaho na zwa vhugevhenga ha tshikafhadzo.4 Khabinethe i a ḓivha uri Durban yo dzhenela miṱaṱisano ya u fara Mitambo ya Muṱanganelo wa mashango ya 2022, ye ya rwelwa ṱari ngei London nga ḽa 2 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.U fara mitambo iyi zwi na khonadzeo ya u sika tshivhalo tsha mishumo tshi anganyelwaho kha 11 650 na u khwaṱhisa ikonomi ya shango nga u gaganyela tshelede i linganaho na R20 biḽioni.

src: IinQunto zeKhabinethi eziQakathekileko IKhabinethi ivumele umThethokambiso wokuTjhugulula iHlelo lokuRhatjha ngeThelevitjhini elisetjenziswa njenganje bona liyokuba ngelirhatjha ngokusebenzisa iinkhongozeli zamaza wommoya (ama-Set Top Box namkha ama-STB), elizakuhlathululwa nawugadangiswako bewumenyezelwa umthethokambiso lo.
tgt: Zwiṅwe zwine mitambo ya ḓo ri siela ndi sisteme ya vhuendi ha nnyi na nnyi ho ṱanganelanaho Durban zwine pulane dza hone dzo no ṋewa thendelo.

src: Urhulumende uzokuphakisa ama-STB angaphezulu kweengidi ezihlanu emizini echakileko kodwana enabomabonisakude.
tgt: Tsheo dza ndeme dza Khabinethe.

src: Imizi eyakhe emikhawulweni yelizweli ngiyo ezakuba maqalontanzi nakuphakiswa ama-STB namkha leziinkhongozelimaza.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela Mbekanyamaitele ya Khwiniso ya Mupfuluwo wa Khasho ya Didzhithala hu tshi katelwa na sisteme dza ndangulo kha Set Top Box (STB),dzine dza ḓo ṱalutshedzwa zwavhuḓi musi mbekanyamaitele i tshi ganḓisiwa.

src: Khona duze nje uNgqongqotjhe wezokuThintana uzokumemezela ilanga ekuzakuthoma ukusebenza ngalo ihlelo elitjha, nekuzakucinywa ngalo le-Analogo elingelidala.2 IKhabinethi ivumele umThethomgomo weQhinga lokuSebenza weminyaka emihlanu womTlamo weQhinga lezokuLima, zamaHlathi nezokuThiywa kweenHlambi.
tgt: Muvhuso u ḓo ṋetshedza STB mahala kha miṱa i fhiraho miḽioni ṱhanu dza vhathu vha tambulaho vha re na thelevishini.

src: UmTlamo lo uveza iintjhijilo eziphambili eziqalene namakoro amathathu la, bese uphakamisa iindlela zokulungisa iintjhijilwezo emakorweni amane iKoro yezokuLungisa nokuLinganisa ikoro yezokuhluma nokukhula ngokulingana, ngendlela elungileko neyokuphalisana kuhle, nekoro yokubambelela kwebhoduluko nokulawulwa kwalo.
tgt: Minisita wa zwa Vhudavhidzani vha ḓo ḓivhadza luswayo lwa u rathela kha didzhithala na datumu ya u tsima luswayo lwa Anaḽogo hu si kale.2 Khabinethe yo tendela miṅwaha miṱanu ya Mbekanyamaitele ya Pulane ya Nyito ya Vhulimi, Vhusimamaḓaka na Muhanga wa Maano a Vhufuwakhovhe.

src: Ihlelo lemisebenzeli lizakunande lifakelelwa okutjha qobe ngomnyaka.
tgt: Muhanga uyu u sumbedza khaedu khulwane dzine ha khou ṱanganwa nadzo nga sekithara tharu nahone wo kumedza uri u ḓo dzhenelela fhethu huṋa hune ha vha, u eḓanyisa na u shandukisa nyaluwa i sa dzhii sia na u kona u ṱaṱisana, mupo u bveledzeaho na mavhusele.

src: Nanyana ihlelo lokwakha nokuvuselela lisithi owona mnqopho omkhulu wokwabiwa kwenarha ngobutjha kukutjhugulula isijamiso sezokuLima eSewula Afrika nje, ngakelinye ihlangothi linqophe nokusekela amakoro esikhulume ngawo ngehlapha kobanyana kuzokuhluma umnotho bekuvulwe nemisebenzi.3 IKhabinethi ivumele ukubanjwa kweKhongresi yaQobe mNyaka engeyama-40 yeHlangano yeemBhedlela zamaZwe ngamaZwe ezokubanjelwa e-Durban ngekupheleni komnyaka wee-2016.
tgt: U vhuedzedza mavu ndi tshiṅwe tsha mbekanyo dza muvhuso dze dza ṱuṱuwedza u eḓana, fhedzi u swika zwino a hu athu swikelelwa zwihulu nga nḓila ya u shandukisa.

src: UmKhandlu weemBhedlela weenTjhabatjhaba uyihlangano yeembhedlela nezamaphilo yamazwe ngamazwe ezijameleko, engasebenzeli inzuzo, nengasi yombuso.
tgt: Ngenovho mbekanyo dza mvusuludzo na mveledziso yo sumbedzisa uri nḓivho khulwane ya mbuedzedzo ya ho hu u shandukisa tshivhumbeo tsha Vhulimi ha Afrika Tshipembe.

src: IKhongresi yaqobe mnyaka le inikela bezamaphilo ithuba lokubonisana babelane ngeendlela eziphambili zokwenza imiphumela yokuqalelela zamaphilo bona zibe ngcono.
tgt: I dovha hafhu ya lingedza u tikedza sekithara u itela u alusa ikonomi na u sika mishumo.3 Khabinethe yo tendela Guvhangano ḽa Zwibadela zwa Ḽifhasi ḽa vhu 40 ḽa Mbumbano ya Zwibadela zwa Dzitshakha ine ya ḓo farelwa Durban mafheleloni a ṅwaha wa 2016.

src: IKhabinethi ikhombela ababelethi ukuthi bazibandakanye emakhethweni wokukhethwa kwamalunga wemiKhandlu eLawula iinKolo (ama-SGB ) azokubanjwa kizo zoke iinkolo zombuso ukusukela mhlana asi-6 ukuya nama-28 kuNtaka wee-2015.
tgt: Guvhangano ḽa ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe ḽi ṋetshedza vhashumeli vha zwa mutakalo tshikhala tsha u ṋeana ngona dza mashumele kwao u khwinisa mvelelo dza ndondola mutakalo.4 Khabinethe i ita khuwelelo kha vhabebi u shela mulenzhe kha khetho dza Khorondanguli ya Tshikolo (SGB) dza 2015 dzine dza ḓo farwa zwikoloni zwoṱhe zwa nnyi na nnyi u bva nga ḽa 6 u swika ḽa 28 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Ama-SGB aphumelelisa indima eqakathekileko eyenziwa mphakathi yokulawula iinkolo zekhethu.
tgt: SGB dzi shela mulenzhe kha mveledziso ya muya wa vhune ha tshitshavha ho khwaṱhaho zwikoloni zwashu.

src: Angaphezulu kwee-250 000 amalunga wama-SGB akhethwa qobe ngeminyaka emithathu eenkolweni zekhethu kobanyana azokusebenzela umnqopho munye nofanako, ekungewokuphumelelisa ifundo kobanyana ibe yindaba ehlanganyelwe mphakathi ngokwawo.
tgt: Mashumele guṱe a zwikolo hu tshi katelwa na u swikelela pfunzo zwi anzela u khwinifhadzea musi vhabebi vha tshi shela mulenzhe vhukuma nahone vhe na dzangalelo kha mafhungo a tshikolo.

src: ImiThethomlingwa IKhabinethi ivumele ukudluliselwa ePalamende kwemiThethomlingwa emibili, yomibili etjhugulula umThetho wezabaNtwana womNyaka wee-2005 ( UmThetho Nomboro 38 wee-2005) njengokutjhugululwa kwawo mThetho Nomboro 41 wee-2007.
tgt: Vhalangi vha fhiraho 250 000 vha a nangwa miṅwaha miraru miṅwe na miṅwe u shuma zwikoloni zwashu zwa nnyi na nnyi vho vhumbana u itela ndivho i fanaho, u ita uri pfunzo i vhe fhungo ḽa tshitshavha.

src: Amatjhuguluko la alandelela izahlulelo zekhotho, zona ezithe iindinyana ezithileko zomThetho lo azikhambisani nomThethosisekelo.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u ṋetshedzwa ha milayotibe mivhili, ine yoṱhe i khou khwinisa Mulayo wa Vhana, 2005 (Mulayo nomboro.

src: UmThethomlingwa womNyaka wee-2015 oTjhugulula umThetho wezabaNtwana ( umThethomlingwa wesiGaba sama-75) Amatjhuguluko la amalungana nehlathululo “yemilandu yezomseme”, begodu athomanisa ihlathululo le nomThethomlingwa oTjhugulula umThetho wezobuLelesi(imilandu yezomseme neendaba ezikhambisana nalokho) umThetho Nomboro 32 wee-2007.
tgt: 38 wa 2005) sa zwe wa khwiniswa nga Mulayo 41 wa 2007, Phalamenndeni.

src: Amatjhuguluko la aphathelene nanokuvumela abantwana abalelesileko ukuthi babe nekulumo yokubakhulumela ngaphambi kobana amabizwabo afakwe kuRejista yezokuVikela yeliZweloke.
tgt: Khwiniso dzi khou fhindula tsheo dza khothe, dzine dza sumbedzisa uri zwiṅwe zwiteṅwa zwa Mulayo a zwi tshimbilelani na ndayotewa.

src: Amatjhuguluko aphakanyiswako la abuye godu akhanyise neemfuneko eziqakathekileko zokubeka umntwana ngaphasi kwesandla sokumelusa, abuye godu anikele namanye amakoro wabantwana abangathathwa bakhuliswe ngabanye abantu njengabantwana abambelekelweko.
tgt: Mulayotibe wa Khwiniso wa Vhana, 2015 (tshiteṅwa 75 tsha Mulayotibe)–Khwiniso i amba nga ha ṱhalutshedzo ya “vhukhakhi ha vhudzekani” ya vhu livhanyisa na Mulayo wa Vhugevhenga (vhukhakhi ha vhudzekani na mafhungo a elanaho) Mulayo wa Khwiniso nomboro 32 wa 2007.

src: UmThethomlingwana wesiBili oKhibelelako, womNyaka wee-2015 ( isiGaba sama-76) – unqophe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi boke abantwana bayabuthola ubuhle obunqophe ukuthi benzelwe bona, bakuthole nokuvikeleka kwabo, nokuthi bakhelwe ihlelo elihle lokuqalelela ihlalakuhle yabo emphakathini.
tgt: Khwiniso i dovha hafhu ya shumana na u tendela vhakhakheli vha vhana u ita ṋetshedzo phanḓa ha musi madzina avho a tshi dzheniswa kha Redzhisitara ya Tsireledzo ya Lushaka.

src: Linqophe godu nokubavulela ubujamo obuphephileko abantwana ekutholakala ukuthi badinge itjhejo nokuvikeleka.
tgt: Mulayotibe wa Khwiniso ya Vhana wa Vhuvhili, 2015 (tshiteṅwa 76 tsha Mulayotibe)–ndivho yawo ndi u vhona uri vhana vhoṱhe vha ḓiphina nga tshumelo na mbuelo dzo sedzaho kha u tshimbidza u kona u swikelela ndondolo ya matshilisano na tsireledzo na u sika sisiteme ya matshilisano ya vhulondavhathu ya khwiṋe.

src: UbuJamo beKhabinethi Ngeendaba Ezenzeka Esikhathi Sanje IKhabinethi ikusola ngamagama abukhali ukufahliswa kwemitlolo okungahle kufake ivikeleko lelizwe lekhethweli engozini.
tgt: U dovha hafhu wa lingedza u ṋea mupo wo tsireledzeaho na tsireledzo u itela u vhea vhana vhane vha wanala vha tshi khou ṱoḓa ndondolo na tsireledzo.

src: Nanyana kuyikambiso yamazwe ngamazwe ukwabelana ngeendaba zobuhloli nje, hlangana nazo ekubalwa neendaba zamathuba womnotho naweendaba zokuvikeleka, kodwana kuphambene nomthetho ukufahliswa kwemitlolo okukhe kwabikwa ngakho okuveza imininingwana ye-Ejensi yeVikeleko lomBuso.
tgt: Khabinethe i sasaladza nga nḓila dzoṱhe, u bvukululwa ha maṅwalo ane a nga vhea tsireledzo ya shango fhethu ho vhifhaho.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozela iphenyo elipheleleko le-Ejensi yeVikeleko lomBuso ngendaba le, begodu iqinisekisa amaSewula Afrika ngokuthi i-Ejensi yeVikeleko lomBuso le izasolo itjhotjholoza njalo ngomsebenzi ethunywe wona wokuvikela igama lelizwe lekhethu, izakhamuzi zalo kunye nomthangalasisekelo walo.
tgt: Saizwi i nḓowelo ya dzitshakha uri mashango a kovhane mihumbulo nga ha tsireledzo, u fana na mafhungo a kwamaho mashango oṱhe a tshimbilelanaho na zwikhala zwa ikonomi na mafhungo a tsireledzo, u bvukululwa ha maṅwalo a dodombedzaho mashumele a Zhendedzi ḽa Tsireledzo ḽa Lushaka a zwi mulayoni.

src: IKhabinethi iwutjho iyawubuyelela umlayezo kaNgqongqotjhe wezeVikeleko lomBuso u-David Mahlobo, othi isenzo esinjengalesi sikhisimeza ipumelelo yomsebenzi wokuvikela ilizwe lekhethu nemikhawulo yalo.
tgt: Khabinethe I ṱanganedza ṱhoḓisiso yo fhelelaho ya Zhendedzi ḽa Tsireledzo ḽa Lushaka kha mafhungo aya nahone i dovha hafhu u fulufhedzisa Afrika Tshipembe uri Zhendedzi ḽa Tsireledzo ḽa Lushaka ḽi ḓo isa phanḓa u sedza kha mushumo waḽo wa u tsireledza na vhutsireledzi ha shango zwi kha ngoho, vhadzulapo vhaḽo na themamveledziso.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozela isimemezelo sakwa-Eskom esithi isiGaba sesi-6 sesiPhehligezi i-Medupi siphehle igezi yaso yokuthoma kileveke, ngaleyindlela-ke sabe sithungelelwe isigaba sokuthoma kezisithandathu kilesi siphehligezi.
tgt: Khabinethe i ombedzela mulaedza wa Minisita wa Tsireledzo ya Lushaka, Minisita David Mahlobo, uri vhuḓipfari ho raloho vhu nyadza mashumele a khwine a mushumo wa u tsireledza shango na mikano yaḽo.

src: Ukuthungelelwa kutjho ihlelo la igezi yejenereyidi yesiphehligezi ihlanganiswa khona nethungelelwano legezi lelizweloke.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou ṱanganedza nḓivhadzo nga Eskom uri Yuniti 6 ya Tshiṱitshi tsha Fulufulu tsha Medupi yo bveledza fulufulu ḽa u thoma ino vhege, zwi i itaho yuniti ya u thoma kha dza rathi yo sinkhronaiziwaho.

src: Bonke abantu bakhuthazwa ukuthi basebenzise igezi ngokuyinconcosela, njengoba ngakelinye ihlangothi sisafunana neminye imithombo yegezi nje.
tgt: U sinkhronaiza ndi maitele ane dzhenereitha yo ṱumanywa lwa muḓagasi kha giridi ya fulufulu ya lushaka.

src: IKhabinethi ibuka isibindi, ukuzimisela, ukuzibophelela ngokuncama kunye nokukhuthala kwamadoda nabomma abasebenza bangadinwa ukusindisa ipilo yabantu nokuvikela ipahla ekoniweni, nekuvikeleni ifuyo nemvelo eligugu kithi ebekusahlelwe mililo yommango eKapa.
tgt: Zwenezwi ri tshi khou isa phanḓa na u shuma kha u engedza nḓisedzo ya fulufulu kha giridi ya lushaka, khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo kha tshitshavha u isa phanḓa na u tevhedza maga a u vhulunga muḓagasi.

src: IKhabinethi izwakalisa ukuthokoza kwayo abantu ababe noBuntu, bahlanganyela nombuso ekwakheni iindawo zobuphephelo la kubalekiselwe khona abantu ngobunengi babo njengoba besele bangasenabuyo nje, babaleka umlilokazi obewuvutha uburhangurhangu.
tgt: Zwitshavha zwi ṱuṱuwedzwa u shumisa muḓagasi nga u vhavhalela, ngeno ri khou isa phanḓa na u ḓisa zwiṅwe zwiko zwa fulufulu.3 Khabinethe i fhululedza vhuhali, vhuḓiimiseli, vhuḓikumedzeli na u shumesa ha vhanna na vhafumakadzi vhane vha khou shuma vha sa neti u tsireledza matshilo na u thivhela u tshinyadzwa ha ndaka, zwifuwo na mupo washu wavhuḓi nga mililo yo thomaho ngei Kapa.

src: Ube muhle khulu, bewuyakhuthaza ummoya otjengiswe babantu ebebasebenza ngokuzinikela basiza abantu ebebasahlelwe mlilo kileziindawo la bekutjha khona.4 IKhabinethi isaphatheke kumbi ngokusahlelwa nokukhahlunyezwa kwamaphandle, begodu iyelelisa ngokuthi bomthetho bazasolo bakhona beluse ngelihlo elibukhali eendaweni ezithintekileko, begodu nabaphehli benturhu nezephulamthetho nabo isandla somthetho sizakusebenza ngabo.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱahisa ndivhuho dzayo kha zwitshavha zwe nga muya wa vhuthu, zwa konana na muvhuso u thoma senthara dza ndondolo dza tshitshavha u ṱanganedza avho vhe vha pfuluswa.

src: Indaba yenturhu phezu kwamaphandle kukhulunywa bekubonisanwa ngayo eenjamisweni zikaRhulumende ngokuhlukahluka kwazo.5 IKhabinethi ithokozisa isiQhema seBholo seliZwe, sabaDlali abangaPhasi kwemiNyaka eli-17, Amajimbos, ngokuphakamisa igama leSewula Afrika ngokuphumelela kwesiqhemesi ukuyokungena kumafayinali wePhaliswano leenKutana lomNyaka wee-2015 labaDlali be-Afrika abangaPhasi kwemiNyaka eli-17, eliyokudlalelwa e-Niamey, ese-Niger.
tgt: Muya wa vhashumi vha u ḓiṋetshedza wo sumbedzwaho nga vhathu vhane vha khou thusa zwipondwa zwa mililo ndi muhulu nahone u a ṱuṱuwedza.

src: IKhabinethi iyathokoza ukuthi agcine abuyiswe woke amaSewula Afrika abhubhela ekugirikeni kwekumba yeemvakatjhi yomakho weSondo le-Nigeria, edorobheni le-Lagos, i-Syanagouge Church of All Nations (i-SCOAN) ngegadango lokulekelela ukubuyisa amaSewula Afrika abhubhela kosozizwe, urhulumende utjengisile ukuthi ungurhulumende onesisa noqalelelako.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou dzulela u vhilaedzwa nga ha miṱhaselo kha vhatsinda nahone i eletshedza uri mazhendedzi a zwa mulayo a ḓo isa phanḓa u ḓivhonadza fhethu hoṱhe hu kwameaho, na uri vhaiti vhazwo vha ḓo dzhielwa vhukando ho khwaṱhaho nga mulayo.

src: Imikhumbulo yethu isese nemindeni eyabhujelwako kunye nalabo abalimalako kileso sehlakalo.
tgt: Khakhathi kha vhatsinda i khou tandululwa nga kha zwivhumbeo zwa Muvhuso zwine zwa vha hone.5 Khabinethe i fhululedza tshigwada tsha bola tsha fhasi ha miṅwaha ya 17 tsha Lushaka tsha Afrika Tshipembe, Amajimbos, nga u hulisa shango nge vha swikelela u ḓo tamba mutambo wa Vhugweṋa wa Afrika wa 2015 wa vha miṅwaha ya fhasi ha 17 ngei Niamey, kha ḽa Niger.

src: 5 Iminyanya Ezako UMengameli u-Jacob Zuma ube nekulumo nabekuvulwa iNdlu yabaRholi beNdabuko yeliZweloke ePalamende mhlana ama-5 kuNtaka wee-2015.
tgt: Matambele avho sa vhakundi kha mitambo ya Vhugweṋa ya Vhaswa ya Afrika a vha swikisa uri vha tambe kha Tshiphuga tsha Ḽifhasi tsha FIFA tsha vha miṅwaha ya fhasi ha 17 ngei Chile nga vhuya uno ṅwaha.6 Khabinethe ipfa vhuṱungu nga u fhira fhano shangoni ha muṅwe wa ramuzika wa bvumo wa Afrika Tshipembe Zayn Adam, a ḓivheaho sa muimbi wa phanḓa kha seminala ‘70's outfit Pacific Express’ we buḓo ḽawe ḽa muzika ḽa fhira miṅwaha ya O bulwa khathihi na ḓivhazwakale ya muzika ya Kapa.7 Khabinethe yo takala uri, u ya nga zwiṱaluli zwa vhukuma zwa muvhuso u londaho, ḽiga ḽa mafhelelo ḽa u vhuisa ya zwitumbu zwa vhathu vha Afrika Tshipembe vhe vha lovha tshifhingani tsha u wa ha nnḓu ya vhaeni ya Synagogue Church of All Nation (SCOAN) ngei Lagos ḽo swikelelwa.

src: Ubudlelwana hlangana kwakarhulumende nabarholi bendabuko buqakathekile, nasizakukghona ukwakha imiphakathi yemakhaya emajadu, nesebenza ngeendlela ezilungileko, ukwenzelela ukuthi imiphakathi yemakhaya le izokubambelela.
tgt: Mihumbulo yashu i miṱani ya vhe vha lozwa vhafuniwa vhavho na vhe vha huvhala afho tshiwoni itsho.5 Mitambo ine ya khou ḓa.1 Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma o ḓo amba kha u vulwa ha Nnḓu ya Lushaka ya Vharangaphanḓa vha Sialala ngei Phalamenndeni, Kapa nga ḽa 5 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 (ṋamusi).

src: IKhabinethi ithokozela ukubuyiswa kwamathambo wamaqhawe womzabalazo, u-JB Marks no-Moses Kotane, abangcwatjwa e-Russia eminyakeni ema-42 eyadlulako.
tgt: Vhushaka vhukati ha muvhuso na vharangaphanḓa vha sialala ndi ha ndeme kha u vhona uri ri fhaṱa zwitshavha zwa vhupo ha mahayani vhu nṱhesa, zwi sa eḓanahoi na zwitshavha zwa mahayani zwi bveledzeaho.2 Khabinethe i ṱanganedza u vhuiswa ha masalela a mivhili ya mazhakanḓila a mbofholowo a ḓivheaho Vho JB Marks na Vho Moses Kotane Afrika Tshipembe u bva Russia he a vha o vhulungwa hone miṅwahani ya 42 yo fhiraho.

src: Lababarholi abanezwelo lesizwe, abathathwa njengaboyise lomzabalazo wekululeko nabafaka itjisakalo yomzabalazo kubasekeli bomzabalazo abanjengo-Nelson Mandela, no-Oliver Tambo kunye no-Walter Sisulu, bazokungcwatjwa kwehlandla lesibili ngendlela ekhethekileko umbuso ongcwaba ngayo abantu abakhethekileko.
tgt: Vharangaphanḓa avha, vhane vha dzhiwa sa vhone vhokhotsi vha nndwa ya mbofholowo nahone vho ṱuṱuwedzaho vhahali vha fanaho na Vho Nelson Mandela, Vho Oliver Tambo na Vho Walter Sisulu, vha ḓo vhulungwa lwa tshiofisi nga muvhuso.

src: U-Moses Kotane uzakungcwatjwa kwehlandla lesibili e-Pella, eseTlhagwini Tjingalanga mhlana ali-14 kuNtaka wee-2015, bese kuthi u-JB Marks angcwatjwe e-Ventersdorp, khona eTlhagwini Tjingalanga mhlana ama-22 kuNtaka wee-2015.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma o ṋea ndaela ya uri Fuḽaga dza Lushaka dzi fhefheḓiswe dzo tsitselwa vhukati u bva nga ḽa 9 Ṱhafamuhwe u swikela vhusiku ha 22 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Ukubuyiswa kwabo kuyingcenye yokuzimisela kwakarhulumende ukubuyisa woke amaqhawe angasekho abhubhela kosozizwe.
tgt: Vho Moses Kotane u ḓo vhulungwa hafhu ngei Pella, kha ḽa North West nga ḽa 14 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngeno Vho JB Marks a tshi ḓo vhulungwa hafhu ngei Ventersdorp, kha ḽa North West nga ḽa 22 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Nyakenye kubuyiswe amathambo wombikiindaba wedumo owayelwa nombuso webandlululo u-Nat Nakasa, owabhubhela wabe wangcwatjwa e-New York, e-Amerikha.
tgt: U vhuiswa havho ndi tshipiḓa tsha u ḓiimisela ha muvhuso u vhuisa mivhili ya mazhakanḓila e a lovhela mashangoni a vhatsinda.

src: Yena-ke ungcwatjwe kwehlandla lesibili endaweni la kungcwatjwa khona amaqhawe, i-Heroes Acre, e-Chesterville, ese-Durban.
tgt: Ṅwaha wo fhelaho, ramafhungo we a lwela tshiṱalula Vho Nat Nakasa o vhuiswa u bva New York uri a ḓo vhulungwa hafhu Heroes Acre ngei Chesterville, Durban.3 Khabinethe i ṱanganedza fulo ḽo fhelelaho ḽa u ṱhaṱhuvha na u itwa ndingo dza TB ḽine ḽa ḓo rwelwa ṱari nga Muthusa Muphuresidennde Vho Cyril Ramaphosa nga ḽa 24 Ṱhafamuhwe ḽine ḽa vha Ḓuvha ḽa Ḽifhasi ḽa TB, ngei Tshiṱirikini tsha Dr Kenneth Kaunda kha Vundu ḽa North West – fhasi ha thero ya “U fhelisa dwadze ḽa TB Afrika Tshipembe: U engedza mashumele ashu kha Zwitshavha zwa Ndeme”.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozela ijima elikhulu lokuhlolelwa isiFo sesiFuba (i-TB) elizokusikinyiswa liSekela likaMengameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa mhlana ama-24 kuNtaka wee-2015, mhlazana weLanga lesiFo sesiFuba ePhasini loke, elizokubanjelwa esiYingini i-Dr Kenneth Kaunda eTlhagwini Tjingalanga – ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “ Siqeda isiFo sesiFuba Esele Sirhatjheke neSewula Afrika Yoke Le: Siwusikimelela Phezulu Umphakathi Wekhethu Oqakathekileko.”Lelijima elide, lizakusikimisa woke amaSewula Afrika, khulu khulu lawo ahlala emiphakathini ezonjelezwe ziimayini, iimbotjhwa ezisemajele, kunye namaziko weenkulisa ukuthi ahlolelwe isifo se-TEminyakeni emihlanu edlulileko le kukhanjwe indima ekulu ukuqinisa amaqhinga karhulumende wokulawula isifo se-TB ngokuphakamisa ihlelo lokuhlola ipilo yabantu, khulu khulu ngeJima lokwElulekwa nokuHlolelwa iNgogwana yeNtumbantonga kwesizwe.
tgt: Fulo iḽi ḽa vhutshilo hoṱhe ḽi lugisela na u dzudzanya vhathu vhoṱhe vha Afrika Tshipembe nga maanḓa vha dzulaho zwitshavhani zwa migodini, vho farwaho zwishumiswani zwa vhululamisi na senthara dza mveledziso dza vhana vhaṱuku u asesiwa na u itwa ndingo dza TMiṅwahani miṱanu yo fhiraho ho iteswa zwinzhi u khwaṱhisa maano a muvhuso a ndangulo ya TB nga u engedza u ṱhaṱhuvhiwa na u itwa ndingo nga maanḓa nga kha fulo ḽa u itwa Ndingo na u Eletshedzwa nga ha HIU ṱhaṱhuvhiwa na u itwa ndingo ho dovha hafhu ha khwaṱhisedzwa nga u ḓiswa ha ndingo dza tsedzisiso dzi ṱavhanyaho dza TB na zwidzidzivhadzi zwilwaho na TB.4 Khabinethe i fhululedza vhuḓikumedzi na u ḓiimisela ha vhadededzi vhashu, vhane nga nnḓa havho ro vha ri sa ḓo kona u swikelela zwipikwa zwashu zwinzhi zwa lushaka.

src: Ukuhlolelwa amagulo kubuye kwaphakanyiswa kwaqiniswa nanga kufika kwendlela etja emsinya yokuhlolela i-TB neyokuhlolela umhlobo we-TB obhalela imitjhoga.4 IKhabinethi ibuka ukuncama nokuzibophelela kwabotitjhere bekhethu, ngaphandle kwabo ebesingeze siphumelele ukuphumelelisa iminqopho yethu eminengi yelizwe loke.
tgt: U topoliwa ha Pfufho dza u Funza dza Lushaka hu sedza u shela mulenzhe ha nṱha hune vhadededzi vha ita kha u bveledza shango ḽashu.

src: Ukwenyulwa kwamagama wabotitjhere abangathola AboNongorwana bokuFundisa BeliZweloke, kuyindlela yokuthokoza umsebenzi omuhle okubabazekako owenziwa botitjhere ekuthuthukisweni kwelizwe lekhethu abonongorwanaba bazokunikelwa mhlana ali-7 kuNtaka wee-2015 e-Gallagher Estate, e-Midrand.
tgt: Pfufho dzi ḓo farwa nga ḽa 7 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngei Gallagher Estate, Midrand.

src: UmNyango wezeFundo esiSekelo ngiwo ozokusingatha umnyanya waqobe mnyaka lo, njengendlela yokuthokoza nokuhlonipha abotitjhere abancamileko, nabazibopheleleko, nabakhutheleko, nabenza umsebenzabo ngendlela abantu abafundiselwe umsebenzi benza ngayo.
tgt: Muhasho wa Pfunzo ya Mutheo ndi wone u faraho mushumo uyu u bvulela muṅadzi vhadededzi vha phrofeshenala vho ḓikumedzaho, u ḓiimisela, na u shumesa.5 Minisita wa zwa Maḓi na Vhuthathatshili Vho Nomvula Mokonyane vha ḓo rwela ṱari Vhege ya Maḓi ya Lushaka ngei kwaDukuza kha ḽa KwaZulu-Natal hu re na gomelelo nga ḽa 16 Ṱhangule 2015 fhasi ha thero: “Maḓi Ha Na Tshiimela”.

src: Mhlana ali-16 kuNtaka uNgqongqotjhe wezaManzi nokuKhanjiswa kweSila uNomvula Mokonyane uzokuvula ukutshwaywa kweVeke yaManzi yeliZweloke KwaDukuza KwaZulu-Natala, la kusahlele khona isomiso.
tgt: Vhege ya lushaka iyi iḓo fhela na Ḓuvha ḽa Maḓi ḽa Ḽifhasi nga ḽa 22 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Ummongondaba weVeke yaManzi le uthi: “Akunalitho Elingajamiselela Amanzi.” IVeke yaManzi le iyokuvala ngeLanga laManzi lePhasiloke mhlana ama-22 kuNtaka wee-2015.
tgt: Fulo iḽi ḽi ḓo funza Maafrika Tshipembe nga ha ndeme ya maḓi na ṱhoḓea ya vhulanguli vhu bveledzeaho ha tshiko itshi tshi shaeaho.

src: Ijimeli lizakufundisa amaSewula Afrika ngokuqakatheka kwamanzi nangesidingo sendlela ebambelelako yokulonda amanzi njengoba amthombo wepilo oyindlala nje.
tgt: Khabinethe i humbudza Maafrika Tshipembe uri ri khou tshila kha shango ḽine hu na ṱhahalelo ya maḓi nahone i ita khumbelo uri roṱhe ri a vhulunge nga u lugisa hu bvuḓaho madi na u ita tshanduko dza matshilele dzi sumbaho u ṱalifhela maḓi.6 Swondaha ya ḽa, 08 Ṱhafamuhwe, ndi Ḓuvha ḽa Vhafumadzi ḽa Dzitshakha (IWD) ḽine ḽa shumiswa ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe ḽifhasini ḽoṱhe u bvisela khagala mvelaphanḓa yo itwaho, u ita khuwelelo ya tshanduko na u pembelela nyito dza vhuhali na u ḓiimisela nga vhafumakadzi vhe vha shela mulenzhe kha ḓivhazwakale ya zwitshavha zwavho na mashango.

src: UmNyango wezaboMma ngiwo ozabe udosa phambili ekuthokozeleni iLanga laboMma leenTjhabatjhaba esiKolweni samaBanga aPhezulu iLanga esiseKapa, ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “AmaLungelo WaboMma AmaLungelo WoBuntu: Sisoke siragela phambili iSewula Afrika enganaNturhu.” Ummongondaba lo ukhambisana nommongondaba weHlangano yeenTjhaba eziBumbeneko othi: “Ukulingana KwaboMma Kuyindima Yetuthuko Kibo Boke!”Ummongondaba lo-ke ubuye godu ukhambisane nesimemezelo soBunye be-Afrika okuthi umnyaka wee-2015 “Mnyaka WokuHlomisa AboMma NgaMandla NangeTuthuko YemiNqopho ye-Afrika yomNyaka wee-2063.” ILangeli lizakusetjenziselwa ukusikimisa ihlelo lokuKhulumisana ezingeni likaRhulumende weliZweloke nelokukhulumisana ezingeni laborhulumende beemFunda, elizokuthoma kiyo inyanga le, beliyokuphela ngenyanga kaMgwengweni.
tgt: Muhasho wa Vhafumakadzi u ḓo rangaphanḓa vhuṱambo ha lushaka ha IWD ngei Tshikoloni tsha Nṱha tsha Langa kha ḽa Kapa fhasi ha thero ya ‘Pfanelo dza vhathu ndi pfanelo dza vhafumakadzi: U isa phanḓa roṱhe Afrika Tshipembe ḽi si na khakhathi’.

src: Lokhu-ke kuzakuphendla indlela eya embikweni wobujamo babomma ozakwethulwa nguMengameli mhlana ali-9 kuRhoboyi.
tgt: Thero iyi yo livhanywa na thero ya Vhuthihi ha Dzitshakha ya: U eḓanyiswa ha vhafumakadzi ndi mvelaphanḓa kha roṱhe!

src: IKhabinethi ikhombela iiMbikiindaba zeSewula Afrika ukuthi zingenele iphaliswano lika-2015 leeMbikiindaba zee-SADIlanga lokuvala ukungenela iphaliswaneli kumhlana ama-31 kuNtaka wee-2015, kanti-ke eminye imininingwana ngalokhu ungayithola kubunzinzolwazi bomNyango wezokuThintana, obuthi: www.
tgt: Khwaṱhisedzo ya Mbumbano ya Afurika ya kha ṅwaha wa 2015 sa “Ṅwaha wa u khwaṱhisedzwa ha Vhafumakadzi kha zwa vhubindudzi na vhubveledzi kha Adzhenda ya Afrika ya 2063”.

src: AboNongorwanaba balungelelanisa iinjamiso ezihlelekileko zaborhulumende be-SADC, iinhlangano zomphakathi, amaziko wefundo ephakemeko, iinhlangano zeensebenzi kunye neembikiindaba.
tgt: Zwi isaho kha muvhigo nga ha maimo a vhafumakadzi ane a ḓo rwelwa ṱari nga Muphuresidennde nga ḽa 9 Ṱhangule.7 Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo kha Nyanḓadzamafhungo ya Afrika Tshipembe u dzhenela muṱaṱisano wa Pfufho dza SADC dza Nyanḓadzamafhungo 2015.

src: Ngalokhu-ke kukhuthazeka ukulungelelana nokusebenzisana esifundeni se-SADC ngokukhuthaza iimbikiindaba ukuthi zirhatjhe iindaba zamazwe amalunga walesisiphande se-SADIphaliswaneli libuye libe nabonongorwana bezaManzi, bona abaqalelela iindaba ezikhuthaza ukuLawulwa kwaManzi okuLungelelweko esiphandeni se-SADC.6 Ukuqatjhwa Koke ukuqatjhwa kuzakulawulwa kufakazeleka kweencwadi zefundo ezikhambisana nomsebenzi umuntu aqatjhelwa wona kunye nokuhlanjululwa kwegama lomuntu okufaneleko.
tgt: Datumu ya u vala ndi 31 ḽa Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 nahone mafhungo manzhi a hone kha webusaithi www.

src: Ukuhlongakala kukaNgoqngqotjhe U-Ohm Collins Chabane.
tgt: U lovha ha Minisiṱa Vho Ohm Collins Chabane.

src: IKhabinethi izwe ubuhlungu ngokuhlongakala ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwakaNgqongqotjhe u-Chabane nabavikeli bakhe, uSayijeni Lesiba Samuel Sekele no-Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, abahlongakalele engozini yomodoro eyibangamatlhuwo ngoSondarha mhlana ali-15 kuNtaka wee-2015.Urhulumende nabantu beSewula Afrika bazakuhlala basikhumbula lesisebenzi sabantu ebesolo sizibophelele emsebenzini wokwakha iSewula Afrika etja, bekwaba sekupheleni kwamalanga waso wokuphila.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱungufhadzwa nga u fhira fhano shangoni hu so ngo lavhelelwaho ha Minisiṱa Vho Chabane na vhatsireledzi vhavho, Vho sedzheni Lesiba Samuel Sekele na Vho sedzheni Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, vhe vha lovha nga khombo ya moḓoro nga Swondaha, ya ḽa 15 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Njengelunga leKhabinethi, uNgqongqotjhe lo wangaphambilini wezabaSebenzi bakaRhulumende nokuPhatha ubekwe ngomGqibelo ngomhlaka 21 kuNtaka ka-2015 ngomNgcwabo weemPhathimandla zomBuso weKoro 1 (i-Official Funeral Category 1.)
tgt: Muvhuso na vhathu vha Afurika Tshipembe ri ḓo ṱulutshelwa u shela mulenzhe ha mushumeli wa vhathu we a ḓikumedzela u fhaṱa Afurika Tshipembe ḽa khwine u swika a tshi WEBTOKEN muraḓo wa Khorondangi, munna wa vhane Minisiṱa wa Muhasho wa Tshumelo ya Tshitshavha na Ndaulo vha ḓo ṋetshedzwa Mbulungo ya Tshiofisi ya Khethekanyo Mushumo wa mbulungo u ḓo farwa Mugivhela, wa ḽa 21 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngei muvhunduni wa HaXikundu kha ḽa Malamulele, ngei Limpopo.

src: Ubekwe e-Xikundu, Kwa-Malamulele, e-Limpopo.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhirisela ndiliso dzayo kha miṱa na dzikhonani dza munna wa vhane Minisiṱa na vhatsireledzi vhavho vhavhili.

src: UkuPhunyeleliswa kwamaHlelo kaRhulumende aQakathekileko UMengameli u-Jacob Zuma uzokudosa phambili imigidingo yesiteyitjhi yeminyaka ema-50 yokurhubhulula ngenyukliya, i-SAFARI-1, ephethwe yihlangano elawula zamandla- i-National Energy Regulator of South Affrica (i-Nersa), ePhelindaba, esiphandeni sePitori.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma vha ḓo ranga phanḓa u pembelela anivesari ya vhu 50 ya Afurika Tshipembe ya nuclear research reactor SAFARI-1 i tshimbidzwaho nga Ndangulo ya Fulufulu ya Lushaka ya Afurika Tshipembe (NERSA) ngei Pelindaba tsini na Pretoria.

src: Solo sathoma ukusebenza mhlana ali-18 kuNtaka wee-1965, lesisiteyitjhi, ekusona esingesikhulu esiveza imithi yokwelapha nama-elementi wemabubulweni khona lapha ekhethu nemazweni ngamazwe, sesithole abonongorwana abanengi nokusekelwa mamazwe ngamazwe.
tgt: U bva tshe ya thoma u shuma nga ḽa 18 Ṱhafamuhwe 1965, riekhitha iyi, ine ya vha yone khulwane i bveledzaho mishonga na industrial isotopes u itela tshumiso ya fhano hayani na dzitshakha, yo ṱanganedza miṅene minzhi na u akhiredithiwa nga dzitshakha.

src: Lesisiteyitjhi senyukliya senze nalitho likhulu ekurhubhululeni ngenyukliya, nakezetuthuko nezefundo, sabeka iSewula Afrika ezingeni eliphambili kezesayensi.
tgt: Riekitha iyi yo dovha hafhu ya shela mulenzhe kha ṱhoḓisiso ya nyukiḽia, mveledziso na pfunzo nahone ya vhea Afurika Tshipembe phanḓa kha u bvelaphanḓa ha saintifiki.

src: IKhabinethi ikhombela amaSewula Afrika ukuthi aphakamise amagama wabantu abafanelwe kusebenza eKomitjhinini yezokuHlela yeliZwe leSewula Afrika, ngaphambi kwelanga lokuvala ukwamuleka iimphakamiso zamabizo lawo elimhlana ali-10 kuSihlabantangana wee-2015.IKomitjhini etja le izokuqalelela ukweluleka nokubonisa urhulumende ngeendlela zokuwuphumelelisa ngcono khulu umTlamo wokuThuthukiswa kweliZweloke (i-NDP).
tgt: Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo kha Maafurika Tshipembe u nanga vhathu vho teaho u shuma kha Khomishini ya Vhupulani ya Lushaka phanḓa ha musi i tshi vala nga ḽa 10 Lambamai 2015.

src: Ukudlula lapho, izakubuye godu ilekelele ekwakheni imitlamo ephelele ngemininingwana emakorweni akhethiweko afuna ukuqalelelwa ngokuthuthukisa umnotho, nokutjhugulula umnotho ngendlela ebonakalako, nangetuthuko ebambelelako.
tgt: Hu tshi ḓadziswa kha zwenezwo, i ḓo dovha hafhu u thusa u bveledza zwidodombedzwa zwa pulani idzo kha sekithara dzo nangwaho dzine dza ṱoḓa u dzhielwa nzhele uri dzi tshimbidze nyaluwo ya ikonomi, u shandukisa ikonomi na mveledziso i bveledzeaho.

src: Okhunye okumalungana nokuphakanyiswa kwamagama wabantu abangafakwa kilekomitjhini itholakala ku: WEBTOKEIinQunto zeKhabinethi eziQakathekileko IKhabinethi ivumele ukudluliselwa ePalamende komThethomlingwa wokuTjhugululwa komThetho wamaRoma eKhotho yezoBulelesi yeenTjhabatjhaba kobanyana uzokufakazelwa.
tgt: Vha tshi ṱoḓa maṅwe mafhungo manzhi nga ha maitele a kunangele a hone kha: www.

src: UbuJamo beKhabinethi Ngeendaba Ezenzeka Esikhathini Sanje IKhabinethi izitjhejile iimpendulo ngeemphakamiso zamva nje zokwabiwa kwemikhawulo, begodu iyavuma ukuthi ikulumopikiswano enamandla iyingcenye engahlukanisekiko nentando yenengi yekhethu.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u kumedza Phalamenndeni nga ha Khwiniso kha Milayo ya Rome ya Khothe ya Vhugevhenga ya Dzitshakha u itela thendelano.

src: Njengoba kunabomasipaladi abadosa emhlweni ukwethulela izakhamuzi zabo izenzelwa zomphakathi, begodu solo abanzinzi kuhle ngenca yokutlhayelelwa ziimali nalilwazi lokuphatha nokulawula kuhle nje, imikhawulo yabomasipaladi ihlala inande ibuyekezwa.
tgt: Khwiniso dzi katela ṱhalutshedzo ya vhugevhenga ha u levha na milayo ya u engedza i katelaho vhugevhenga ha nndwa kha Milayo ya Rome ye ya ṱanganedzwa nga Buthano ḽa Mahoro a Dzitshakha (ngei Kampala, Uganda nga ḽa 11 Fulwi 2010).Thendelano ya u khwiniswa uhu ha Milayo ya Rome nga Afurika Tshipembe zwi sumbedza u ḓinetshedzela ha muvhuso u lwa na vhugevhenga kha matshilo a vhathu na vhugevhenga ha u levha musi ho itwa ngomu kana nnḓa ha shango ḽashu.

src: Amatjhuguluko aphakanyiswako la athoma ngokucozululwa yiBhodi yemiKhawulo kaMasipaladi (i-MDB), yona ethunywe umsebenzi wokusika imikhawulo yabomasipaladi, ngokomThetho wokuSikwa kwemiKhawulo yaboMasipaladi womNyaka we-1998 (umThetho Nomboro 27 womNyaka we-1998 ), kunye nomThethosisekelo weRiphabhligi yeSewula Afrika we-1996.
tgt: Vhuimo ha Khabinethe kha Mafhungo a zwino.

src: Njengesijamiso esizijameleko, i-MDM le isebenza ikhambe ngekambiso etjhatjhalazi ebonwa mumuntu woke, nangokubonisana nabo boke abafaneleko.
tgt: Khabinethe i dzhiela nzhele phindulo kha mafhungo a zwino a mukumedzo wa mikaṋo na u ṱanganedza uri khaseledzo nga hazwo ndi tshipiḓa tsha ndeme tsha dimokirasi yashu.

src: IKhabinethi ikhuthaza imiphakathi ukuthi ibe nelizwi kilekambiso.
tgt: Vhunga hu na miṅwe mimasipala ine ya khou kundelwa kha nḓisedzo ya tshumelo nahone a i khou bveledzea nga mulandu wa ṱhahelelo ya masheleni na mavhusele a si avhuḓi, mikaṋo ya mimasipala i fanela u dzulela u sedzuluswa.

src: Umsebenzi weBhodi yemiKhawulo uyingcenye engahlukaniko nekambiso kaRhulumende yokuBuyela emiRajini (i-Back to Basics) ngomnqopho wokuqinisekisa ukwenzelwa kwabantu izenzelwa ngendlela engcono.
tgt: Tshanduko dzo kumedzwaho dzi thoma dza sedzwa nga Bodo ya Mikaṋo ya Masipala (MDB), ine mushumo wayo ndi u sedza mikaṋo ya mimasipala u ya nga ha Mivhuso Yapo: Mulayo wa Mikaṋo wa Masipala, wa 1998 (Mulayo 27 wa 1998) na Ndayotewa ya Riphabuḽiki ya Afurika Tshipembe ya WEBTOKEN dzangano ḽo ḓiimelaho, maitele a MDB a khagala nahone a shumisa vhukwamani.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozise iSekela likaMengameli ngomsebenzi awenzileko owenze ukuthi libe yipumelelo ikhetho le-Lesotho.
tgt: Khabinethe i sasaladza u shumiswa ha mimatsho ya migwalabo i re na khakhathi sa yone nḓila ya u tandulula khuḓano dza mikaṋo.

src: Iyawuthokoza godu nomsebenzi owenziwe yiHlangano yokuThuthukisa imiPhakathi yamaZwe ase-Afrika engeSewula (i-SADC) ngokuvula kwayo indlela yokuletha ukuthula nokuphumelelisa ukukhethwa kwakarhulumende omutjha.
tgt: Mushumo wa MDB ndi tshipiḓa tsha ndeme tsha muvhuso kha maele awo a u Vhuelela Murahu kha zwa Ndeme (Back to Basics) u itela u khwinisa nḓisedzo ya tshumelo zwitshavhani.

src: IKhabinethi ibuyelele yezwakalisa ukuzibophelela kweSewula Afrika ngokuragela phambili ngokusebenzisana ne-Lesotho kobanyana buzokuphakama buqine ngamandla ubudlelwana esele vele bukhona hlangana kwamazwe amabili la, ngokuqalelela ukuqiniswa komnotho nokusebenzisana kezomnotho okuzakwenza ipilo yabantu ibe ngcono.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhululedza Vhasuthu kha u fhirisela maanḓa hu so ngo dinaho nahone i khou vha humbela uri vha shumisane u itela mulalo na mveledziso ya ikonomi.

src: ISekela likaMengameli u-Ramaphosa bekaye emnyanyeni wokuthokozela imiNyaka ema-25 i-Namibia yathola iKululeko, la bekwethulwa esitjhabeni noMengameli u-Hage Geingob e-Windhoek mhlana ama-21 kuNtaka wee-2015.
tgt: Khabinethe i dovha hafhu ya fhululedza Phuraimi Minisiṱa muswa wa Muvhuso wa Lesotho, Muṱhomphei Vho Pakalitha Mosisili kha u nangwa na u rwelwa ṱari havho he ha itea nga Ḽavhuvhili, ḽa 17 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015, he ha swika na Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma na Muthusa Muphuresidennde Vho Cryil Ramaphosa.

src: IKhabinethi ibuka i-Namibia ngokuhlanganisa kwayo imiNyaka ema-25 yeKululeko, nangokuphumelela kwakaMengameli Geingob ukuthatha isihlalo sobengameli unguMengameli wesithathu we-Namibia.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhululedza Muthusa Muphuresidennde kha mushumo we vha u ita uri hu vhe na khetho dzavhuḓi kha Muvhuso wa Lesotho.

src: UMengameli Zuma uzokuvakatjhelwa nguMengameli we-Zimbabwe u-Robert Mugabe ukusukela mhlana abu-8 ukuya nakali-9 kuSihlabantangana wee-2015 ePitori.
tgt: I dovha hafhu ya ṱanganedza mushumo wo itwaho nga Tshitshavha tsha Mveledziso tsha Tshipembe ha Afurika kha u tshimbidza muya wa mulalo na khetho dza muvhuso muswa.

src: Lelivakatjho-ke lizakugcina ngomHlangano wezamaBhizinisi ozakubanjwa mhlana ali-9 kuSihlabantangana wee-2015 lomhlangano-ke unqophe ukuphakamisa ubudlelwana bokurhwebelana nebamasiso.
tgt: Khabinethe i khwaṱhisedza u ḓiṋetshedzela ha Afurika Tshipembe u bvela phanḓa u shumisana na Muvhuso wa Lesotho u isa phanḓa u khwaṱhisa vhushaka vhu re hone nga u sedzesa kha u khwaṱhisa ikonomi na nyanḓano ya matshilisano ine ya ḓo swikisa kha u khwinifhadza matshilo a vhathu.

src: UMengameli Zuma mhlana ali-19 kuNtaka wee-2015 uzokuhloma ukusebenza kweentimela ezima-95 ePitori leziintimela-ke zakhiwe njengengcenye yehlelo le-Transnet lamasiso, lamaBhiliyoni ama-R300, ngomnqopho wokuvuselela umthangalasisekelo wezokuthutha.
tgt: Muthusa Muphuresidennde Vho Ramaphosa vha ḓo ya kha Anivesari ya vhu 25 ya Vhuḓivhusi ha Riphabuliki ya Namibia, hu tshi katelwa na u rwelwa ṱari ha Muphuresidennde Vho Hage Geingob ngei Windhoek nga ḽa 21 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Ngesikhathi sehlelo lamasisweli, minengi imisebenzi emitjha ezakuvuleka, ngalokho-ke amabhizinisi wekhethwapha asethubeni lokuzuza ngemisebenzi le, nangokuthuthukiswa kwamakghonofundwa nangokudluliswa kwethekhnoloji.
tgt: Khabinethe i khoḓa Namibia kha u pembelela haḽo Silver Jubilee na Muphuresidennde Vho Geingob kha u vha Muphuresidennde wa vhuraru wa Namibia.

src: Iintimela ezitjezi zizokulamula umraro wokusalela emva kwehlelo lokuthutha ngesiporo, zilekelele nokulenza lisebenze ngcono ihlelo lekhethu lokuthutha ngeentimela.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo vha ṋemuṱa musi hu tshi dala Muphuresidennde wa Zimbabwe Vho Robert Mugabe u bva nga ḽa 8 u ya kha ḽa 9 Lambamai 2015 ngei Pretoria.

src: Ukuhlonywa nokuthoma ukusebenza kweentimelezi kutjengisa nokutjhuguluka kwePhiko lezobuNjiniyera lakwa-Transnet libe mkhandi wekuthomeni weentimela ezima-85 ezikhandwe ezikweni leentimela elise-Koedoespoort ePitori.
tgt: Madalo a ḓo ḓisa mveledziso ya nṱha kha Foramu ya Vhubindudzi ya Afurika Tshipembe na Zimbabwe yo vhekanyelwaho ḽa 9 Lambamai 2015, ine tshipikwa tshayo ndi u engedza vhubindudzi na u zwala masheleni.

src: UMengameli Zuma uzokuvula Indaba Yabosomabubulo Abanzima ezokubanjwa ukusukela mhlana ama-25 ukuya nakama-26 kuNtaka wee-2015 e-Gallagher Convention Centre, e-Midrand, njengengcenye yehlelo urhulumende azibophelele ngalo ukuthuthukisa abosomabubulo abanzima elizweni lekhethweli.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo rwela ṱari zwidimela zwa 95 nga ḽa 19 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngei Pretoria zwe zwa fhaṱwa sa tshipiḓa tsha Mbekanyamushumo ya R300 biḽioni ya mbulungo ya masheleni ya Transnet ya u vusuludza themamveledziso ya vhuhwalathundu ya shango.

src: I-NMA izakuveza ubunjalo baborhulumende beendawo eminyakeni eli-15 edlulileko le, ibonisane ngamaqhinga wokulwa nomraro wokubhalelwa kwezenzelwa ukufika ebantwini namkha wokutlhayela kwazo, ibonisane nangokwakhiwa kwamandla wokuphumelelisa umsebenzi, ibonisane nangobukhohlakali kunye nangeendaba eziphathelene nokusikwa kwemikhawulo yabomasipaladi ngobutjha.
tgt: Nga tshifhinga tsha mbekanyamushumo ya mbulungo ya masheleni hu ḓo sikwa tshivhalo tsha mishumo miswa nahone vhubindudzi hapo vhu nga kona u vhuelwa nga u shumisa zwithu zwapo, u bveledzisa zwikili na u fhirisela thekinoḽodzhi.

src: Umhlangano lo uzakubanjwa ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “Iminyaka Eli-15 yaboRhulumende beeNdawo beNtando yeNengi - Silungelelanisa Besinabise iNtando yeNengi yaboRhulumende beeNdawo Enamandla, neThuthukisako neMalungana NabaNtu”.
tgt: Zwidimela zwiswa zwi ḓo thusa sisiṱeme ya vhuendi ha zwiporoni shangoni ḽashu nahone zwi ḓo thusa u khwinifhadza mveledziso na mashumele a vhuṱumani ha vhuendi ha zwiporoni.

src: AmaSewula Afrika agidinge iLanga lamaLungelo wobuNtu mhlana ama-21 kuNtaka wee-2015 eTinarha, ePumalanga Kapa, ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “Sigidinga umTlolo weSivumelwana seKululeko, siThokozela amaLungelo wobuNtu aLinganako Kibo Boke abaNtu”.
tgt: U rwela ṱari hu dovha hafhu ha sumbedza u kwiniswa ha inzhiniariṅi ya Transnet uri i vhe yo fhelelaho ya vhabveledzi vha zwishumiswa zwa vhukuma vhunga 85 wa zwidimela zwo bveledzwa ngei Koedoespoort, tsini na Pretoria.

src: Iminyanya le ivulela amaSewula Afrika woke ithuba lokukhumbula ukuzinikela okwaphekelela umzabalazo wentando yenengi kunye nokuzinikela kwethu ekuphakamiseni amalungelo wobuntu njengoba avikeleke emThethwenisisekelo.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo vula Black Industrialists Indaba ine ya ḓo farwa u bva nga ḽa 25 u ya kha ḽa 26 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngei Gallagher Convention Centre, Midrand, sa tshipiḓa tsha vhuḓiṋetshedzeli ha muvhuso ha u bveledza nḓowetshumo ya vharema shangoni ḽashu.

src: IKhabinethi ikhombela amaSewula Afrika ukuthi agidinge lelilanga eliqakathekileko ngokukhwezelela ukusebenzisana ngokubambana kwabantu nangokwakhisana isizwe.
tgt: Guvhangano ḽi ḓo bveledza mufhindulano vhukati ha sekithara ya phuraivethe na ya tshitshavha u itela u khwinisa nḓowetshumo ya vharema, na u khwinisa u fhaṱulula ikonomi uri i swikelele nyaluwo nyangaredzi.

src: Njengengcenye yeNyanga yamaLungelo woBuntu, iinkulumiswano zomphakathi zizakubanjwa kizo zoke iimfunda ngomnqopho wokuphakamisa ukusebenzisana hlangana nemiphakathi ehlukahlukeneko.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo amba na Buthano ḽa Miraḓo ḽa Lushaka (NMA) ḽa Dzangano ḽa Muvhuso Wapo ḽa Afurika Tshipembe, ḽine ḽa ḓo farwa ngei Gallagher Convention Centre, Midrand u bva nga ḽa 24 u ya kha ḽa 26 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: Lokhu kuzakugcina ngomHlangano omkhulu wokuBuyisa umBiko newokuBeka iLihlo ozokubanjwa mhlana ama-30 kuNtaka wee-2015 eBhayi.
tgt: NMA ḽi ḓo bvisela khagala nyimele ya muvhuso wapo nga murahu ha miṅwaha ya 15 nahone ha haseledzwa maano a u tandulula zwavhuḓi nḓisedzo ya tshumelo, vhashumi vho eḓanaho, tshanḓa nguvhoni na mafhungo a kwamaho mikaṋo ya mimasipala.

src: UmNyango wezokuThuthukiswa komPhakathi uzokubamba umHlangano weNdaba Yemisebenzi Yomphakathi ukusukela mhlana ama-24 ukuya nakama-26 kuNtaka e-Durban ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “Sivuselela umSebenzi wokuba nguNohlalakuhle eSewula Afrika.” Indaba le izokwakha iimphakamiso namahlelo wokulungisa imiraro enamaqaphazela emsebenzini wokuba nguNohlalakuhle, bese kuthonyaniswa umsebenzi othunywe iphiko lezemisebenzi yomphakathi kobanyana lizokusekela ihlelo lombuso lokutjhugulula ngendlela ebonakalako iindaba zomnotho wokuhlaliseka kuhle komphakathi.
tgt: Buthano ḽi ḓo farwa fhasi ha thero: “Miṅwaha ya 15 ya Muvhuso Wapo wa Dimokirasi – Ṱhanganyiso na Khwaṱhisedzo i Vhonalaho, Kubveledzisele na Dimokirasi Yapo i Ḓisendekaho nga Vhathu”.

src: Ukuphumelelisa lokhu, umNyango lo uvule ihlelo lomfundalize elizakufundisa abafundi abafundela umsebenzi wokuba boNohlalakuhle emayunivesithi.
tgt: Maafurika Tshipembe a ḓo pembelela vhuṱambo ha Ḓuvha ḽa Pfanelo dza Vhathu ḽa lushaka nga ḽa 21 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngei Uitenhage, Eastern Cape fhasi ha thero: “U pembelela Thendelanomviswa ya Mbofholowo, U ḓifhelwa nga Pfanelo dza Vhathu Vhoṱhe dzi Eḓanaho”.

src: UmNyango wezokuThuthukiswa komPhakathi uzakubuye ubambe iKhonferensi yesiBili yokuCitha ubuKhohlakali nobuKirikitjani bokuKhwabanisa ukusukela mhlana ama-30 ukuyokufika nakama-31 kuNtaka wee-2015, e-St. George Hotel, e-Centurion, ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “ Siqinisekisa amaLungelo wobuNtu Kibo Boke abaNtu ngeHlelo lomRholo wemBusweni elinganabuKirikitjani bokuKhwabanisa.” Ikhonfrensi le izokuhlola ilinganise lamagadango wanje wokucitha ubukhohlakali ehlelweni lemirholo embusweni.
tgt: Mishumo heyi i ḓo ṋea Maafurika Tshipembe vhoṱhe luvhanḓe lwa u humbula vhuḓikumedzeli he ha tshimbila na nndwa ya dimokirasi na u ḓiṋetshedzela hashu u isa phanḓa pfanelo dza vhathu sa zwe zwa kuvhatedzwa nga Ndayotewa.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozela iphaliswana lokuvula le-Basketball le-Four Nations Challenge eliyokudlalelwa e-Wembley Stadium eJwanisbhege ukusukela mhlana ali-19 ukuyokufika nakama-22 kuNtaka wee-2015.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo kha Maafurika Tshipembe vhoṱhe u pembelela heḽi ḓuvha ḽa ndeme nga u bveledza vhuthihi ha tshitshavha nga huhulu na u fhaṱa lushaka.

src: Leliphaliswana-ke lihlanganisa iinqhema zamadoda amakhulu zeSewula Afrika, ne-Nigeria, ne-Mozambique, ne-Kenya, ephaliswaneni ekuqalwe ukuthi libe qobe mnyaka.
tgt: Sa tshipiḓa tsha Ṅwedzi wa Pfanelo dza Vhathu, nyambedzano zwitshavhani dzi ḓo farwa mavunḓuni oṱhe u bveledza tshumisano vhukati ha zwitshavha zwo fhambanaho.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozisa isiqhema sekhethu sekhrikhethi, esikhambe sabe sayokufika emdlalweni wangaphambi kowokugcina ngokuthumba ngamawikhethi alithoba sibetha isiqhema se-Sri Lanka emdlalweni wabo weBhigiri yePhasi.
tgt: Izwi zwi ḓo fhaṱa kha Samithi ya Vhuṱoli na Vhuvhigela murahu ya Vhuthihi ha Tshitshavha ha Lushaka vhu ne ha ḓo farwa nga ḽa 30 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngei Port Elizabeth.

src: Isiqhemesi nombanduli waso sibafisela itjhudu njengobanyana basaya phambili nje ngemidlalo kileliphaliswana.
tgt: Muhasho wa Mveledziso ya Tshitshavha u ḓo vha ṋemuṱa wa Guvhangano ḽa Vhashumelavhapo ḽa Lushaka u bva nga ḽa 24 u ya kha ḽa 26 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015 ngei Sentharani ya Miṱangano ya Dzitshakha ngei Durban fhasi ha thero: “U vusuludza mushumo wa vhashumelavhapo Afurika Tshipembe”.Guvhangano ḽi ḓo bveledza makumedzwa na u dzhenelela kha u tandulula mafhungo ane a vha na masiandoitwa kha mushumo wa vhashumelavhapo na u livhanya u bveledziswa ha buḓo u tikedza khwiniso ya ikonomi na matshilisano ya muvhuso.

src: UkuqatjhwaZoke iinkhundla zomsebenzi ezitholelwe iimphathimandla zilawulwa mibandela yokufakazelwa kweencwadi zefundo ezifuneka eenkhundlenezo kunye nokuhlanjululwa okukhambisana nemisebenzi yaleziinkhundla:.
tgt: U swikelela izwi, muhasho wo thoma mbekanyamushumo ya vhagudi u lambedza vhagudi vhane vha khou gudela vhushumelavhapo dziyunivesithi.

src: Tintswalo Annah Nana Makhubele (USihlalo)b. UMm uLindelwa Mbanjwa (ISekela likaSihlalo)c. UNom Pumezo Malik Mpumelelo Jonasd.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱanganedza u farwa ha Muṱaṱisano wa u Thoma wa Basiketebola wa Tshaka Nṋa une wa ḓo vha hone ngei Luvhanḓeni lwa Wembley, ngei Johannesburg u bva nga ḽa 19 u ya kha ḽa 22 Ṱhafamuhwe 2015.

src: UMm uMaleho Margaret Nkomoe.
tgt: Izwi zwi kuvhanganya thimu khulwane dza vhanna fhethu huthihi dzine dza vha Afurika Tshipembe, Nigeria, Mozambique na Kenya kha zwine zwa khou lavhelelwa u vha vhuṱambo ha ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe.

src: Tumai Murombo, kunye no-f. Nom.
tgt: Ri tamela tshigwada na Mugudisi watsho mashudu zwenezwi vha tshi khou bvela phanḓa na thonamennde.

src: 1.Ukusahlelwa Kwamaphandle Umlandelande Kwamhlaphanje.1 IKhabinethi izisola ngamagama abukhali izenzo zenturhu phezu kwamaphandle ezenzeke mhlaphanje.
tgt: U ṱhaselwa ha vhabvannḓa hune ha khou itea zwino.1 Khabinethe i khou lwa na khakhathi dza zwino dzine dza khou itelwa vhabvannḓa.

src: Njenganje iKhabinethi ithanda ukududuza bemakhabo balabo ababhubhele kilenturhu, ibafisele nokululama kwamsinya labo abalimeleko.
tgt: Zwazwino, Khabinethe i tama u livhisa ndiliso kha miṱa ya avho vho lovhelwaho nga miraḓo ya miṱa yavho na u tamela mashudu avho vho huvhalaho uri vha ṱavhanye u fhola.

src: Akunazinga lokusilingeka nokuthukuthela elingenza lokhu kusahlelwa nokwetjelwa kweentolo zamaphandle kube yinto elungileko.
tgt: Ahuna tshileme tsha nḓaḓo kana u dinalea zwine zwa nga dzikisa u ṱhaselwa uhu na u tshinyadzwa ha mavhengele.

src: Kunobanyana ibe nento eyilungisako, ininda ngehlazo igama lelizwe lekhethu, njengoba inturhu phela iphikisana nesisekelo sentando yenengi yekhethu.2 ISewula Afrika yalwisa ubukoloni nomBuso weBandlululo, ilekelelwa babantu bekhethu bamanye amazwe we-Afrika kobanyana boke abantu enarheni yehlanganisela yamazwe we-Afrika bazokuhlonitjhwa babe baphathwe ngesithunzi.
tgt: Musi hu tshi khou dzhielwa nṱha mbilaelo dzi bvaho kha zwitshavha, khakhathi yo livhanywaho kha muṅwe muthu ai tandululi thaidzo idzi.

src: Umphumela wokusahlelwa kwamaphandle uzakuba namaqaphazela azakuba mthelela omumbi emnothweni wekhethu, nekuhlalisaneni kwethu nebudlelwaneni bethu bezepolotiki namanye amazwe wenarhakazi ye-Afrika kunye nephasi loke.
tgt: Izwi zwi sumbedza zwi si zwavhuḓi kha rine vhathu, nga u ita zwi lwisanaho na mutheo wa demokirasi yashu.

src: Iinkhamphani zeSewula Afrika ezinamabhizinisi aphumelelako enarhakazini ye-Afrika, ezilekelela ilizwe lekhethu ukungenisa imali ngaleyindlela kudzimelele umnotho wekhethu, nazo kungenzeka zithelwe maqaphazela anjalo.
tgt: Afurika Tshipembe ḽo lwa na vhukoḽoni na Khethululo kha maAfurika hu u itela uri vhathu vhoṱhe kha dzhango ḽashu vha ṱhonifhiwe na u vha na tshirunzi.2 Masiandoitwa a khakhathi idzi a nga ḓisa zwi si zwavhuḓi kha ikonomi, matshilisano na vhushaka hashu kha dzhango na shango.

src: Mhlaphanje abavumi beSewula Afrika ebekufanele bayokutjengisa ikghono labo emazweni wangaphandle, abanjenge-BigNuz obekazilungiselele ukuya e-Zimbabwe, u-Kelly Khumalo kunye no-Casper ebekufanele bayokuvuma e-London bagcine bakatelelekile ukuthi bawatshwilise amakhonsayithi wabo, ngenca yazo leziziga zokusahlelwa kwamaphandle lapha eSewula Afrika.
tgt: Khamphani dza Afurika Tshipembe dzine dza vha na mabindu ane a khou tshimbila zwavhuḓi kha dzhango dzi thusaho nga u shela mulenzhe kha mbuelo dzashu na uri ikonomi yashu i bvelele dzi nga vha na vhukonḓi vhu fanaho na uho.

src: Abanengi babantu balapha ekhethu abathembele eentolo zamaphandle ukuthenga nokuthola ukudla kwabo basele esihlengeleni nakunje.
tgt: Zwenezwino, ho pfuvhiswa khontsethi dza vhaimbi vha Afurika Tshipembe nga ṅwambo wa u ṱhaselwa uhu vhe vha vha vho tea uya kha mashango a nnḓa u sumbedza vhukoni havho vha ngaho BigNuz vhe vha vha vho tea u ya ngei Zimbabwe, Kelly Khumalo na Casper vhe vha vha vho tea u ya ngei London.

src: Namhlanje, amaSewula Afrika athabela iinzuzo ezilethwa lilizwe elikhululekileko ikululeko leyo yatholakala ngesizo lamaZwe we-Afrika ambadlwana.
tgt: Vhunzhi ha vhathu vha kha mivhundu yo ḓitikaho nga mavhengele a langwago nga vhabvannḓa kha u renga vhurotho na zwa u ḓodzela zwazwino vho hanganea.

src: Usaziwako nentandokazi engasekho, uMengameli u-Oliver Tambo wahlala pheze ama-30 weminyaka e-Zambia namanye amaSewula Afrika amanengi ayesekudingisweni.
tgt: Zwazwino, Afurika Tshipembe ḽi ḓiphina nga u vha shango ḽo vhofholowaho, zwo vhaho hone nga kha u dzhenelela ha mashango o vhalaho a Afurika.

src: Amazwe wekhethu we-Afrika azange agcine ngokubhacisa abantu bekhethu nje kwaphela, kodwana asiza nangeensetjenziswa nangemithombo yamandla, amanye wawo athenga ikululeko yeSewula Afrika ngeengazi, njengoba abhujelwa nanga zizakhamuzi zawo nakulwelwa ikululeko nentando yenengi yeSewula Afrika.
tgt: Munna wa vhaṋe vhane vha vha ḽizhakanḓila ḽashu, Muphuresidennde Vho Oliver Tambo vho ṋewa vhudzulo lwa miṅwaha ya 30 ngei Zambia na vhaṅwe maAfurika Tshipembe vho dzulaho vhupulini.

src: ISewula Afrika angeze yaliywa endleleni yokuphumelelisa inembombono yoBunye bamaZwe we-Afrika njengombana imumethwe ku-ajenda yomNyaka wee-2063 yeHlangano yoBunye be-Afrika, njengombana yayilandelelwa bobamkhulu bethu abanjengo-Kwame Nkrumah, u-Nnamdi Azikiwe, no-Mwalimu Julius Nyerere kunye no-Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Mashango a Afurika ha ngo ṋea vhathu vhashu vhudzulo fhedzi, o dovha a ṋetshedza zwishumiswa maṅwe a badela mbadelo dza nṱhesa nga u xelelwa nga vhadzulapo hu tshi khou itelwa uri Afurika Tshipembe ḽi kone u wana demokirasi.

src: UMengameli u-Jacob Zuma uthume isiQhema saboNgqongqotjhe sezoBulungiswa, ukuKhandelwa kobuLelesi nokuQinisekisa ukuVikeleka ngokukhambisana naboNgqongqotjhe wezokuThuthukiswa kwamaBhizinisi amaNcani, wezeRhwebo namaBubulo kunye newezokuThuthukiswa komPhakathi kobanyana babonisane nazo zoke iinqhema ezifaneleko, bafunisane ipengu yokurarulula umraro lo.
tgt: Afurika Tshipembe a ḽi nga ḓo vhuya ḽa pambuwa kha u isa phanḓa na bono ḽa Pan African sa zwo sumbedzwaho kha adzhenda ya AU ya 2063, ye ya vha itshi khou tshimbidzwa nga vho makhulukuku washu Vho Kwame Nkrumah, Vho Nnamdi Azikiwe, Vho Mwalimu Julius Nyerere na Vho Nelson Mandela.

src: AboNgqongqotjhaba bathunywe nomsebenzi wokuqala ubujamo bomnotho womphakathi ekubonakala unga wona mthombo walomukghwa wokusahlelwa kwamaphandle, kobanyana indaba le izokulungiswa ngokupheleleko iphele.
