src: ISewula Afrika izokuthoma khona nje ukukhulumisana ne-AU ) namazwe amalunga wayo, kubonisanwe ngokuthi iindlela zokulamula imibango yamazwe we-Afrika zingasetjenziswa njani ngaphandle kokuriyada, “ngomnqopho wokuqinisekisa ukuthi amacala amambi khulu emazweni ngamazwe awaphunyurhi angakajeziswa, nokuthi ukutjhutjhiswa kwawo okuphumelelako kufanele kuqinisekiswe ngokuthatha amagadango elizweni loke nangokukhuphula izinga lokusebenzisana ngokulekelelana namazwe ngamazwe.”ISewula Afrika izakubamba imikhulumiswana nelizwe ngalinye kewe-Afrika, ibambe imikhulumiswano namazwe we-Afrika ambadlwana kobanyana azokukhanjsiwa msinyana amatjhuguluko weKhotho yamaLungelo wobuNtu e-Afrika namanye amabandla wesiphande.
tgt: Afrika Tshipembe ḽo ḓiimisela u ṱahisa fhungo iḽi muṱanganoni wa Buthano ḽa Madzangano a Muvhuso kha Mulayo wa Roma wa Khothe ya Vhugevhenga ya Dzitshakatshaka.

src: Lokhu-ke kuzakwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi amacala wobulelesi amambi khulu phezu kwabantu asetjenzwa msinyana ngileziinjamiso, bekube nesiqiniseko sokuthi kuba namahlelo wokungezelela la amacala anje atjhutjhiswa khona yi-ICC namkha atjhutjhiswe ngezinye iinjamiso ze-Afrika.
tgt: Ho sedzwa tserekano ya mbilaelo dza thekinikhala na dza mulayo dzine ra vha nadzo, Afrika Tshipembe ḽi ḓo sedza hafhu u rumela mulaedza uyu kha Khothe ya Vhulamukanyi ya Dzitshakatshaka uri i dzhie tsheo kha fhungo iḽi.

src: Kungasikade, iSewula Afrika izokuhlelela ukubamba imikhulumiswana ne-ICC ngeendaba ezinomnako ngazo.
tgt: Athikili 97a i athu shumiswa nga ICC na luthihi.

src: ISewula Afrika izakulungisa umbiko wayo ngokusebenzisana ne-ICC ngokwemibandela ye-Athikili yama-97 nangobunye ubudisi edlule kibo ngokwemibandela ye-Athikili 98(2), bese umbiko loyo iwudlulisela eBandleni lesiGungu emhlanganweni ozako.
tgt: Izwi ho vha hu lwa u thoma Dzangano ḽa Shango ḽi tshi rambiwa nga ICC u kwamana nayo nga ha vhuleme vhune ḽi nga vha naho kha u bvisa ḽiṅwalo ḽa u fara ḽine ḽi nga vhangela uri Dzangano ḽa Shango ḽi pfuke zwipikwa zwaḽo zwa Dzitshakatshaka.

src: ISewula Afrika izakubuye iphakamise amatjhuguluko wesiVumelwano somLayelo weRoma we-ICC ngomnqopho wokuhlathulula nokuqinisa iimbopho zokubonisana nokusebenzisana ne-ICC emiBusweni enjalo.
tgt: ICC ḽo fanela u dzhiela aya mafhungo nṱha nahone masia oṱhe o vha a tshi kombetshedzea u ambedzana nga muya wavhuḓi.

src: IinQunto zeKhabinethi eziQakathekileko.
tgt: Tsheo dza Khabinethe dza Ndeme Khabinethe yo tendela pulane dza u ḓo thoma Operation Phakisa Mining Lab, ine ya ḓo sedza thaidzo dzo dziaho dzine dzi khou kundisa nyaluwo na mveledziso ya sekithara.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele amaqhinga wokuhloma i-Operation Phakisa Mining Lab, ezakukhomba imiraro ebonakalako ekhandela umthelela wokukhula nokuthuthuka kwezikweli.
tgt: Muṱangano wa vhege nna wa Ḽebo ya Migodi wo pulanelwa u farwa ngaTshimedzi 2015.

src: I-Mining Lab le ibunjwa siqhema sabosolwazi beemayini abazakusebenzisana ngokutlama amaqhinga wokulungisa imiraro le.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u anḓaziwa ha mvetomveto ya Maano a Vhuṱali a Ikonomi ya Bayodavesithi u itela vhupfiwa ha nnyi na nnyi.

src: Kuhlelwe umbuthano we-Mining Lab ozokudosa iimveke ezine ngoSewula wee-2015.
tgt: Maano a vhuṱali a katela tshifhinga tsha miṅwaha ya 14 u swika nga 2030.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukukhutjhelwa emphakathini komtlamo weQhinga lomNotho weeMmila neeNunwana.
tgt: Nga kha maano a vhuṱali hu ḓo vha hu tshi khou sedzwa nyaluwo ya bayodavesithi kha u thusedza Zwibveledzwa Zwapo ngeno hu tshi khou vhulungwa ekhosisiṱeme.

src: Iqhingeli ngeleminyaka eli-14 elizakuraga bekufike umnyaka wee-2030.
tgt: I ḓo sedza, ro tou topola kha zwinzhi, kha nyaluwo ya sekithara ya zwa matshilo a ḓakani na vhuendelamashango ha vhupo ha mupo ho tsireledzeaho.

src: Iqhingeli linqophe godu ukukhuphula nokwandisa isizo lezemvelo kuNgeniso yomKhiqizo oPheleleko weliZweloke ngakelinye ihlangothi kongiwe iintjalo zelizwe.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u anḓaziwa ha mvetomveto ya muhanga na mashumele ane a ḓo shumiswa u dzudzanya Vhuḓiimiseli ha u Shela Mulenzhe ha Lushaka vhu Ṱoḓaho u itwa nga Afrika Tshipembe u itela vhupfiwa ha nnyi na nnyi kana vhukwamani na vhakwameaho phanḓa ha musi ḽikumedzwa ḽi tshi ṋetshedzwa kha Muhanga wa Yuno wa Thendelano ya Tshanduko ya Kilima (UNFCC).Muhanga wa vhuya wa ṱoliwa u ḓo vha tshipiḓa tsha thendelano i re mulayoni nga fhasi ha UNFCC, une u ḓo rwelwa ṱari ngei Paris, France nga Nyendavhusiku MilayotibeKhabinethe yo tendela u anḓadzwa ha Milayotibe i tevhelaho u itela vhupfiwa ha nnyi:.

src: Hlangana nokhunye lizakunqopha ekuqiniseni ukukhula emazikweni womnotho wezevakatjho nezemvelo.
tgt: Zhendedzi ḽa Vhulangi ha Mikaṋo (BMA), 2015, ḽine ḽa khou lwisa u thoma BMA ine ya nga dzudzanya kuendele kwo tsireledzeaho kwa u pfukha mikaṋo, ṱhuṱhuwedzo ya mbambadzo na ṱhoḓea dza vhutsireledzi ha lushaka, kha vhupo ha dzingu Afrika Tshipembe, Afrika na milayo ya ḽifhasi ḽoṱhe.

src: ImiThethomlingwaIKhabinethi ivumele ukukhutjhelwa emphakathini kwemithethomlingwa elandelako:.
tgt: Ndango heyi nthihi ya zwa mulayo u shumiswaho mikaṋoni i ṋetshedza khonadzeo ya tshumelo dzi sa ḓuriho kathihi na vhutsireledzi na vhulangi ha vhupo ha mikanaṋoni.

src: UmThethomlingwa we-eJensi yokuPhathwa kwemiKhawulo (i-BMA) umThethomlingwa wee-2015, ohlose ukuhloma i-BMA ezakulinganisa amakhambo aqamula imikhawulo, ukurhwebelana namakareko wokuvikeleka kwelizwe, ukuya ngokweembopho zeSewula Afrika esifundeni, e-Afrika nephasini loke.
tgt: Khwiṋiso ya Mulayotibe wa Tshavhi, 2015, une wa khou ṱoda u bveledza maitele a shumesaho a matshimbidzele a khumbelo dza vha ṱodaho vhudzumbamo.

src: Ukusetjenziswa komthetho munye wokuphathwa kwemikhawulo ukghonakalisa ukonga nokuqinisa ukuphathwa kwemikhawulo.
tgt: Khabinethe yo dovha ya tendela u kumedzwa ha Milayotibe i tevhelaho Phalamenndeni:.

src: IsiKhibelelo somThethomlingwa wabaPhalali wee-2015, ohlose ukwenzela abaphalali ubulula ekwenzeni iimbawo zokukhoseliswa.
tgt: Muvhuso Wapo: Khwiniso ya Mulayotibe wa Khetho dza Masipala, 2015, une u khwinisa Muvhuso Wapo: Mulayo wa Khetho dza Masipala, 2000 (Mulayo 27 wa 2000).Khwiniso dzi sedza kha mafhungo a u ḓo vhona uri ndugiselo na mashumele zwi tshimbile zwavhuḓi kha khetho dza 2016 dza muvhuso wapo.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukudluliselwa ngePalamende kwemiThethomlingwa elandelako:.
tgt: Khwiniso ya Mulayotibe wa Ndindakhombo ya vha sa Shumiho,2014.

src: IsiKhibelelo somThethomlingwa wezamaKhetho waboMasipala baboRhulumende bemaKhaya wee-2015, okhibelela uMthetho wezamaKhetho waboMasipala baboRhulumende bemaKhaya, 2000 (uMthetho Nomboro 27 wee-2000).Iinkhibelelwezi ziqinisekisa ukukhanjiswa lula kwamalungiselelo nokudluliswa kwamakhetho waboRhulumende bemaKhaya ahlelelwe umnyaka wee-2016.
tgt: Heyi ndi khwiniso ya vhuvhili ya Mulayo wa Ndindakhombo ya vha sa Shumiho wa 2001 (Mulayo 63 wa 2001).Mulayotibe wa vhuya wa phasisiwa, u ḓo dovha hafhu, ho topolwa kha zwinzhi, wa engedza tshifhinga tsha mbuelo dza mbadelo kha mubadeli u bva kha miṅwedzi ya malo u ya kha ya 12 na u engedza tshifhinga tshine mubadeli a nga kona u ḓisa mbilo yawe u bva kha miṅwedzi ya rathi u ya kha ya Zwi khou ḓaho.

src: IsiKhibelelo somThethomlingwa wesiKhwama seTjhorensi yabangasaSebenziko wee-2014.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela thero ya Ṅwedzi wa Vhafumakadzi ya 2015: “Vhafumakadzi, Vho Vhofhana kha u Takulela Afrika Tshipembe Phanḓa”, na khaḽenda ya mitambo kha Ṅwedzi wa Vhafumakadzi, ine ya ḓo ya phanḓa sa mbekanyamushumo ya ṅwaha.

src: Lesi sikhibelelo sesibili somThetho wesiKhwama seTjhorensi yabangasaSebenziko, 2001 (uMthetho Nomboro 63 wee-2001).Nasele umthethomlingwa lo uphasisiwe, uzakulula isikhathi sokubhadelwa kwenzuzo kumfakisibawo ukusuka eenyangeni ezibunane ukuya kezili-12 bekwelulwe nesikhathi sokobana umfakisibawo athumele itleyimu ukusuka eenyangeni ezisithandathu ukuya kezili-.
tgt: Mutambo wa Ḓuvha ḽa Vhafumakadzi nga ḽa ṱahe ḽa Ṱhangule 2015 u ḓo farelwa ngei Sasolburg, Free State, une u bvisiwa ha Muvhigo wa u thoma wa Tshiimo tsha Vhafumakadzi nga Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma zwa ḓo vha tshihumbudzi.2015 u khou dovha wa vha luswayo lwa anivesari ya vhu 59 ya Mugwalabo wa Vhafumakadzi vha tshi ya Union Buildings vha tshi khou lwa na milayo ya ḓompasa, zwi tshi khou rangela u dzudzanyiwa ha anivesari ya vhu 60 nga 2016.Minisiṱa vha Saintsi na Thekhinoḽodzhi Vho Naledi Pandor, vha ḓo divhadza Vhege ya ya Lushaka ya Saintsi (NSW)ine ya ḓo fariwa u bva nga ḽa (u thoma u swika nga ḽa malo 2015) Yunivesithi ya North-West (NWU), kha davhi ḽa Mafikeng nga ḽa u thoma ḽa Ṱhangule.

src: Umnyanya weLanga laboMma mhla ali-9 kuRhoboyi wee-2015 uzakubanjelwa e- Sasolburg, eseFreyistata, lapho uMengameli uJacob Zuma azakwethula khona umBiko wokuthoma ngobuJamo baboMma.
tgt: Vha ḓo fhelekedzwa nga MEC vha zwa Pfunzo, Vho Maphefo Matsemela, na Tshanḓa tsha Mutshantseḽara, Prof Vho Dan Kgwadi.

src: Umnyaka wee-2015 utshwaya iminyaka ema-59 weMatjhi yaboMma batjhinga e-Union Buildings ngomnqopho wokuyokuphikisana nemithetho yokuphathwa kwabomazisi, ekusisekelo setshwayamlando yeminyaka ema-60 ezokuba ngomnyaka wee-2016.
tgt: Mutambo u ḓo dzhenelwa nga zwigidi zwa vhagudi, vhagudi vha yunivesithi, vhoradzisaintsi na miraḓo ya tshitshavha.

src: UNgqongqotjhe wezeSayensi neThekhnoloji, uMma.
tgt: Thero ya NSW 2015 ndi “Ṅwaha wa Tshedza wa Dzitshakha na Thekhinoḽodzhi yo Ḓisendekaho kha Tshedza.” Tshedza na ndeme yatsho tshi ḓo vha tshi tshi khou sumbedziwa nga nḓila dzo fhambanaho sa kushumisele kwa ḽeiza kha mutakalo, muaro wa iṱo ḽo dzulwaho, nḓowetshumo ya u bveledza , u fhisedzela dzigoloi na dzibimu dza vhutsireledzi ha u kanganyisa u pwashelwa.

src: U-Naledi Pandor, uzokuhloma iVeke yezeSayensi yeliZweloke (i-NSW) ezakuraga ukusuk (mhlana li-1 ukuya naka-8 kuRhoboyi wee-2015) eYunivesithi yeTlhagwini Tjingalanga (i-NWU) eKhamphasini ye-Mahikeng mhlana li-1 kuRhoboyi.
tgt: Muhasho wa Saintsi na Thekhinoḽodzhi wo kona uri nga kha Khoro ya Ṱhoḓisiso ya zwa Nḓowetshumo na Saintsi wa bindudza kha fotonikisi – saintsi ya thekhinoḽodzhi ya tshedza ya u bveledza u langa na u fembedza dziweivi na zwitshakatshaka zwa tshedza.

src: UNgqongqotjhe uzabe aphekelelwa nguSomkhandlu wezeFundo weTlhagwini Tjingalanga, uMma.
tgt: Hezwi zwo swikisa kha, ho tou topolwa, u phuletshedza ha u tou thoma ha thekhinoḽodzhi ya ḽeiza ya didzhithaḽa.

src: U-Maphefo Matsemela, neSekela leHloko yeYunivesithi, uPhrofesa u-Dan Kgwadi.
tgt: Vho Stavros Nicolaou sa muraḓo ane a nga imela wa Khoro ya Mveledziso ya Vhashumi na Ikonomi ya Lushaka kha Bodo ya Tshipentshele ya Vhueletshedzi ha zwa Dzizouṋu dza Ikonomi.

src: Ummongondaba weVeke yezeSayensi yomnyaka wee-2015 uthi “UmNyaka weenTjhababatjhaba wokuKhanya nokuKhanyisa okuSekelwe kuThekhnoloji.” Kuzakukhangiswa ngokukhanyisa okuhlukileko nokuqakatheka kwakho ekuthuthukiseni amaphilo njengokusetjenziswa komtjhini okhupha umkhanyo otjhisa amalwele kezokwelapha, ukuhlinzwa kwamehlo, zokukhiqiza emabubulweni, ukutjhiselela iinkoloyi neensimbi zokukhandela ukufahla kweelelesi.
tgt: Bannga ya Khadzimiso:a) Vho Bafana Patrick Mathidi – (vho dovha u tholwa hafhu sa Muhulwane a sa Shumiho hone)b) Adv.

src: UmNyango wezeSayensi neThekhnoloji, ngokusebenzisana nomKhandlu wezokuRhubhulula ngeSayensi namaBubulo (i-CSIR), usise ku-photonics – ekuyisayensi yethekhnoloji yokuphehlwa, ukulawulwa nokuyabula imisebe namacezwana womkhanyo.
tgt: Vho Sandra Julie Hester Coetzee – (Muhulwane a sa Shumiho hone)c) Vho Mathane Eveline Makgatho – (Muhulwane a sa Shumiho hone)nad) Vho Bennie van Rooy – (Muofisiri Muhulwane wa zwa Masheleni).

src: Lokhu kudosele epumelelweni yokuthoma ephasini ngethekhnoloji i-digital laser.
tgt: Khoro ya Lushaka ya Vhafhaṱi vha Dzinnḓu vho Ḓiṅwalisaho:a) Vho Abbey Chikane (Mudzulatshidulo)b) Vho Julieka Bayatc) Vho Xoliswa Eunice Dakud) Vho Themba Thomas Cyril Dlaminie) Vho Hlaleleni Kathleen Dlepuf) Ambasada Vho Segogwane Samuel Kotaneg) Vho Phetola Nailana Solomon Makgatheh) Vho Mankwana Christinah Mohalei) Vho Busisiwe Nwabisa Nzoj) Vho Alvin Phumudzo Rapeak) Vho Goolam Hoosen Manack (Muimeleli wa Vhufaragwama ha Lushaka)l) Vho Obed Lucas Molotsi (Muimeleli wa Muhasho Mishumo ya Muvhuso) nam) Vho Lulama Andisa Potwana (Muimeleli wa Muhasho wa Mbambadzo na Nḓowetshumo).

src: Ipumelelo eyenziwe yi-CSIR ijamele indlela etja yokucabanga ngokwethekhnoloji yomkhanyo otjhisako begodu ingaba sisekelo sekusasa lendlela ithekhnoloji eyakhiwa ngayo.
tgt: Dr Vho Muzamani Charles Nwaila sa Muhulwane (DG) wa Muhasho wa zwa Sialala– (Khonṱhiraka yo engedzwa u ya kha miṅwaha miraru).

src: UkuqatjhwaUkuqatjhwa koke kulawulwa kufakazeleka kweencwadi zefundo ezikhambisana nomsebenzi umuntu aqatjhelwe wona kunye nokuhlanjululwa kwegama lomuntu okufaneleko okwenziwa ziimphathimandla.
tgt: Dr Vho Bongani Douglas Ngqulunga sa Mufarisa DG: Ofisi ya Phuraivethe ya Phuresidennde kha Ofisi ya Muphuresidennde.

src: Ukuphunyeleliswa Kwamahlelo Karhulumende Aphambili.
tgt: U thomiwa ha mbekanyamushumo dza ndeme dza muvhuso.

src: IKhabinethi iyayithokozela indima esele yenziwe yi-Project Mikondzo, eligadango lezenzelwa ekuqothelwe ngayo ukufikisa izenzelwa zombuso ebantwini abatlhage khulu elizweni lekhethweli.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱanganedza mvelaphanḓa ya Project Mikondzo, nḓisedzo ya tshumelo yo thomiwaho hu na ndivho ya u engedza tswikelelo ya tshumelo dza tshitshavha kha zwitshavha zwi tambulesaho shangoni ḽashu.

src: Lokhu-ke kutjengiswe e-De Doorns, eTjingalanga Kapa, la imindeni ezi-4 021 ilekelelwa khona ngesizo lombuso kilemindeni-ke abantu abondla imindeni leyo ubunengi babo babantu abasebenza amatorho wamaplasi avela ngeenkhathi ezithileko zomnyaka kwaphela.
tgt: Izwi zwo sumbedziswa ngei De Doorns kha ḽa Kapa Vhukovhela, hune thuso ya khou ṋetshedzwa kha miṱa ya 4 021 ine vhunzhi ha vhaṱunḓeli vhayo vho fara zwikoropo mabulasini.

src: Hlangana nokhunye abasizwa ngakho lababantu abasizwako, basizwa nangembewu kunye nangezinjana zeentjalo (iintjadlwana) kobanyana bazozitjalela zona eemvandeni zabo zekhaya, basizwe nangeemali zokuzivulela iinhlangano zomphakathi kunye namakoporasi.
tgt: Thuso i katela, vhukati ha zwiṅwe zwithu, nḓisedzo ya mbeu na mbwanana u itela ngade dza miṱani na u lambedzwa ha u thomiwa ha madzangano a zwitshavhani na mabindu maṱuku.

src: UmNyango wezokuThuthukiswa komPhakathi godu usebenzisa i-De Doorns njengendawo ekuzakwakhelelwa phezu kwayo umthethokambiso ozakulawula iinsebenzi zamatorho avela ngeenkhathi ezithileko.
tgt: Muhasho wa Mveledziso ya Tshitshavha u khou shumisa hafhu De Doorns u bveledza mbekanyamaitele ya vhashumi vha u tou koropa kana vha WEBTOKEN tshi ḓadziswa, Zhendedzi ḽa Tsireledzo ya Zwitshavha ḽa Afrika Tshipembe (SASSA) ḽo phaḓaladza mbekanyamushumo ya Mbofholowo ya Zwitshavha kha Mutsiko u ṋea zwiḽiwa na zwiṅwe zwa ndeme u fana na yunifomo dza tshikolo dza vhana vha bvaho miṱani i shayaho.

src: Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Ejensi yeeMbonelelo zeSondlo noMhlalaphasi kaRhulumende yeSewula Afrika (i-SASSA), ivule ihlelo lokuLekelela umPhakathi emTlhagweni elizakuphakisa umphakathi ngokudla nokhunye okudingekileko, njengejinifomu yabantwana besikolo bemakhaya adingileko.
tgt: Gavhelo ḽa R1 083 160 u bva kha Zhendedzi ḽa Mveledziso ya Lushaka ḽi tikedza zwigwada zwa mitambo zwa Mveledziso ya Vhana Vhaṱuku (ECD) zwi si na senthara zwa 11, zwi re na vhana vha 975 vhane vha khou dzhena sentharani dza ECD vhuponi uho nahone 789 ya vhana avho vha khou vhuelwa u bva kha luafhulelo lwa ECD lwa muvhuso.

src: Isibonelelo sombuso se-R1 083 160 esivela ku-Ejensi yezeTuthuko sisekela iinkundla ezili-11 zokudlalela zeeNdawo zokuKhulisela abaNtwana kwebuNtwaneni (ama-ECD), la kunabantwana abama-975 abakilama-ECD endaweni kunye nabama-789 babo abasizwa siphekiso sombuso sama-ECIKhabinethi iyayibuka ipumelelo esolo iya phambili ye-Operation Fiela, ipumelelo yamva nje ebonakele eTlhagwini Kapa la ijima elihlanganyelweko leButho lamaPholisa weSewula Afrika (i-SAPS), neminyango karhulumende, neenqhema zokuphumelelisa umthetho zaborhulumende beemfunda nabeendawo liragele khona phambili ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphephile, nokuthi bazizwa baphephile.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhululedza mishumo yavhuḓi ine ya khou bvela phanḓa ya Operation Fiela, ine zwazwino ya vha ngei Kapa Devhula hune mashumele o ṱanganelanaho a Tshumelo ya Mapholisa ya Afrika Tshipembe (SAPS), mihasho ya muvhuso, na mazhendedzi a mulayo a mimasipala na mavunḓu a vha kati na u vhona uri vhathu vha pfa vho tsireledzea.

src: IKomidi eHlanganyelwe boNgqongqotjhe (i-IMC) ngeeNdaba zokuPhuma nokuNgena kwabaNtu eSewula Afrika izokubamba umhlangano weembikiindaba ngeveke ezako la izokwethula khona umbiko opheleleko ngejimeli.
tgt: Komiti ya Minisiṱa dza Mihasho yo fhambanaho (IMC) nga ha Mipfuluwo i ḓo vha na zwine ya ḓo amba na vha nyanḓadzamafhungo vhege iḓaho u ṋea zwidodombedzwa nga vhuḓalo u swika zwino.

src: IKhabinethi ibuka amayuniyoni neenhlangano eziphethe iimayini ngokusebenzisana kwazo norhulumende ukuvuselela umsebenzi wekoro yeemayini, wona oyisika yomnotho wekhethu, begodu ikhuthaza zoke iinqhema ukuthi zigcine iimbophozazo.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhululedza madzangano a vhashumi na nnḓu dza vhupo ha migodini kha u shumisana na muvhuso u vusuludza sekhithara ya migodini, ine ya vha ṅwongo wa ikonomi yashu nahone i humbela madzangano oṱhe u thoma zwe a fulufhedzisa.

src: URhulumende, ngokubambisana namabhizinisi namayuniyoni, bekasolo alinga ukwenza iindawo ezihlala abantu emadorobheni weemayini zibe ngcono, ngokunjalo alinga nokwenza ipilo yabantu ibe ngcono kilamadorobha.
tgt: Muvhuso, khathihi na mabindu na muhasho wa vhashumi, ndi kale zwi khou lingedza u khwinisa nga u ṋea nnḓu dza khwine na nyimele ya matshilo ya khwine kha ḓorobo dza migodini.

src: Nasele iyoke, ima-R18 wamabhiliyoni imali ebekelwe umsebenzi osaragwako eendaweni zeemayini la abantu baphila khona ngomtlhago ubunengi bemali le ibuya embusweni, bese kuthi elinganiselwa esiquntwini sokuthathu kube ngebuya eenkampanini zeemayini.
tgt: Rannda dza 18 biḽioni dzo kumedzelwa u shuma zwitshavhani zwi siho kha vhuimo havhuḓi zwa vhupo ha migodini, vhunzhi ha iyi tshelede i bva kha muvhuso ngeno khamphani dza migodi dzo bvisa tshelede ine i nga eḓana tshararu tsha u lambedzwa uhu.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele iHlanganisela yaboNgqongqotjhe bezokuPhepha ukuthi ifakwe ku-IMC ngezokungena nokuphuma kwabantu elizweni lekhethweli, emenyezelwe nguMengameli u-Jacob Zuma.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u katelwa ha Minisiṱa dza Tshigwada tsha Tsireledzo kha Komiti ya Dziminisiṱa dza Mihasho yo fhambanaho (IMC) nga ha Ṱhundu zwe zwa ḓivhadzwa nga Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma.

src: I-IMC, edoswa phambili liSekela likaMengameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa, izokuphenya ibe irarulule imiraro yamaqaphazela abekangakahloswa wemithetho emitjha ngezokungena nokuphuma kwabantu eSewula Afrika emakorweni ngamakoro, sekubalwa nekoro yezevakatjhobukelo nezamasiso.
tgt: IMC, yo rangwa phanḓa nga Mufarisa Muphuresidennde Vho Cyril Ramaphosa, i ḓo ṱola na u tandulula khonadzeo na masiandoitwa a so ngo lavhelelwaho a milayo miswa ya ṱhundu kha sekhithara dzo fhambanaho, hu tshi katelwa na vhuendelamashango na vhubindudzi.

src: I-IMC izakubunjwa nguNgqongqotjhe wezokuVakatjha, noNgqongqotjhe wezangeKhaya, noNgqongqotjhe wezeRhwebo nezamaBubulo, noNgqongqotjhe wezokuThuthukiswa komPhakathi, noNgqongqotjhe wezokuThuthukiswa kwamaBhizinisi amaNcani kunye neHlanganisela yezokuPhepha.
tgt: IMC i ḓo katela Minisita wa Vhuendelamashango Muhasho wa zwa Muno Mbambadzo na Nḓowetshumo Mveledziso ya Zwitshavha Mveledziso ya Mabindu Maṱuku, na Tshigwada tsha Tsireledzo.

src: Babalwa ngeenkulungwana abomma ababuthene e-Harry Gwala Stediyamu e-Sasolburg bayokukhumbula indima eqakathekileko yokutjhotjhozela kezepolitiki eyenziwa bomma ngeminyaka yokulwela itjhaphuluko ngesikhathi sombuso wamakhuwa nowe-apartheid.
tgt: Tshiimo tsha khabinethe kha mafhungo a ndeme a mupo.

src: IKhabinethi ibawa woke amakoro womphakathi ukuthi aragele phambili ngommongondaba weNyanga yaboMma, aragele phambili nangokuqinisekisa ukuthi boke abantu abasikazi, khulu khulu abantwana babantazana, bahlonyiswa ngamandla, batjhatjhululwe ebandlululweni lomphakathi kobanyana kuzokulungiseka indaba yokutjhiyana ngendima yobulili elizweni leSewula Afrika.
tgt: Khabinethe yo ṱanganedza u pembelelwa ha Ḓuvha ḽa Vhafumakadzi he ha farwa ngei Sasolburg kha ḽa Free State fhasi ha thero ine ya ri: “Vhafumakadzi vho Farana kha u isa Afrika Tshipembe Phanḓa”.

src: Ukudlula lapho, uMengameli uZuma ubuye wamemezela nombiko ongowokuthoma womhlobo onje ngobuJamo baboMma eSewula Afrika.
tgt: Zwigidi na zwigidi zwa vhafumakadzi zwo kuvhangana ngei tshiṱediamu tsha Harry Gwala ngei Sasolburg u dzhiela nṱha mushumo wa ndeme wa u shela mulenzhe kha polotiki nga vhafumakadzi wo iteaho nga tshifhinga tsha nndwa ya mbofholowo u bva kha u vhuswa na muvhuso wa tshiṱalula.

src: Umbiko lo uveza amaqha amakhulu wokukhuphula ubujamo babomma ukusukela ngomnyaka we-1994.
tgt: Khabinethe i ita khuwelelo kha sekithara dzoṱhe zwitshavhani u farelela kha thero ya Ṅwedzi wa Vhafumakadzi na u bvela phanḓa na u shuma uya kha u vhona uri vhafumakadzi vhoṱhe, zwihulusa vhana vha vhasidzana, vha khou maanḓafhadziwa na u vhofhololwa kha tshiṱalula zwitshavhani u itela uri ri kone u tandulula u eḓanyisa mbeu shangoni ḽashu.

src: Umbiko uhlanganiswe mNyango wezaboMma, ngemva kobana ukhe wabamba imihlangano yokukhulumisana elizweni loke ukusukela ngenyanga kaNtaka ukuyokufika enyangeni kaMgwengweni nonyaka (2015).
tgt: Hu tshi ḓadziswa, Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vho bvisa muvhigo wa u tou thoma wa ulwu lushaka nga ha Maimo a Vhafumakadzi Afrika Tshipembe.

src: Umbiko lo usisekelo somtlolo ophakamisa nokhuthaza ukuhlonyiswa kwabomma ngamandla womnotho womphakathi, nokulinganiswa kobulili kunye namalungelo wobuntu.
tgt: Muvhigo u dzhiela nṱha, mishumo ya nṱha yo itwaho shangoni ḽashu u bva ṅwaha wa 1994 u khwinisa maimo a vhafumakadzi.

src: URhulumende uzokusebenzisa amalanga asaseleko wenyanga le ukuveza imininingwana yabomma abaphumelelako kunye nendima abangene ngayo emnothweni, khulukhulu emakorweni la babancani khona ngesibalo.
tgt: Muvhuso u ḓo shumisa maḓuvha o salaho a ṅwedzi u phurofaila vhafumakadzi vho swikelelaho zwinzhi na u shela havho mulenzhe kha ikonomi, zwihulusa vhuponi hune a vho ngo tou imelelwa zwavhuḓi.

src: Lapha-ke kubalwa aboNongorwana baboMma kezeSayensi (13 kuRhoboyi) kunye naboNongorwana baboMma kezaManzi neHlwengeko (23 kuRhoboyi).
tgt: Izwi zwi katela Vhafumakadzi kha Pfufho dza Saintsi (13 Ṱhangule) na Vhafumakadzi kha Pfufho dza Maḓi na Vhuthathatshili (23 Ṱhangule).

src: IKhabinethi ibuka ama-Proteas ngokuphakamisa igama leSewula Afrika ePhaliswaneni le-World Cup ye-Netball e-Sydney, e-Australia.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhululedza vhatambi vha Proteas kha u ita uri Afrika Tshipembe ḽi ḓihudze ngei kha Tshiphuga tsha Ḽifhasi tsha Netibola ngei Sydney, kha ḽa Australia.

src: Isiqhema se-Netball seSewula Afrikesi siseduze nokulungela imidlalo yama-semifayinali weBhegere yePhasi ngemva kokudlala imidlalo enzima bekube khathesi.
tgt: Tshigwada tsha Afrika Tshipembe tshi tsinisa na u tea u vha kha mitambo ya tsini na ya mafhelelo ya Tshiphuga tsha Ḽifhasi nga murahu ha u tamba mitambo i konḓaho vhukuma u swika zwino.

src: Ngokutjho kwehlangano ye-Netball yamaZwe ngamaZwe, iSewula Afrika njenganje seyisezingeni lesihlanu ephasinizombelele.
tgt: U ya nga Guvhangano ḽa Netibola ḽa Dzitshakhatshakha, Afrika Tshipembe zwazwino ḽo vhewa kha maimo a vhuṱanu kha maimo a ḽifhasi.

src: IKhabinethi ibawa woke amaSewula Afrika ukuthi asekele ama-Proteas njengoba asolo atjhitjhingela ukuthumba iBhegere yePhasi nje.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo kha maAfrika Tshipembe uri vha tikedze Proteas zwenezwi vha tshi khou bvela phanḓa kha lwendo luyaho gundoni ngei kha Tshiphuga tsha Ḽifhasi.

src: IKhabinethi seyihlanganyele noMengameli uZuma ekulileleni imindeni, nabangani nabalingani bamapholisa wakwa-SAPS asandukubulawa.
tgt: Khabinethe i kha ḽithihi na Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma kha u fhirisa ndiliso kha miṱa, khonani na vhashumisani vha miraḓo ya SAPS yo vhulawaho.

src: Ukubulawa kwamapholisa okunganangqondokhu kufuze kusolwe ngiwo woke amaSewula Afrika.
tgt: Mabulayo ayo a si na ṱhoho a fanela u sasaladzwa nga maAfrika Tshipembe roṱhe.

src: Amapholisa ayisika yokuvikeleka kwabantu beSewula Afrika eenlelesini.
tgt: Mapholisa ndi vha ndeme kha u tsireledza zwitshavha kha maitele a vhugevhenga zwitshavhani zwashu.

src: Lokhukubulawa kwamapholisa okunganangqondo akugcini ngokwemuka umphakathi iimphathimthetho nje kwaphela, kodwa kwemuka nemindeni amadoda wemizi, abafazi bemizi, abafowabo babantu, abodadwabo labantu kunye nababelethi.
tgt: Mabulayo a si na ṱhoho ha khou tou ri lozwisa fhedzi sa shango na tshitshavha tsha vhaofisiri vha vhutsireledzi ha mulayo, miṱa na yone i khou lozwa vhokhotsi, vhomme, dzikhaladzi, vhakomana na vhabebi.

src: IKhabinethi ibawa labo abanelwazi ngokubulawa kwamapholisokhu ukuthi beze ngaphambili basebenzisane namapholisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ababulali bayabotjhwa, baqalane nesandla somthetho.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo kha vha re na mafhungo nga ha aya mabulayo a si na ṱhoho u bvela khagala nahone vha shumisane na mazhendedzi a vhatsireledza mulayo u vhona uri avho vha re na vhuḓifhinduleli vha a farwa nahone vha imela tshanḓa a mulayo.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozisa isiQhema seSewula Afrika ngokusebenza kwaso kuhle khulu ePhaliswaneni lokuThaya elingele-16 le-FINA (i-International Swimming Federation) eKazan, e-Russia la isiqhema sekhethu sithumbe khona iimendlela zegolide ezimbili nezesiliva ezintathu.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhululedza Tshigwada tsha Afrika Tshipembe kha matambele atsho a nṱhesa ngei kha 16th FINA (International Swimming Federation) World Championship kha ḽa Kazan, Russia he vha kunda vha pfufhiwa nga miṅene mivhili ya musuku na miraru ya silivhere.

src: IinQunto zeKhabinethi eziQakathekileko.
tgt: Tsheo dza ndeme dza Khabinethe.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukumenyezelwa komTlamomgomo wemiBono ngomThethokambiso weenTimela, wona okhuluma ngokuthuthwa kwepahla ngeentimela nangokukhanjiswa kwabantu ngeentimela.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u bviswa ha Mulayombisi nga ha Mbekanyamaitele ya Zwiporo ya Lushaka hu tshi itelwa vhupfiwa ha tshitshavha, ine ya tandulula u tshimbidzwa ha vhathu nga tshidimela na mihwalo.

src: Umthethokambiso lo, okhambisana neKomitjhini yezokuLungelelwa komThangalasisekelo, uvula ithuba lokuvuselelwa kwebubulo leentimela ngamagadango ahleliweko akhamba ngomthethokambiso okhambisana nomTlamo wezokuThuthukiswa kwesiTjhaba (i-NDP).Umnqopho lapha kukwakha ihlelo lezokuthutha eliphumelelako, elizakwazi ukujamelana namanye amahlelo wezokuthutha wakhona lapha ekhethu nawamazwe ngamazwe, kunye nokwehlisa iindleko zokuthutha.
tgt: Mbekanyamaitele iyi, yo livhanywaho na mushumo wa Khomishini ya Pfananyo ya Themamveledziso ya ofisi ya Muphuresidennde, i konisa mvusuludzo ya nḓowetshumo ya zwiporo nga kha u dzhenelela ha mbekanyamaitele yo rangaho phanḓa maano a vhubindudzi ane o livhanywa na Pulane ya Mveledziso ya Lushaka (NDP).Ndivho ndi ya u sika sisiṱeme ya vhuendi vhu shumaho zwavhuḓi vhune ha kona u ṱaṱisana fhano hayani na mashangoni a nnḓa, na u fhungudza mbadelo dza vhuendi.

src: Lokhu-ke kuzakukhuthaza ukusetjenziswa kwetheknoloji efaneleko ukuphakamisa amandla wokusebenza nawokuthola amakghonofundwa afuneka khulu la emnothweni.
tgt: Izwi zwi ḓo ṱuṱuwedza u shumiswa ha thekinoḽodzhi yo teaho u engedza vhubveledzi na u wana zwikili zwi ṱoḓeaho kha ikonomi.

src: Kukhuphula nethuba lokusizakala kwabantu beendawo zemakhaya, kukhuphule namathuba wokukghona ukukhamba lula, kwakhe nemisebenzi.
tgt: Zwi dovha zwa khwinisa u kona u swikelela vhupo ha mahayani, u engedza matshimbidzele na u sika mishumo.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele nokusabalaliswa komtlolo wokubonisana nomphakathi, othi “Ukuthwasiselwa amakghonofundwa nokufundiselwa amaqhinga wamaKoro ngamaKoro ngemva komnyaka wee-2016, efundisweni ehlukaniswe ngeengaba ngeengaba zokuthwasiselwa ilwazi ngemva kwesikolo.”Umtlolo lo ukhuluma ngepumelelo nobuhle beenjamiso zokufundiselwa nokuthwasiselwa amakghonofundwa kunye nokufakwa kwawo ehlelweni lefundo nokuthwasisa ngokuphelela kwalo ngemva kwesikolo namkha efundweni ephakemeko.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u phaḓaladzwa ha ḽiṅwalwa u itela vhupfiwa ha tshitshavha ḽa “Maano a Mveledziso ya Zwikili a Lushaka na Maanḓalanga a Vhupfumbudzi na Sekithara ya Pfunzo u fhira 2016 ngomu ha nyimele yo ṱanganelanaho, i fhambanyaho pfunzo ya nga murahu ha tshikolo na sisiṱeme ya vhupfumbudzi”.Ḽiṅwalwa iḽi ḽi tandulula mashumele kwao na mashumele avhuḓi a zwiimiswa zwa mveledziso ya zwikili na u dzheniswa hazwo ngomu ha sisiṱeme ya vhupfumbudzi na u ṱanḓavhuwa ha pfunzo ya nga murahu ha tshikolo.

src: Lapha-ke umtlolo lo uphakamisa khulukhulu izinga elilandelako leQhinga lokwAkhiwa kwamaKghonofundwa eliZweni lOke elizawaqalelela liwenze amaqalontanzi wemisebenzi yebizelo esele ikhethwe njengemisebenzi efuneka khulu ekuphunyelelisweni kwamahlelo weqalontanzi.
tgt: Zwihulusa, ḽi kumedza uri Maano a Mveledziso ya Zwikili a Lushaka a tevhelaho uri a dzhiele nzhele mabuḓo e a topoliwa sa one a ṱoḓeaho nga maanḓa u itela u thomiwa ha mbekanyamushumo dza ndeme dza lushaka.

src: Ubuye godu ukhulume nangepumelelo nangobuhle beendaba zokuphatha ekorweni yezefundo nokuthwasisa ekukhutjhweni kweemali zesibonelelo emabizelweni amaqalontanzi.
tgt: Ḽi dovha ḽa tandulula mashumele kwao na mashumele avhuḓi a mafhungo a vhuvhusi ha sekithara ya maanḓalanga a pfunzo na vhupfumbudzi kha u ṋetshedza magavhelo u itela mabuḓo a ndeme.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukukhutjhwa kwamalayisense wokusebenzela safuthi weenTeyitjhi zeLwandle zakwaTransnet kobanyana azokulawula iinteyitjhi zemanganizi, esiTeyitjhini semiKhumbi seNgqura, ncangepumalanga yeligu leSewula Afrika, ebangeni elima-20 wamakhilomitha ukusuka eBhayi, phakathi naphakathi ne-Durban neKapa.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u ṋetshedzwa ha ḽiṅwalwa ḽa tshumiso ḽa tshoṱhe kha Theminaḽa dza Vhuimangalavha dza Transnet uri i shumise theminaḽa ya khontheina ya manganese ngei Vhuimangalavha ha Ngqura, vhu re kha phendelashango ya vhubvaḓuvha ha Afrika Tshipembe, khiḽomitha dza 20 devhula vhubvaḓuvha ha Port Elizabeth na tshikhalani tsha vhukati ha Durban na Ḓorobo ya Kapa.

src: Lokhu-ke kusese yindlela yinye namaqalontanzi wombuso amalungana ne-Operation Phakisa malungana nokuhlunyiswa komNotho weLwandle.
tgt: Izwi zwi tshimbilelana na mishumo ya ndeme ya muvhuso i re na vhushaka na Operation Phakisa kha u alusa Ikonomi ya Maḓanzhe.

src: Lokhu-ke kuzakwenza ukuthi umsebenzi wemanganizi ususwe eenteyitjhini zeBhayi ne-Saldanha uyiswe esiTeyitjhini semiKhumbi seNgqura.
tgt: Izwi zwi ḓo vhanga u pfuluswa ha mishumo ya manganese u bva vhuimangalavha ha Port Elizabeth na Saldanha u ya kha Ngqura.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele iSewula Afrika ukuthi ivumele isiVumelwana somnyaka wee-2010 sokuThwala iCala nesokuLilisa ngoMonakalo wePahla eKhanjiswa ngeLwandle ukube iyiNgozi neTjhefu.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela Afrika Tshipembe u tenda kha Muṱangano wa Dzitshakhatshakha wa Milandu na Mbadelo dza Tshinyalelo dzi Tshimbilelanaho na Khwalo ya Zwithu zwa khombo na zwithu zwivhi lwanzheni wa 2010.Muṱangano uyu u vhona uri hu vhe na ndambedzo kha tshinyalelo ya vhathu na ndaka, mbadelo dza u kunakisa na maitele a u vhuedzedza, na ndozwo ya ikonomi yo vhangwaho nga vhuendi ha maḓanzheni vhu tshimbidzaho zwithu zwa khombo na zwithu zwivhi zwine zwi nga tshikafhadza lwanzhe.

src: Isivumelwanesi siqinisekisa ukuthi kuba khona abaliliswa ngakho abantu nepahla lokhuya nakunomonakalo owenzekileko, neendleko zokuhlwengisa nezokubuyisela izinto ebujameni obujayelekileko, neendleko zokulahlekelwa kezomnotho ezibangwa zizinto eziyingozi neziyitjhefu ezikhanjiswa ngelwandle, ezingahle zisalaphaze ilwandle.
tgt: Afrika Tshipembe ḽi ḓo kona u swikelela tshikwama u thusa kha zwithu zwa khombo na nyimele ya zwithu zwivhi nga murahu ha musi maitele a phalamennde oṱhe a u sedza mafhungo a muṱangano uyu o no fhedziwa.

src: Imithethomlingwa IKhabinethi ivumele ukudluliselwa ePalamende komThethomlingwa wee-2015 wokuTjhugulula umThetho wezamaFilimu nezemiTlolo.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela mukumedzo wa Mulayotibe wa Khwiniso wa Khanḓiso na Dzifiḽimu wa 2015 Phalamenndeni.

src: UmThethomlingwa lo utjhugulula umThetho wezamaFilimu nezemiTlolo we-1996 (umThetho 65 we-1996).Amatjhuguluko la avulela indima yetuthuko yetheknoloji, khulukhulu ikundla yethungelelwano neyecociswano lomphakathi, kobanyana kuzokuvikeleka abantwana emilayezweni eyingozi, elimazako nephazamisako kizo zoke iinkundla (eziphathekako nezethungelelwano).UmThethomlingwa lo uqinisa imisebenzi ethweswe amathungelelwano angakanzinzi ndawonye kunye neenhlangano ezilawula amathungelelwanothintwano we-inthanethi, ngomnqopho wokuvikela umphakathi nabantwana nabasebenzisa amathungelelwano la.
tgt: Mulayotibe u khwinisa Mulayo wa Khanḓiso na Dzifiḽimu wa 1996 (Mulayo 65 wa 1996).

src: IBandla eliLawula zokuThintana (i-ICASA) angeze lamnikela ilayisense namkha limvuselelele ilayisense umuntu lingakatholi ubufakazi obuvela eBhodini yezamaFilimu nezemiTlolo, obufakazela ukuthi umuntu loyo nangambala ukhambisana nayo yoke ngokupheleleko imithetho elawula nephethwe ngiyo leBhodi emsebenzini wayo.
tgt: Khwiniso idzi dzi tendelana na u bvela phanḓa ha thekinoḽodzhi, zwihulusa kha inthanethe na luvhanḓe lwa vhudavhidzani ha ṱhingo, u itela u tsireledza vhana kha u ṱanelwa zwithu zwi sa takadzi na nyanḓadzamafhungo i re khombo kha mbanḓe idzi.

src: UMengameli uZuma uzokuya emHlanganweni weenKhulu zeHlanganisela yokuThuthukiswa kwamaZwe ase-Afrika eseSewula (i-SADC), ongowama-35, ukusukela mhlana ali-17 ukuyokufika mhlana ali-18 kuRhoboyi e-Gaborone, e-Botswana.
tgt: Mulayotibe u khwaṱhisa mishumo yo tetshelwaho vhaḓisi vha vhuṱumani ha ṱhingo na vhaṋetshedzi vha tshumelo ya inthanethe u tsireledza tshitshavha na vhana nga tshifhinga tsha tshumiso ya tshumelo yavho.

src: Kilomhlangano weenkhulu, uMengameli uyokudlulisa isikhundla sikaSihlalo wePhiko lezePolitiki, zokuVikela nokuVikeleka.
tgt: Maanḓalanga a Vhudavhidzani o Ḓiimisaho a Afrika Tshipembe ha nga ṋei ṱhanziela kana mvusuludzo ya ṱhanziela hu so ngo thoma ha khwaṱhisedzwa arali ho tevhelwa mulayo nga vhuḓalo u bva kha Bodo ya Khanḓiso na Fiḽimu.

src: Kilesisikhundla, iSewula Afrika beyidosa phambili iinQhema ezintandathu zabaBekilihlo beKhetho be-SADC, ezifakazele ukuthi woke amakhetho akhe abanjwa ngaphasi kwelihlo lazo abe nganokuthula nathembekileko.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo dzhenela Samithi Zwayo ya vhu 35 ya Madendele a Mivhuso ya Tshitshavha tsha Mveledziso tsha Tshipembe ha Afrika (SADC) u bva nga dzi 17 u ya kha dzi 18 Ṱhangule 2015 ngei Gaborone, kha ḽa Botswana.

src: ISekela likaMengameli uRamaphosa uzokuthatha iVakatjho lomSebenzi lokuya eJapan ukusukela mhlana ama-24 ukuyokufika mhlana ama-25 kuRhoboyi.
tgt: Kha samithi iyo, Muphuresidennde vha ḓo vhuedzedza mushumo wa u vha mudzulatshidulo wa Dzangano ḽa SADC kha Polotiki, Vhupileli na Nyanḓano ya Tsireledzo.

src: Kilelivakatjho, uRamaphosa uzayokulotjhisa noNdunakulu we-Japan u-Shinzo Abe , abe ahlanganyele nemHlanganweni wokubonisa ngezamaBhizinisi wokuRhwebelana hlangana kweSewula Afrika ne-Japan.
tgt: Kha mushumo uyu, Afrika Tshipembe ḽo ranga phanḓa Vhurumiwa ha Vhulavhelesi ha Dzikhetho dza rathi dza SADC, he ha ṱanziela uri khetho dzoṱhe dzo vha dza mulalo nahone dzo tshimbila zwavhuḓi.

src: IKhabinethi iyalithokozela ivakatjho lomsebenzi le-Japan, elizakuqinisa ubungani nokuzwana okukhona hlangana kwamazwe amabili la, iSewula Afrika ne-Japan.
tgt: Mufarisa Muphuresidennde Vho Ramaphosa vha ḓo fara lwendo lwa madalo a tshiofisi a u shuma ngei Japan u bva nga dzi 24 u ya kha dzi 25 Ṱhangule 2015.

src: Amazwe amabili la godu abuye abe nemibono ekhambelanako ngokuqakatheka kwesidingo sokutjhugulula umKhandlu wezokuPhepha weHlangano yeenTjhaba eziBumbeneko kunye nehlelo lalehlangano ekuHlanganeni kweBandla eliVamileke leHlangano yeenTjhaba eziBumbeneko kwama-70 ngenyanga ezako.
tgt: Madalo aya a katela u dalela Prime Minister Vho Shinzo Abe na u shela mulenzhe kha Semina ya Vhubindudzi ha Nnḓa ya Madzangano a Mabindu a Afrika Tshipembe na Japan.

src: UMengameli uZuma uzokubiza iMbizo yobeNgameli e-Eersterust, ePitori mhlana ama-21 kuRhoboyi wee-2015 kobanyana ayokukhuluma ngemiraro ephathelene nokusetjenziswa kweendakamizwa.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱanganedza madalo a u. shuma a uya Japan, ane a ḓo khwaṱhisa vhukonani na u pfesesana hune ha vha hone vhukati ha mashango aya mavhili.

src: UmTlamo oPheleleko weenDakamizwa eliZweni lOke wee-2013-2017, ulungelela imizamo karhulumende yokulwa nomukghwa wokuphila ngotjwala newokuphila ngeendakamizwa.
tgt: Afrika Tshipembe na Japan a na muhumbulo muthihi kha ndeme ya nyambedzano dza vhanzhi na ṱhoḓea ya u khwinisa Khoro ya Tsireledzo ya Vhuthihi ha Dzitshakha (UN) na sisiṱeme ya UN ngei kha Buthano ḽa Guṱe ḽa UN ḽa vhu 70 ṅwedzi u ḓaho.

src: IKhabinethi ibawa boke abantu ukuthi basebenzisane ngokulekelelana norhulumende neemphathimandla zomthetho kobanyana kuzokucithwa imikghwa yeendakamizwa, eyona ibangela imiraro eminengi emphakathini, ekubalwa hlangana nayo nenturhu phezu kwabantu abasikazi nabantwana kunye nokukhahlunyezwa kwabantwana.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo ya kha Imbizo ya Muphuresidennde ngei Eersterust, kha ḽa Pretoria nga dzi 21 Ṱhangule 2015 u tandulula mafhungo a re na vhushaka na tshumiso mmbi ya zwidzidzivhadzi.

src: Ababelethi kunye nabakhulisi babantwana bathwele umsebenzi oqakatheke khulu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bakhuliseka kuhle bavikelekile.
tgt: Pulane Khulwane ya Zwidzidzivhadzi ya Lushaka ya 2013-2017, i pfananya nungo dza muvhuso kha nndwa yawo ya zwikambi na tshumiso mmbi ya zwidzidzivhadzi.

src: IKhabinethi ithokozela ukuvulwa kwesikolo iMakgatho Lewanika Mandela Primary esakhiwe savuselelwa eMvezo, ePumalanga Kapa, savulwa nguMengameli Zuma mhlana ama-25 kuRhoboyi wee-2015.Isikolwesi siyingcenye yomsebenzi karhulumende oragako wokubuyisa isithunzi sabafundi ngokwakha iinkolo eendaweni zemakhaya ngezakho zesimodeni.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo zwitshavhani uri zwi shume na muvhuso na mazhendedzi a tsireledzo ya mulayo u fhelisa tshumiso mmbi ya zwidzidzivhadzi zwitshavhani, zwine ndi zwone zwivhangi zwa tshivhalo tsha thaidzo dza matshilisano, hu tshi katelwa na pfudzungule kha vhafumakadzi na u tambudzwa ha vhana.

src: Bekube khathesi, i-ASIDI seyiqede iinkolo ezili-116 yafakela amanzi eenkolweni ezima-449, yathoma amahlelo wokuhlwengisa eenkolweni ezima-425, yafakela igezi eenkolweni ezima-298.
tgt: Vhabebi na vhaunḓi vha na mushumo wa ndeme une vha tea u ita u vhona uri vhana vho tsireledzea na u londotwa.

src: ISekela likaMengameli uRamaphosa uzokuya eKhongresini yamaZwe ngamaZwe yamaBulungelo weeNcwadi nezokwAzisa eyokubanjelwa e—Cape Town International Convention Centre ukusukela mhlana ali-15 ukuyokufika mhlana ama-21 kuRhoboyi wee-2015, ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “AmaBulungelo WeeNcwadi AmaJadu: Ukufikeleleka, Ituthuko NeTjhuguluko.”Ikhongresi le ithomana nomsebenzi karhulumende wokuvula amabulungelo weencwadi angaphezulu kwe-1000 kilo loke ilizweli ukusuke mhlana ali-18 kuVelabahlinze wee-2015 ukuyokufika mhlana ali-18 kuVelabahlinze wee-2016, anqophe ukukhuthaza abafundi ukukhuthalela ukufunda.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱanganedza u vulwa ha Tshikolo tsha Phuraimari tsha Makgato Lewanika Mandela tsho khwinifhadzwaho nga huswa ngei Mvezo hune ha vha Kapa Vhubvaḓuvha nga dzi 25 Ṱhangule 2015 nga Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma.

src: UmNyango wezeFundo esiSekelo usasoma neenhlangano zamabhizinisi wangeqadi ezimbadlwana kunye neenhlangano ezingasizombuso ezimbadlwana ukuthi zisekele ijima lamabulungelo weencwadeli ngokuphisana ngeencwadi nangokwakha amabulungelo weencwadi, hlangana nokhunye.
tgt: Tshikolo itshi ndi tshipiḓa tsha mushumo une wa khou bvela phanḓa wa muvhuso u vhuisa tshirunzi kha vhagudi na u ṋea zwikolo zwa vhuponi ha mahayani zwishumiswa zwa tshizwinozwino.

src: IKhabinethi ibawa ababelethi nabotitjhere ukulinga ukwenza iincwadi zitholakale ebantwini abatjha, kanti godu ubawa nomphakathi ukuthi unikele ngeencwadi ube uvule neenqhema zokufunda, ngoba phela isitjhaba esifundako sitjhaba esiphumelelako.
tgt: Nga kha Maitele a Nḓisedzo ya Themamveledziso ya Zwikolo yo Engedzwaho (ASIDI) ya Muhasho wa Pfunzo ya Mutheo, muvhuso wo thutha tshivhalo tsha zwikolo zwi so ngo fhaṱwaho zwavhuḓi nahone wa sika vhupo ha khwine ha u gudela.

src: UNgqongqotjhe wezokuVakatjha u-Derek Hanekom uzokuvula iNyanga yezeVakatjho mhlana ali-16 kuRhoboyi wee-2015 e-Euphoria Golf Estate, e-Mookgophong, eLimpopo, ngaphasi kommongondaba othi: “Asigidi Amathuba Amatjha Alindileko”, lommongondaba-ke ususelwa kummongondaba weLanga LezeVakatjho LePhasi LOke (27 kuKhukhulamungu ), othi: “Ibhiliyoni Yeemvakatjhibukeli – Ibhiliyoni Yamathuba.”Imimmongondaba yamazwe ngamazawe neyalapha ekhethu le inqophe ukuphandlulula iimvakatjhibukeli ngokuqakatheka kwevakatjhobukelo elinokuziphendulela.
tgt: U swika zwino, ASIDI yo no fhedza zwikolo zwa 116 nahone ya ṋetshedza maḓi kha zwikolo zwa 499, vhuthathatshili kha zwikolo zwa 425 na muḓagasi kha zwa 298.

src: Njengengcenye yalokhu, iimvakatjhibukeli zikhuthazwa ukuthi zihloniphe amasiko, zivikele amafa aligugu, zibabalele igezi namanzi, kanti ngaphezu kwakho koke, zithenge ipahla yekhethwapha kobanyana kuzokusekeleka imisebenzi yalapha ekhethu.
tgt: Mufarisa Muphuresidennde Vho Ramaphosa vha ḓo dzhenela Muṱangano wa Feḓeresheni ya Dzitshakatshaka wa Madzangano a Ḽaiburari na Mafhungo a Ḽifhasi une ya ḓo farelwa Ḓoroboni ya Kapa ngei International Convention Centre u bva nga dzi 15 u swika dzi 21 Ṱhangule 2015 fhasi ha thero ine ya ri : “Ḽaiburari dzo Dziaho: Tswikelelo, Mveledziso na Tshanduko”.

src: IKhabinethi ikhuthaza amaSewula Afrika ukuthi aziphe isikhathi sokukhamba avakatjha abukele ubuhle belizwe lekhethu, ngaleyindlela azabe alekelela ukusekela imisebenzi nokusekela ipahla yalapha ekhethu.
tgt: Muṱangano u khou tshimbilelana na u thomiwa ha ḽaiburari dza zwikolo dzi fhiraho 1 000 shangoni ḽoṱhe nga muvhuso vhukati ha dzi 18 Fulwana 2015 na dzi 18 Fulwana 2016 u ṱuṱuwedza vhagudi vhanzhi uri vha vhale.

src: UmNyango wezemiDlalo nezokuziThabisa nomNyango wezaboMma sewenze isivumelwano sokusebenzisana ne-G-sport ukuthokozisa nokuhlonipha abantu abasikazi beSewula Afrika abasemidlalweni.
tgt: Muhasho wa Pfunzo ya Fhasi u khou ṱuṱuwedza madzangano a mabindu a phuraivethe o fhambanaho na madzangano a si a muvhuso u tikedza fulo iḽi nga u ṋetshedza dzibugu na u thoma dziḽaiburari, vhukati ha zwiṅwe zwa zwithu.

src: UmNyango wezemiDlalo nezokuziThabisa kunye ne-G-Sport bazokuhlonipha abadlali abasikazi abalungele nabafanele kuhlonitjhwa, nabaphathi bemidlalo abasiphalaze ngitjho nanyana babegandelelwe kangangani, kodwa baphumelela ukuphakamisa iflarha lelizwe lekhethu.
tgt: Khabinethe i khou humbela vhabebi na vhagudisi u lingedza uri vha ite uri bugu dzi swikelelee kha vhaswa vhashu, na u ita khuwelelo kha zwitshavha u ṋetshedza dzibugu na u thoma zwigwada zwa u vhala ngauri lushaka lu vhalaho ndi lushaka lu kundaho.

src: UmNyango wezemiDlalo usawulimuka nomsebenzi osafunekako wokuraga nokuphumelelisa ihlelo lokulinganiswa kwabo boke abantu abasikazi abasemidlalweni, kezokuphatha nekudlaleni.
tgt: Minisiṱa wa Vhuendelamashango Vho Derek Hanekom vha ḓo rwela ṱari Ṅwedzi wa Vhuendelamashango nga dzi 16 Ṱhangule 2015 ngei Euphoria Golf Estate, Mookgophong kha ḽa Limpopo fhasi ha thero: “Zwikhala zwi swa zwa miḽioni zwire hone”, ine ya bva kha Ḓuvha ḽa Vhuendelamashango ḽa Ḽifhasi (27 Khubvumedzi) thero: “Vhaendelamashango vha Bilioni nthihi – Zwikhala zwa Biḽioni nthihi”.

src: Njengoba umNyango wezemiDlalo ulimuka nje ukuthi usese mnengi umsebenzi ekusafuze bona wenziwe malungana nalokhu, ngahlanye uzibophelele ukubambana ngezandla nalabo abancamele ukwenza umehluko emtlhagweni wabomma.
tgt: Thero dza dzitshakhatshakha na thero dzapo dzi na ndivho ya u ita uri vhaendelamashango vha ḓivhe nga ha ndeme ya vhuendelamashango vhu na vhuḓifhinduleli.

src: IKhabinethi ikhuthaza woke amaSewula Afrika ukuthi aphakamise amabizo wabantu abangethweswa aboNongorwana beliZwe ngomnyaka wee-2016, ekubonongorwana abaphezulu kinabo boke iSewula Afrika ebethwesa izakhamuzi zayo namaphandle enze umsebenzi oqakatheke khulu ekuthuthukiseni ihlelo ledemokhrasi, nababe negalelo elihle khulu ekwenzeni ipilo yamaSewula Afrika ibe ngcono khulu.
tgt: Sa tshipiḓa tsha izwi, vhaendelamashango vha ṱuṱuwedzwa u ṱhonifha mvelele, u tsireledza vhufa, u vhulunga fulufulu na maḓi, tshiṅwe hafhu tsha ndeme, u renga zwibveledzwa u itela u tikedza mishumo yapo.

src: LababoNongorwana beliZwe abathandathu, yi-Order of Mendi for Bravery, i- Order of Ikhamanga, i-Order of the Baobab, i-Order of Luthuli, i-Order of Mapungubwe, kunye ne-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo.
tgt: Khabinethe i ṱuṱuwedza maAfrika Tshipembe u tandula shango ḽashu ḽi takadzaho ḽa manakanaka, nga u ita zwenezwo zwi thusa uri vhathu vha dzule vhe na mishumo nahone hu khou tikedzwa zwibveledzwa zwapo.

src: Ilanga lokuvala ukwamukela iimphakamiso zamabizo wabantu abafanelwe kukwethweswa abonongorwana kumhlana amalanga ama-31 kuRhoboyi wee-2015.
tgt: Muhasho wa zwa mitambo na vhuḓimvumvusi na wa vhafumakadzi i kha vhuḽedzani na G-Sport u itela u ṱhonifha vhafumakadzi vha Afrika Tshipembe vhane vha shela mulenzhe kha mitambo.

src: Amaforomo ungawathola ku- WEBTOKEN , kanti-ke kufuze bona iforomo ngalinye liphekelelwe likhasi linye elisekela ukuthi kubayini umuntu ibizo lakhe eliphakanyiswako afanelwe kuthweswa unongorwana.
tgt: Muhasho wa zwa Mitambo na Vhuḓimvumvusi na G-Sport i ḓo ṋea miṅene vhafumakadzi vho teaho vha vhagidimi na vhalanguli vhe vha kunda nḓila dzoṱhe dza u tsikeledzwa vha imisa fulaga ya ḽino shango.

src: UkuqatjhwaUkuqatjhwa koke kulawulwa kufakazeleka kweencwadi zefundo ezikhambisana nomsebenzi umuntu aqatjhelwe wona kunye nokuhlanjululwa kwegama lomuntu okufaneleko.
tgt: Muhasho u ḓo dzula u tshi humbula mushumo u ṱoḓeaho uri u bveledze adzhenda ya u eḓanyiswa ha vhafumakadzi vhoṱhe vha dzhenelaho kha zwa mitambo, vhulangi na u shela mulenzhe.

src: Amalungu angasiseenkhundleni zokuphatha eBhodini yezePoso yeSewula Afrika.
tgt: Zwenezwi muhasho u tshi khou dzhiela nṱha uri mushumo munzhi u kha ḓi fanela u itwa kha sia iḽi, wo ḓi kumedzela u farana nga zwanḓa na vhane vho ḓiṋetshedzela u ḓisa phambano kha nyimele iyi i si yavhuḓi ya vhafumakadzi.

src: IKhabinethi yemukele ukuthoma kokusebenza ngokuzeleko kwe-Unit 6 yesiTetjhi seGezi i-Medupi eLephalale, eLimpopo nokunikela kwayo ngamamegawathi wegezi (ama-MW) ama-800 kusiphehligezi selizwe.
tgt: Khabinethe yo ṱanganedza Yuniti 6 ya Tshiṱitshi tsha Fulufulu tsha Medupi ngei Lephalale kha ḽa Limpopo, tsho kona u thoma u shuma tshoṱhe na u shela mulenzhe nga u ṋea 800 megawatts (MW) wa fulufulu kha giridi ya Lushaka.

src: IPhrojekthi ye-Medupi Power Station iliziko lokuphelhla igezi elivumelana nokutlhogonyelwa kweBhoduluko elinamayunithi asithandathu elinekghono lokuphehla amamegawathi alinganiselwa kwazii-4 764 MUMengameli u-Jacob Zuma uzakuhloma iyunithi le mhla ama- 30 kuRhoboyi 2015.Ukwakhiwa kwe- Medupi Power Station kwathoma ngoMrhayili wee-2007 kanti kulindelwe kobana amayunithi la asithandathu asebenze engcenyeni yokuthoma enyakeni wee- 2019.
tgt: Thandela ya Tshiṱitshi tsha Fulufulu tsha Medupi ndi ḽimaga ḽa fulufulu i itwaho nga malasha kha fhethu he ha vha hu songo bvelela lwa makwevho hune ha vha na yuniti dza rathi dzine dzi vhewa maimoni ane ṱhanganyelo yadzo ndi 4 764 MW ya maanḓa o dzheniswaho afho.

src: Nasele izikweli liphelile ukwakhiwa lizakuba ngelesine kamakhulu nelingelikhulu kapholiswa umtjhiso ngomoya ephasini.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Jacob Zuma vha ḓo rwela ṱari yuniti iyi nga dzi 30 Ṱhangule 2015.U fhaṱwa ha Tshṱitshi tsha Fulufulu ngei Medupi ho thomiwa nga Shundunthule 2007 nahone yuniti dzoṱhe dza rathi dzi khou lavhelelwa u vha dzi khou shuma vhukati ha ṅwaha wa 2019.

src: Isitetjhi lesi singaphila iminyaka ema-50.I-Unit 6 yalungelelaniswa kokuthoma kusiphehligezi senarha mhla amabili kuNtaka enyakeni lo begodu beyisokhu ifakela igezi kusiphehligezi selizwe nofana kunini lokha nagade silungiselwa ukuhlolelwa ukusebenza ngokuzeleko.
tgt: Musi tsho no fhela, tshi ḓo vha tshiṱitshi tshihulwanesa tsha vhuṋa tsha fulufulu ya malasha nahone tshihulwanesa tshine tsha shumisa maḓi a rothodzwaho nga phaiphi a sa ḓimuwi kha ḽifhasi.

src: Ngesikhatheso i-Unit-6 ikghonile ukuphungula ubudisi obuthwelwe lithungelelwano legezi ngelizweni, nokusiza ukukhandela ukwabiwa kwegezi okulinganisiweko nanyana kunciphise umthelela omkhulu wokwabelana ngegezi.
tgt: Tsho pulanelwa u vha na vhutshilo ha u shuma ha miṅwaha ya 50.Yuniti 6 yo ṱumanywa na giridi ya lushaka nga ḽa 2 Ṱhafamuhwe lwa u thoma ṋaṅwaha nahone i khou ḓisa muḓagasi kha giridi ya lushaka nga zwiṱuku nga zwiṱuku ngeno hu tshi kha ḓi itwa ndingo khatsho tshifhinga tshoṱhe.

src: Ukusebenza ngokuzeleko kweyunithi le kufikelelwe ngesikhathi esibekiweko seenyanga ezisithandathu ngemva kokulungelelaniswa kokuthoma.
tgt: Nga hetshino tshifhinga Yuniti 6 yo ḓi kona u thusa u bvisa mutsiko une wa vha hone kha sisiṱeme ya muḓagasi ya lushaka, i tshi khou thusa nga u fhungudza uri hu sa vhe na u tsiṅwa ha muḓagasi kana hone u tou fhungudza kha maitele a u tsima muḓagasi.

src: Ukusebenza ngokuzeleko kwe-Unit 6 yesitetjhi seGezi i-Medupi kuyipumelelo etlhogekako emizameni yethu yokwakha ikghono elitjha lokuphehla igezi.
tgt: Mashumele a yuniti o swikelelwa, nahone nga tshifhinga tshe yuniti ya vha yo tetshelwa tsha miṅwedzi ya rathi nga murahu ha u ṱumanywa na giridi ya lushaka.

src: IKhabinethi ibuye yatjheja iinqabo inarha eqalene nazo ekusatjalalisweni kwegezi.
tgt: Mashumele a Yuniti 6 a Tshiṱitshi tsha Fulufulu tsha Medupi ndi zwiṅwe zwa ndeme zwo swikelelwaho kha nungo dza u fhaṱa zwiṱitshi zwiswa zwa fulufulu.

src: Nofana ukwabelana ngegezi kungasibujamo obukarisako, i-Eskom izibophelele ukutjheja ukuphogola okungapheliko kweentetjhi zethu ngaphandle kokuphazamisa khulu ukunikelwa kwegezi.
tgt: Khabinethe yo isa phanḓa u ṱanganedza mutsiko ure hone une shango ḽa vha khawo wa nḓisedzo ya fulufulu.

src: NgoMvulo weveke ezako, (mhla ama-31 kuRhoboyi), i-Unit 2 ye-Koeberg Power Station ngeTjhingalanga Kapa izokuvalelwa ukutjhejwa okuhleliweko.
tgt: Musumbuluwo u ḓaho (wa dzi 31 Ṱhangule), Yuniti 2 ya Tshiṱitshi tsha Fulufulu tsha Koeberg ngei kha ḽa Kapa Vhukovhela tshi ḓo dziṅwa hu tshi itelwa ndugiselo dzo pulanelwaho.

src: Kulindeleke kobana iyunithi le ithome ukusebenza ngemva kweenyanga ezintathu.
tgt: Yuniti i khou lavhelelwa u dovha hafhu ya shuma nga murahu ha miṅwedzi miraru.

src: Ukuvalwa okuhleliweko lokhu kwe-Koeberg Unit 2 kuyingcenye yehlelo elijayelekileko le-Eskom lokutjheja iintetjhi zayo zegezi.
tgt: U valwa uhu ho pulanelwaho ha Yuniti 2 ya Koeberg ndi tshipiḓa tsha Eskom tsha mbekanyamushumo ya u lugisa zwiṱitshi zwoṱhe zwa fulufulu.

src: Qobe eenyangeni ezili-16 ukuya kezili-18, iyunithi eyodwa kamabili la e-Koeberg iyavalwa kobana ifakelwe amafutha, ukuhlolwa nokutjhejwa.
tgt: Miṅwedzi miṅwe na miṅwe ya 16 u ya kha 18, iṅwe na iṅwe ya yuniti mbili dza ngei Koeberg i a valwa u itela u shela hafhu mapfura, u ṱolwa na u lugiswa.

src: Ukuvalwa lokhu okuhlala kwenziwa kuhlelwa ngendlela yokukhandela kobana amayunithi la angajanyiswa ngasikhathi sinye ukubalekela iinyanga zobusika qobe nyaka.
tgt: Nḓowelo iyi ya u tsima i tou pulanelwa u itela u thivhela uri yuniti dzoṱhe vhuvhili hadzo dzi sa vhe na thaidzo nga tshifhinga tshithihi na u thivhela miṅwedzi ya vhuriha ṅwaha muṅwe na muṅwe.

src: Nofana sineragelophambili ekuthuthukiseni ukuphehlwa kwegezi, iKhabinethi ikhombela amaSewula Afrika ukuraga nokonga igezi.
tgt: Zwenezwi ri khou bvela phanḓa na mvelaphanḓa ya u khwinisa u engedzwa ha u magwa ha muḓagasi, Khabinethe i khou ita khuwelelo kha maAfrika Tshipembe uri vha ise phanḓa na u shumisa muḓagasi nga vhulondo.

src: Umhlangano weenHloko zemiBuso noRhulumende.
tgt: Samithi ya Vharangaphanḓa vha Mashango na Mivhuso.

src: IKhabinethi yemukele imiphumela ebuya emHlanganweni oJayelekileko weenHloko zemiBuso noRhulumende wehlandla lama-35 weHlangano yokuThuthukisa imiPhakathi ese-Afrika engeSewula, lapho uMengameli u-Zuma gade adosa phambili isiqhema esijamele iSewula Afrika.
tgt: Khabinethe yo ṱanganedza mvelelo dza Samithi Zwayo ya Vharangaphanḓa vha Mashango na Mivhuso ya vhu 35 ya Tshitshavha tsha Mveledziso ya Tshipembe ha Afrika (SADC), he Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ranga phanḓa vhurumelwa ha Afrika Tshipembe.

src: Umhlangano wemukele iHlelo elibuyelelweko leQhinga leTuthuko yesiFunda se-SADC lika-2015 ukuya ku-2020.
tgt: Samithi yo ṱanganedza khwiniso ya Pulane ya Mveledziso ya Tshiṱirathedzhi tsha Ndivhiso ya Dzingu ya 2015-2020.

src: Umhlangano ubuye watlikitla iimvumelwanokambiso ezintathu ezizakukghonakalisa isifunda se-SADC ukuqalana neentjhijilo eziqakathekileko zokutlhayela kwemisebenzi nokupheliswa komtlhago ngendlela eneragelophambili.
tgt: Thendelano ya u khwinisa Maitele nga ha Polotiki, Vhupileli na Nyanḓano ya Tsireledzo (Maitele) na Thendelano ya u khwinisa Mulanga wa SADC (Mulanga) Thendelano idzi dzi ḓo tendela Vhupileli ha Dzitshakha na Komiti ya Tsireledzo ya Muraḓo kha Polotiki, Vhupileli na Nyanḓano ya Tsireledzo u shuma sa muṱangano wa pfananyo wa Vhurangaphanḓa ha Vhululamisi na Dzidzhele Tshipembe ha Afrika.

src: Isivumelwano esikhibelela iKambiso yezePolitiki, itjhebiswano lezokuVikela nokuPhepha (ikambiso) nesiVumelwano esikhibelela isiVumelwano se-SADC (isivumelwano).
tgt: Nḓivhadzo nga ha Mveledziso ya Vhaswa na u Maanḓafhadza i sumbedza nyimele ya shishi ya mveledziso ya vhaswa na u maanḓafhadza nga kha nyanḓano ya dzingu, muṱanganelano, mveledziso na mulalo, na tsireledzo kha dzingu.

src: Iimvumelwano lezi zizakuvumela iKomiti yezokuVikela nokuPhepha eHlanganisa imiBuso yePhiko lezePolitiki ukusebenza njengeforamu yokuhlanganisa abaPhathi bamaziko wokuBuyiswa kweemilo nemaJele we-Afrika engeSewula.
tgt: Maitele nga ha Tshumelo ya Mbambadzo ndi u ṱhonifha mbambadzo ngomu ha miraḓo ya SADC kha tshumelo ho sedzwa u sika maraga muthihi wa tshumelo kha dzingu.

src: Isimemezelo sokuThuthukiswa kweLutjha nokulinikela amandla sitjengisa ukuqakatheka nokurhabeka kwetjhejo lokuthuthukisa ilutjha nokulinikela amandla ngokusebenzisa itjhebiswano leemfunda ze-SADC, ukuhlanganyela, ituthuko, ukuthula nokuphepha esifundeni se-SADC.
tgt: U ṱanganedzwa ha Pulane yo Vusuludzwaho ya Mveledziso ya Tshiṱirathedzhi tsha Ndivhiso ya Dzingu ya 2015-2020 ḽo vha ḽiga ḽihulu kha ndingo dza SADC dza u ṱuṱuwedza mbambadzo ngomu ha dzingu.

src: Ikambiso mayelana nemiSebenzi yokuRhwebelana ngomnqopho wokukhulula ukurhwebelana kwamazwe we-SADC ngomnqopho wokuvula imakethe eyodwa eqalene nemisebenzi yesifunda se-SADUkwamukelwa kweQhinga eliBuyekeziweko leTuthuko yesiFunda se-SADC lee-2015 ukuya ku-2020 kwaba yipumelelo eqakathekileko emzameni we-SADC wokuphumelelisa ukurhwebelana kwamazwe wesifunda se-SADC.
tgt: Khabinethe yo ṱanganedza hafhu tsheo ya muṱangano wa Masia Mararu Kavhili wa SADC, we wa farwa wo vhambelana na Samithi ya SADC wo dzhenelwaho nga Muthusa Muphuresidennde na Mutshimbidzi wa SADC Vho Cyril Ramaphosa, u khwaṱhisedza maitele a mashumele a Khomishini ya Ṱhoḓisiso ya SADC kha mafhungo a Muvhuso wa Lesotho.

src: IKhabinethi ibuye yemukela isiqunto somhlangano we -Double Troika ye-SADC ogade ubanjwe ngeqadi lokha kunomhlangano we-SADC okhanjelwe liSekela likaMengameli nomKghonakalisi we-SADC u-Cyril Ramaphosa, ukuqinisekisa amaphuzusebenzelo weKomitjhini ye-SADC ngomBuso weLesotho.
tgt: Khabinethe yo ṱanganedza madalo o tshimbilaho zwavhuḓi a Muthusa Muphuresidennde Vho Ramaphosa ngei Japan.

src: Ivakatjho leSekela likaMengameli e-Japan.
tgt: Vho vha vho fheletshedzwa nga vhurumelwa ha nṱha ha dziminisiṱa na vhoramabindu u ṱuṱuwedza Afrika Tshipembe sa hone hune vhathu vha fanela u takalela u bindudza hone.

src: IKhabinethi yemukele ivakatjho elibeyipumelelo leSekela likaMengameli uRamaphosa e-Japan.
tgt: Muthusa Muphuresidennde vho fulufhedzisa vhabindudzi vha Japan uri Afrika Tshipembe a ḽi na thaidzo ya u ita vhubindudzi nahone vha vha toololela nga ha vhudziki ha ikonomi yashu na vhupo ha mabindu ho teaho vhune vhathu vha nga bindudza khaho, zwihulusa kha tshumisano dzine dza sika mishumo.

src: Bekaphekelelwa bujameli obuphezulu babongqongqotjhe nabosomabubulo ukuyokukhangisa ngeSewula Afrika njengelizwe ekungasiswa kilo imali.
tgt: Muthusa Muphuresidennde Vho Ramaphosa vho dovha hafhu u shumisa madalo avho u wana vhuḓikumedzeli u bva kha ḽa Japan u ita vhuḽedzani na Afrika Tshipembe kha nungo dzaḽo dza u lwa na u phaḓalala ha HIV na AIDS, TB na Malaria.

src: ISekela likaMengameli liqinisekise abatjalimali be-Japan kobana iSewula Afrika ivule izandla begodu wabahlathululela ngobujamo nokunzinza kezomnotho welizwe nekghonakalo yobujamo obuvumela itjalomali, khulukhulu amabubulo layo avula imisebenzi.
tgt: Tsheo dza Khabinethe dza Ndeme.

src: ISekela likaMengameli u-Ramaphosa lasebenzisa ivakatjhweli ukufumana iimbopho zeJapan ukusebenzisana neSewula Afrika emzameni wayo wokukhandela umraro woMbulalasihlangu oBangela iNtumbantonga (i-HIV) neNtumbantonga (i-AIDS), ubuLwelwe besiFuba (i-TB) neMalariya.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela mukumedzo wa Afrika Tshipembe na Ḓorobo ya Durban wa u vha ṋemuḓi wa Mitambo ya Mulanganelano ya 2022.

src: IinQunto zeKhabinethi eziQakathekileko.
tgt: Izwi ndi lwa u thoma hune Afrika ḽa ḓo vha ṋemuḓi wa Mitambo ya Mulanganelano nahone zwi ḓo vhea Afrika Tshipembe sa fhethu ha vhuendelamashango ha mitambo na u ṋea hafhu zwikhala u itela Tshigwada tsha Afrika Tshipembe.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele umzamo weSewula Afrika neDorobha ye-Durban wokuba bonomnyanya wemiDlalo ye-Commonwealth yee-2022.
tgt: U vha ṋemuḓi zwi ḓo thusa u shumisa themamveledziso yo siiwaho nga Tshiphuga tsha Ḽifhasi tsha FIFA 2010™.Mitambo ya Mulanganelano ya 2022 i khou lavhelelwa u ḓisa masheleni a swikaho kha R20 biḽioni kha ikonomi, zwine musi zwi tshi fhindulelwa zwa amba nyengedzedzo ya R11 biḽioni kha nyaluwo ya GDKhabinethe yo tendela u ganḓiswa ha Muvhigo wa khalaṅwaha ya (2009-2014) wa Vhuṱanu wa Afrika Tshipembe nga ha U thomiwa ha Buthano ḽa u Fheliswa ha Zwivhumbeo zwoṱhe zwa Khethululo ya Vhafumakadzi ngomu kha Gurannḓa ya Muvhuso, u itela vhupfiwa ha vhathu.

src: Kungokokuthoma kobana i-Afrika inikelwe ithuba lokwamukela imiDlalo ye-Commonwealth begodu lokhu kuzakubeka iSewula Afrika ebujameni obuhle bokuqalwa njengelizwe lezamavakatjho wezemidlalo kunvulele nesiQhema seSewula Afrika amathuba.
tgt: Muvhigo u ṋea manweledzo a mashumele avhuḓi a milayo yo fhambanaho, mbekanyamaitele na mbekanyamushumo dzo thomiwaho Afrika Tshipembe na u sumbedza zwe zwa swikelelwa nga shango ḽashu kha u maanḓafhadza vhafumakadzi na u eḓanya mbeu.

src: Ukubamba imidlalo le kuzakusiza ngkusebenzisa umthangalasisekelo wamagugu weBhegere yePhasi ye-FIFA ka-2010™.ImiDlalo yeCommonwealth yee-2022 ilindelwe ukufukula umnotho ngamabhiliyoni ama-R20 okuzakungezelela ukukhula kwePahla ePheleleko yangeKhaya (i-GDP) ngamabhiliyoni ali-IKhabinethi ivumele ukukhutjhelwa emphakathini komBiko wesihlanu wesikhathi esibekiweko weSewula Afrika (wee-2009 ukuya kewee-2014) ngokuPhunyeleliswa kwesiVumelwano sokuPheliswa kwemiHlobo yoke yokuBandlululwa kwaboMma kuGazede kaRhulumende.
tgt: Muvhigo u dovha hafhu u dzhiela nṱha khaedu dzi sa fheli na zwikhukhulisi kha u kunda u sa eḓana na khethululo shangoni ḽashu.

src: Umbiko lo unikela ihlathululo efitjhazana ukusebenza ngamandla kwemithetho ehlukileko, imithethomgomo namahlelo aphunyeleliswa ngeSewula Afrika begodu iveza ipumelelo efikelelwe lilizwe ekunikelelni abomma amandla nokulingana ngobulili.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela Afrika Tshipembe u dzhenela Senthara ya Vhueletshedzi nga ha Mulayo wa Dzangano ḽa Mbambadzo ḽa Ḽifhasi (WTO) ngei Geneva.

src: Umbiko lo utshwaya iintjhijilo neenqabo ezingapheliko ekulwisaneni nokungalingani nebandlululo ngelizweni.
tgt: Iḽi ndi dzangano ḽa dzitshakhatshakha ḽine ḽa ṋea ngeletshedzo nga ha zwa mulayo kha milayo ya WTO, thikhedzo kha matshimbidzele a nzudzanyo dza phambano na vhupfumbudzi kha milayo ya WTO kha mashango ane a khou bvelela na ane a ha athu bvelela.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele iSewula Afrika ukuba yingcenye yeSentha yeenLuleko zomThetho eHlanganweni yeRhwebo yePhasi Loke (i-WTO) e-Geneva.
tgt: Afrika Tshipembe sa muraḓo ḽi ḓo kona u wana ngeletshedzo nga ha maga a mbambadzo o fanelaho a maṅwe mashango ane a kwama mbambadzelaseli ya Afrika Tshipembe na maga a mbambadzo ane Afrika Tshipembe ḽa khou ṱoḓa u a ḓivhadza.

src: Ihlangano le yeentjhabatjhaba inikela ukululeka ngezomthetho emthethweni we-WTO, isekele i-WTO nakunokurarana ngamatleyimu nokubandula amazwe asathuthukako nagakathuthuki ngomthetho we-WTO.
tgt: Senthara i nga thusa hafhu Afrika Tshipembe kha thandululo ya phambano ya milandu ya WTKhabinethe yo toololelwa nga ha Minisiṱa wa Gwama, Vho Nhlanhla Nene, vhane vha khou thoma mushumo wa u vha Muphuresidennde wa Khoro ya Dziminisiṱa dza Vhubvaḓuvha na Tshipembe ha Afrika ya Tshigwada tshi lwaho na Tshelede yo wanalaho nga nḓila i si yavhuḓi, lwa ṅwaha muthihi.

src: Njengelunga iSewula Afrika izakukghona ukukhombela iseluleko ngokukhambelana kweenqunto zokurhwebelana ezisetjenziswa ngamanye amazwe eziba nomthelela epahleni yeSewula Afrika ethunyelwa emazweni wangaphandle namagadango iSewula Afrika efuna ukuwethula.
tgt: Nga zwenezwo, Minisiṱa vha ḓo fara muṱangano wa luthihi nga ṅwaha wa 2015 wa khoro iyo.

src: Nhlanhla Nene, nakathatha isikhundla sokuba nguMengameli womKhandlu wesiQhema saboNgqongqotjhe bePumalanga ne-Afrika engeSewula esiLwisana nokuKhukhuthiswa kweeMali, okusikhundla azosibamba isikhathi sonyaka.
tgt: Dzangano iḽi ḽa tshumisano ya mivhuso ya dzingu ḽi ṱuṱuwedza u thomiwa ha maga a fanaho na u lwa na tshelede yo wanalaho nga nḓila i si yone na u lambedza nndwa dza polotiki tshipembe na vhubvaḓuvha ha dzingu ḽa Afrika ḽoṱhe.

src: Ngebangelo uNgqongqotjhe uzakuba ngusomnyanya womhlangano waqobe nyaka womkhandlu enyakeni wee-2015.Ihlangano le yesifunda eyihlanganyela yaborhulumende iphumelelisa ukusetjenziswa ngokufananako kwamagadango akhandela ukukhukhuthiswa kweemali nokusekelwa ngeemali amavukelambuso epumalanga nesewula ye-AfrikaUmnqopho wobulunga beSewula Afrika kukuqinisa amagadango ngesifundeni se-Afrika ekulwisaneni nokukhukhuthiswa kweemali ezisekela amavukelambuso nokuthuthukisa ukuphepha kwelizwe ngaphakathi nesifundeni se-Afrika.
tgt: Ndivho ya Afrika Tshipembe ya u vha muraḓo ndi u khwaṱhisa maga a dzingu a lwaho na tshelede yo wanalaho nga nḓila mmbi na u lambedzwa ha nndwa dza polotiki, zwine zwa ṱuṱuwedza tsireledzo ya lushaka shangoni ḽashu na kha dzingu.

src: IKhabinethi iyaraga nokunyefula ukubulawa kwamapholisa ngelunya.
tgt: Khabinethe i bvela phanḓa u sasaladza mabulayo a si na ṱhoho a vhaofisiri vha mapholisa.

src: IKhabinethi yenza ibizelo emphakathini ukusebenzisana nesipholisa ekubotjhweni kweenlelesi.
tgt: Khabinethe i ita khuwelelo kha miraḓo ya tshitshavha u shuma na mapholisa kha u thusa u fara vhavhangi vha mabulayo aya.

src: Ama-ejensi wezomthetho asebenza ubusuku nemini ukuqinisekisa kobana iinlelesezi ziyabotjhwa.
tgt: Khabinethe i livhuwa miraḓo ya tshitshavha vhe vha shela mulenzhe kha u farwa ha vhathu vhararu vha ṱumanywaho na mabulayo a mapholisa.

src: ImiThethomlingwa.
tgt: Milayotibe.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukuthunyelwa ngePalamende umThethomlingwa wemiSebenzi yezangaPhandle wee- 2015.UmThethomlingwa lo uvumela ukusetjenziswa kwehlelo linye lemiSebenzi yezangaPhandle begodu uvulela umthethomtlamo lapho imiSebenzi yangaPhandle yagadesi izakuphathwa ilawulwe mNyango wezeTjhebiswano leenTjhaba.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u kumedzwa ha Mulayotibe wa Tshumelo ya Zwannḓa, wa 2015 Phalamenndeni.

src: UmThethomlingwa uzakusetjenziswa ngokomThethomlingwa, imithetho esetjenziswako esebenza neminyangweni karhulumende begodu ikhambisana nokuqiniswa kokulethwa kwezenzelo ukuya ngokwe-NDP.
tgt: Mulayotibe uyu u ṋea sisiteme nthihi ya Tshumelo ya Zwannḓa na u sika muangarambo wa vhusimamilayo vhune ngaho Tshumelo ya Zwannḓa i ḓo langula na u vhetshelwa milayo nga Muhasho Vhushaka ha Dzitshakha na Nyanḓano.

src: Lokhu kuzakuqinisa ukusebenza ngepumelelo, ukuziphendulela nokonga ngokusebenzisa amathuba ngaphetjheya ukuthuthukisa umthethomgomo weSewula Afrika wezangaphandle ne-ajenda yezetuthuko.
tgt: Mulayotibe u ḓo shumiswa fhasi ha Ndayotewa, milayo i re hone i shumiswaho kha Tshumelo ya Tshitshavha, tshumelo ya tsireledzo nahone yo livhanywa na NDP kha u khwaṱhisa nḓisedzo ya tshumelo.

src: IKhabinethi ivumele ukwendlalwa ngePalamende komThethomlingwa wamaSiko noburholi bamaKhoisan wee- 2015.
tgt: Izwi zwi ḓo khwaṱhisa mashumele avhuḓi, vhuḓifhinduleli na tshumiso kwao ya masheleni ine ya dzhia zwikhala mashangoḓavha u isa phanḓa mbekanyamaitele ya dzithakha ya Afrika Tshipembe na adzhenda ya mveledziso.

src: Utjhukumisa ukutlanywa kweKomiti yeenLuleko eendabeni zamaKhoisan ezakusiza urhulumende ngomsebenzi lo wokwamukela nokuhlonipha imiphakathi yamaKhoisan nabarholi bayo.
tgt: Khabinethe yo tendela u kumedzwa uri hu haseledzwe ngaha Mulayotibe wa Vhurangaphanḓa ha Sialala na Khoisan, wa 2015 Phalamenndeni.

src: UMengameli uZuma uzakuhloma ePort Elizabeth mhla ama-28 kuRhoboyi enyakeni lo wee-2015 iprojekthi yePi elwisana nokuVuza kwaManzi, eyamenyezelwa eKulumeni yakhe yobuJamo beNarha enyakeni lo, njengengcenye yehlelo likarhulumende lokuqalana nokulahlekelwa mamanzi ngonobangela wokuvuza kwawo.
tgt: Mulayotibe u shela mulenzhe kha zwipikwa zwa ndeme NDP zwa u ṱanḓavhudza vhuthihi ha zwitshavha na mbumbano zwenezwi hu tshi khou tandululwa u sa eḓana ha kale nga u ṋea u dzhielwa nṱha ha zwitshavha zwa VhaKhoisan na vharangaphanḓa.

src: Iphrojekthi le izakubandula abantu abatjha abazii-15 000 bathwasele umsebenzi wezandla namaplamara balungise iimpompi ezivuzako emiphakathini yabo Lokhu kuzabanikela amakghonofundwa wokuthoma amabhizinisi wabo nanyana bafumane imisebenzi enqophileko.
tgt: U kumedza u thomiwa ha Komiti ya Vhueletshedzi nga ha mafhungo a VhaKhoisan ane a ḓo thusa muvhuso nga u dzhiela nṱha maitele a elanaho na zwitshavha zwa VhaKhoisan na vharangaphanḓa.

src: Sekuthonyiwe ngokuqatjha Isiqhema samathomo esizii-3 000 enyakeni wona lo weemali.
tgt: Mulayotibe u pfumbisa mulayo wa vhurangaphanḓa ha sialala ha lushaka u re hone une wa ḓo fhedza u tshi khou thutha Mulayo wa Vharangaphanḓa vha Sialala vha Nnḓu ya Lushaka, 2009 (Mulayo 22 wa 2009) na Mulayo wa Muhanga wa Vhuvhusi na Vhurangaphanḓa ha Sialala, 2003 (Mulayo 41 wa 2003).

src: Ukuvuza kwamanzi kungunobangela wokumotjheka kwamanzi ama-40% begodu ilizwe lilahlekelwa mabhiliyoni alikhomba ngonyaka.
tgt: Mbekanyamushumo dzine dza khou ḓa Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo rwela ṱari thandela ya Nndwa kha u Bvuḓa ha Maḓi, ye vha ḓivhadza kha Mulaedza wavho wa Lushaka nga 2015, ngei Port Elizabeth nga dzi 28 Ṱhangule 2015, sa tshipiḓa tsha mbekanyamushumo ya muvhuso ya u tandulula tshinyalelo ya maḓi i vhangwaho nga u bvuḓa.

src: UMengameli uZuma uzakukhambela umnyanya wama-70 wokuPheliswa kokuSahlelwa kweChina nePi yesiBili yePhasi ngeChina mhla ama-2 ukuya nakama-4 kuKhukhulamungu enyakeni lo wee-2015, begodu uzakubamba imikhulumiswano noMengameli u-Xi Jinping.
tgt: Thandela i ḓo pfumbudza vhaswa vha 15 000 sa vhashumi vha zwanḓa na pulambara u lugisa u bvuḓa ha phaiphi zwitshavhani zwa havho i ḓo vha ṋea zwikili uri vha kone u thoma mabindu avho kana vha wane mishumo yo teaho.

src: IKhabinethi yenza ibizelo kiwo woke amaSewula Afrika ukugidinga umlando wethu namasiko ahlukileko ngengalokha ilizwe lizabe lithoma iNyanga yamaGugu ingoKhukhulamungu ngaphasi kwesihloko esithi: “Ilwazi lethu ngesikhethu, amagugu wethu: Ukutshwaya, ukuphumelelisa nokongiwa kwamagugu weSewula Afrika”.Ukugidinga konyaka lo kuzakufaka imakethe yemikhangiso yesikhethu begodu imiphakathi iyakhuthazwa ukusebenzisa amagugu wabo njengokudla, ubukghwari bezandla, ukugida nombhino ukukhangisa ukwahlukana ngokwamasiko, amalungelo wobuntu, ukwakha isitjhaba nokuthuthukisa zomnotho.
tgt: U bvuda ha maḓi hu anganyelwa kha phesenthe dza 40 dza ndozwo ya maḓi nga lushaka nahone zwi ḓurela shango R7 biḽioni nga ṅwaha.

src: ISewula Afrika izakugidinga iNyanga yezeVakatjho ngoKhukhulamungu okusikhathi esihle semindeni kobana ivakatjhele iindawo zamagugu ngelizweni bakwazi ukuzikhumbuza ngokwakade.
tgt: Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma vha ḓo dzhenela Anivesari ya vhu 70 ya u Fheliswa ha Mugovhelo wa China na Nndwa ya Ḽifhasi ya Vhuvhili ngei kha Riphabuliki ya Vhathu ya China (PRC) u bva nga dzi 2 u ya kha dzi 4 Khubvumedzi 2015, nahone vha ḓo vha na nyambedzano dza vhavhili na Muphuresidennde Xi Jinping.

src: NgeNyanga yamaGugu, umNyango wezamaSiko nobuKghwari uzakubamba umnyanya wokuphendula isoyi eCabazini leenKutani zeLizwe Loke ngePitori ukuqinisekisa ukuthoma kokwakhiwa kwesikhumbuzo esizakutjengisa isikhathi sangaphambilini kokubuswa mbuso webandlululo, umzabalazo wekululeko neenkutani ezihlukileko ezalwela ituthuko yezehlalakuhle.
tgt: Vhushaka ha Afrika Tshipembe na PRC vhu kha maimo a Vhuḽedzani ha Maano ho Fhelelaho vhu tikedzwaho nga Thendelano ya Beijing nga ha u Thomiwa ha Vhuḽedzani ha Maano o Fhelelaho, ane a katela vhushaka hoṱhe vhukati ha mashango aya mavhili.

src: ILanga lokuGidinga imiSebenzi yesiPholisa seSewula Afrika (i-SAPS) laqobe nyaka mhla asiThandathu kuKhukhulamungu enyakeni wee-2015 e-Union Buildings ePitori lizakugidinga isibindi nokuzinikela kwamapholisa ahlongakalela emsebenzini lokha nakavikela umphakathi.
tgt: Khabinethe i ita khuwelelo kha maAfrika Tshipembe vhoṱhe u pembelela ḓivhazwakale yashu na u fhambana ha mvelele musi shango ḽashu ḽi tshi khou swika kha Ṅwedzi wa Vhufa nga Khubvumedzi fhasi ha thero ine ya ri: “Nḓivho yashu yapo, vhufa hashu: U ya kha u kona u topola, u ṱuṱuwedza na u vhulunga vhufa ha Afrika Tshipembe.”U humbula ha ṋaṅwaha hu ḓo itwa nga nḓila ya sialala nahone zwitshavha zwi khou ṱuṱuwedzwa u shumisa vhufa havho vhu vhune vha vhu ḓivha u fana na zwiḽiwa, vhuvhaḓi, mitshino na muzika u ṱuṱuwedza u fhambana ha mvelele, pfanelo dza vhathu, u fhaṱa lushaka na mveledziso ya ikonomi.

src: Ngehlelo le-SAPS lokuqatjha kuzakungezelelwa amalunga azii-6 252 enyakeni weemali wee-2015/16 ukuqinisa imisebenzi yabasetjhi, isipholisa somphakathi, zobuhloli bobulelesi ukuqinisa imisebenzi yabasetjhi, zeforensikhi, ukufaka hlangana zokuphepa nokuvikela.
tgt: Afrika Tshipembe ḽi ḓo pembelela Ṅwedzi wa Vhuendelamashango nga Khubvumedzi, zwine zwa vha tshifhinga tsha miṱa uri i dalele fhethu ha vhufa ha shango ḽashu uri vha kone u ḓiṱumanya na ḓivhazwakale yashu.

src: IKhabinethi yenza ibizelo ebantwini abatjha ukukhetha ibizelo le-SAPS elinikela amathuba amanengi.
tgt: Nga hoyu Ṅwedzi wa Vhufa, Muhasho wa Vhutsila na Mvelele u ḓo ita bembela ḽa sialala ngei kha Egere ya Vhahali vha Lushaka ngei Pretoria u sumbedza u thomiwa ha u fhaṱwa ha tshihumbudzo tsha lushaka tshine tsha ḓo ṱana misi ya phanḓa ha koloni, nndwa ya mbofholowo na vhahali vho fhambanaho vhe vha lwela mvelaphanḓa ya tshitshavha.

src: Ungafumana ilwazi elinabileko ku: WEBTOKEINyanga yemiNyango kaRhulumende izakubanjwa emiNyagweni kaRhulumende yoke ngoKhukhulamungu ngaphasi kwesihloko esithi “Ukuragela iSewula Afrika Phambili: UkuLetha ImiNyango kaRhulumende ebantwini”.Inyanga le izakutshwaya imisebenzi karhulumende, ukuzinikela, ukuzibophelela nepumelelo yokulethwa kwezenzelo emphakathini.
tgt: Ḓuvha ḽa tshihumbudzo ḽa Lushaka ḽa Tshumelo ya Mapholisa a Afrika Tshipembe (SAPS) ḽa ṅwaha nga dzi 6 Khubvumedzi 2015 ngei Union Buildings kha ḽa Pretoria hu ḓo pembelelwa mafulufulu na u ḓiimisela ha vhaofisiri vhe vha badela nga matshilo avho u tsireledza zwitshavha.

src: Kuzakunikelwa umbiko ngeragelophambili ngemva kwemihlangano yonyaka wee-2014 ngeminyango yombuso nemikhulumiswano nabasebenzi bombuso mayelana nokuvuselela indlela yokusebenza kwabasebenzi bakarhulumende.
tgt: Nga kha fulo ḽa u thola ḽa SAPS hu ḓo engedzwa miraḓo ya 6 252 nga ṅwaha wa muvhalelano wa 2015/16 u khwaṱhisa tshumelo ya vhufogisi, mapholisa a vhonalaho, vhuṱali ha vhugevhenga, tshumelo ya vhuṱoḓisisi, hu tshi katelwa na tshumelo ya vhutsireledzi na tsireledzo.

src: Umnyango karhulumende osebenza ngepumelelo usidingo esiqakathekileko sokuphumelelisa i-NDP begodu iKhabinethi yenza ibizelo kubasebenzi bombuso ukuzibophelela kabutjha ngemigomo ye-Batho Pele ngokunikela isizo lezinga eliphezulu, elongako neliphumelelako kiwo woke amaSewula Afrika.
tgt: Khabinethe i ita khuwelelo kha vhaswa vhashu uri vha dzhiele buḓo ḽa SAPS nṱha, ḽine ḽa ṋea zwikhala zwo fhambanaho.

src: Isihloko “AmaHlathi nabaNtu: Ukusisa ekuSaseni eliNzinzileko” sikhuluma ngamahlathi anzinze ebantwini, indima yamahlathi etuthukweni yezehlalakuhle nezomnotho, amathuba wezokusisa ngeemali, nendima yamahlathi etuthukweni yezomnotho.
tgt: Mafhungo manzhi a nga wanala kha WEBTOKEVhuṱambo ha ṅwaha ha Ṅwedzi wa Tshumelo ya Tshitshavha vhu ḓo farwa fhethu hoṱhe kha Tshumelo dza Tshitshavha nga ṅwedzi wa Khubvumedzi fhasi ha thero ine ya ri “U isa Afrika Tshipembe phanḓa: U isa Tshumelo ya Tshitshavha vhathuni.” Ṅwedzi uyu u ḓo sumbedza tshumelo dza muvhuso, u ḓiimisela, u ḓikumedzela na vhukoni kha nḓisedzo ya tshumelo dza tshitshavha.

src: Umhlangano lo uzakutjheja ukutlhayela kwamanzi nokutjhuguluka kobujamo bezulu.
tgt: Thero “Vhusimamaḓaka na Vhathu: U vhulunga kha Vhumatshelo vhu Vhuedzaho” i bvisela khagala madaka o ḓitikaho nga vhathu, mushumo wa vhusima maḓaka kha mveledziso ya ikonomi ya zwitshavha, ṱhoḓea na zwikhala zwa u bindudza, na mushumo wa vhusimamaḓaka kha mveledziso ya ikonomi.

src: Kuzakuba nehlelo eliya ebantwini ukwazisa umphakathi, nabantu abatlhagako ngekghonakalo lokuzibandakanya.
tgt: Izwi zwi elana kokotolo na zwipikwa zwa ndeme zwa muvhuso zwa u fhelisa vhushai, mveledziso ya mahayani na u sika mishumo.

src: Umhlangano lo uzakulandela iVeke yokuTjala imithi yeLizwe Loke (mhla lili-1 ukufikela nakali-7 kuKhukhulamungu) ngaphasi kwesihloko “Sigidinga iHlathi elitjha” kukhonjelwa amaSewula Afrika ukutjala okungenani umuthi owodwa namhlanjesi nokusiza ukusisa ekusaseni elinzinzileko.
tgt: Uyu ndi Muṱangano wa Vhusimamaḓaka ha Ḽifhasi wa u thoma u farwa kha ḽa Afrika nahone u ri ṋea tshifhinga u phurofaila dzhango ḽashu kha vhugalatenga ha ḽifhasi.

src: Umlayezo wokuthokozisa.
tgt: Mbekanyamushumo ya u swikelela ine ya ḓo vhudza tshitshavha, hu tshi katelwa na zwigwada zwi so ngo tsireledzeaho, nga ha khonadzeo ya u shela mulenzhe.

src: IKhabinethi yenza ibizelo kumaSewula Afrika ukubumbana basekele abagijimi bekhethu nabaphakamisela phezulu igama leSewula Afrika begodu benza isitjhaba sekhethu sizikhakhazise.
tgt: Muṱangano u ḓo tevhela Vhege ya Lushaka ya Arbor (1 u ya kha dzi 7 Khubvumedzi) fhasi ha thero “Kha maḓaka maswa” nahone hu humbelwa maAfrika Tshipembe u ṱavha muri muthihi ṋamusi na u thusa u bindudza kha vhumatshelo vhu vhuyedzaho.

src: IKhabinethi ivumelana noMengameli uZuma ekuthokoziseni iimbikindaba ze-SABC u-Dennis Tshetlhane no-Sam Msibi ngokuthumba eHlangothini likaMabonakude unongorwana we-SADC Media Awards, nomfundi wesikolo esiphakemeko u- Imbelani Matibe ngokuthumba i- SADC Essay School Category Competition.
tgt: Khabinethe i tamela mashudu vhagidimi vha shango ḽashu u kunda vhane vha khou ṱaṱisana kha 15th World Championships in Athletics ine ya khou itea zwazwino ngei kha ḽa Beijing, China na vhane vha khou shela mulenzhe kha 11th All-Africa Games vhukati ha dzi 4 na dzi 19 Khubvumedzi 2015 ngei kha ḽa Brazzaville, Congo.

src: IKhabinethi ithokoza woke amaSewula Afrika azibandakanya ekugidingeni iNyanga yaboMma.
tgt: Khabinethe i ita khuwelelo kha maAfrika Tshipembe uri vha vhumbane kha u tikedza vhagidimi vhashu zwenezwi vha tshi khou fhefheḓisela fulaga yashu nṱha na u ita uri uri lushaka lwashu lu ḓihudze.

src: Iminyanya eyabanjwa ziinhlangano ezihlukeneko norhulumende ezigidinge ipumelelo esiyenzileko ekuqalaneni nokungalingani ngokobulili emiphakathini yekhethu.
tgt: Khabinethe i fhethu huthihi na Muphuresidennde Vho Zuma kha u fhululedza vhoramafhungo vha SABC Vho Dennis Tshetlhane na Vho Sam Msibi kha u kunda kha Khethekanyo ya Thelevishini ya Pfufho dza Nyanḓadzamafhungo dza SADC, na mugudi wa tshikolo tsha nṱha Imbelani Matibe kha u kunda kha Muṱaṱisano wa Khethekanyo ya Tshikolo ya Maanea wa SADKhabinethe i livhuwa maAfurika Tshipembe vhoṱhe vhe vha dzhenela u pembelela Ṅwedzi wa Vhafumakadzi.

src: Inyanga le yasetjenziselwa ukutjhejisisa ngeentjhijilo esiqalene nazo mayelana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabomma nabentwana.
tgt: Mabembela e a farwa nga madzangano o fhambanaho na muvhuso e a pembelela mvelaphanḓa yo swikelelwaho kha u tandulula u sa eḓana ha mbeu tshitshavhani tshashu.

src: IKhabinethi ifisela uNgqongqotjhe wezamaPhilo u-Aaron Motswaledi ongene ngepelaveke le e-Steve Biko Academic Hospital ePitoria ukuphola msinyana.
tgt: Ṅwedzi uyu wo shumiswa u bvisela khagala khaedu dzine ri kha ḓi ṱangana nadzo zwi tshi elana na u tambudzwa ha vhafumakadzi na vhana.
